variants.text: 一段 30 秒的电影感高山冬日 Vlog 剪辑，展现同一位年轻女性在温馨的冬日度假期间探索雪山村庄的过程。采用真实奢华旅行日记的拍摄手法，包含手持摄像机运动、自然抓拍瞬间、从柔和阴天过渡到温暖火光的色调、梦幻的 35mm 胶片质感、冷色调调色配以暖琥珀色点缀、浅景深、自然的皮肤纹理、氛围感光影以及电影叙事。在所有场景中保持同一位女性形象：深色头发、年轻面容、自然妆容、放松且快乐的表情——身份需锁定参考图像。格式：4K 电影级视频，24fps，35mm 胶片颗粒，逼真的手持摄像，柔焦，冷暖对比色调，旅行纪录片风格。场景 1 (0-4s) — 到达木屋村：清爽的冬日早晨，轻雪飘落。她走出木屋门口，身穿奶油色麻花针织毛衣、带仿皮草饰边的派克大衣和针织帽，呼出的气息在冷空气中清晰可见。摄像机从身后跟随她走过铺满积雪的鹅卵石小巷，两旁是木质小屋，随后转为特写，她回头微笑着轻声说：“天哪，这感觉就像在电影里一样。”场景 2 (4-8s) — 首次滑雪：她平稳地滑下初学者坡道，雪花在滑雪板下轻柔飞溅，松树在两侧飞速掠过。低角度追拍，随后切换到前置 GoPro 视角，捕捉她因轻微摇晃而大笑并稳住身体的画面。场景 3 (8-12s) — 雪中松林漫步：虫眼视角仰望被霜覆盖的松枝，苍白的阳光穿过树枝，在冰晶上形成柔和的镜头光晕。切换至特写，她走在未被触碰的积雪中，戴着手套的手划过低垂的树枝，喃喃自语：“这里太安静了，感觉很不真实。”场景 4 (12-16s) — 温馨咖啡馆小憩：她坐在木质小咖啡馆的霜花窗边，双手捧着冒热气的热巧克力，上面覆盖着鲜奶油。温暖的室内光线与窗外蓝白色的世界形成对比。特写镜头聚焦在融化的棉花糖上，她看着窗外飘落的雪花，露出满足的浅笑。场景 5 (16-20s) — 雪橇冒险：她坐在小山顶的木制雪橇上，用力一推，大笑着飞驰而下，头发从帽子里散落出来。摄像机在雪橇高度同步跟拍。她在底部轻柔地滚入雪堆，大笑着对镜头喊道：“别拍这一段——好吧，继续拍吧。”场景 6 (20-24s) — 圣诞集市探索：夜晚的集市灯火通明，挂满了温暖的串灯，积雪落在木质摊位上，小贩推车上升起的蒸汽暗示着烤栗子的香气。她穿梭在人群中，品尝着热红酒和姜饼，脸庞被串灯和灯笼的光芒照亮。电影级特写捕捉她品尝时惊喜的眼神，背景灯光虚化成柔和的光斑。场景 7 (24-27s) — 山峰之上的金色日落：广角剪影镜头，她站在雪山观景台上，太阳落入山脉后方，天空从淡金色转为柔和的紫色，围巾在风中飘动。她将脸转向渐弱的光线，一只手按住帽子。场景 8 (27-30s) — 壁炉旁的夜晚沉思：夜晚的木屋内部，壁炉闪烁着火光，窗外可见积雪。她蜷缩在羊毛毯上，手里拿着马克杯，火光在她脸上跳动。最后的亲密特写中，她直视镜头，露出温柔温暖的微笑，说道：“晚安，来自山间。”摄像风格：真实的旅行 Vlog 摄影，手持摄像机抖动，流畅的电影级转场，缓慢推镜头，自然的漂移运动，偶尔的 POV 视角，逼真的自动对焦搜索，细微的运动模糊。视觉风格：温馨的高山冬日电影感，精品旅行品牌美学，柔和漫射的日光与温暖的室内火光，真实的皮肤纹理，电影级浅景深，怀旧的 35mm 胶片感，冷暖对比色调，自然的非剧本化表情，情感叙事。避免：卡通风格、CGI 感、塑料皮肤、不真实的面部、不连贯的角色形象、发型改变、多余的手指、扭曲的身体、人工照明、过饱和色彩、模糊的面部、不自然的动作、重复的人物。

prompt: HALF A BEAT LATE — 15 seconds. Dark gothic psychological horror. 16:9. Real-time action, controlled cuts, continuous spatial and emotional progression. REFERENCES Image 1 defines adult female jester Sin and her identical evil mirror double: exact face, white makeup, red nose, dark eye makeup, painted tear marks, red twin-horn hair, gold crown with bells, ivory ruff, red-and-blue court costume, pointed shoes. Image 2 defines the room and opening frame: burgundy curtain and warm wall sconce on the left, charcoal walls, wooden floor, large antique gold mirror on the right. Preserve the room, mirror frame, and light direction. IDENTITY AND STAGING SIN starts outside the mirror: increasingly frightened, resisting capture. DOUBLE starts inside the mirror: amused, disobedient, smiling, physically assertive. After the exchange, DOUBLE is outside in the room and SIN is trapped behind intact glass. Begin on Image 2’s empty-room composition. Sin enters from lower-left, walks diagonally to the mirror, and stops about 55 cm from the glass, torso facing it, back and partial profile toward camera. Keep her slightly off the mirror center so both real and reflected faces stay visible. Camera remains on the mirror’s left-front side; the glass stays broadly visible, not edge-on. Natural perspective, readable facial detail, enough depth of field for both faces. During the exchange, Sin passes inward through the screen-left half of the mirror while Double steps outward through the screen-right half. Their paths stay separate. Afterward Double takes one short settling step toward screen-left, ending in the left foreground while trapped Sin remains visible inside the mirror on the right. PERFORMANCE LOCK Sin stops smiling once she notices the anomaly and never smiles again. Double keeps smiling and never copies Sin’s fear. Sin shakes her head, retreats, gasps, loses balance, resists. Double refuses to follow, advances, grips, pulls, plants its feet. After the exchange, Sin panics inside the mirror while Double turns toward camera, smiles wickedly, then whispers. Both faces stay alive and natural, never frozen or deformed. 0-3 SECONDS — THE SMILE REMAINS A heel clicks offscreen. Sin enters immediately, takes two or three short grounded steps to the mirror, relaxed posture, chin slightly raised, small habitual smile. Weight transfers naturally through each foot; skirt and crown bells follow with soft motion and sound. Her reflection appears normal at first. Sin briefly adjusts the side of her crown with her right hand, lowers it, exhales, and her mouth turns neutral. The reflected hand lowers about half a second late. Double keeps smiling and slowly shows its teeth. A restrained push-in keeps both faces readable: Sin neutral and unsmiling, Double still smiling. 3-5.5 SECONDS — OPEN DISOBEDIENCE Sin looks from Double’s mouth to its eyes, brow tightening, then slowly shakes her head once. Double does not shake. It tilts its head slightly and widens its amused smile. Sin catches her breath, draws her chin back, retreats about 20 cm, and raises her right hand at chest height, palm toward the mirror. Double leans closer to the glass as Sin increases her real distance. Keep both opposing movements visible in the same oblique frame. 5.5-8 SECONDS — GRIP, THEN PULL Hard cut to a same-side medium shot holding both faces, Sin’s raised right wrist, and the mirror’s left edge. A localized patch of glass turns into a dark elastic membrane. Double’s left hand reaches through into the room and grips Sin’s right wrist firmly. Double pulls inward. Sin’s eyes snap to the captured wrist; her lips part in a sharp inhale. Her left hand grabs the mirror’s left frame, rear foot braces on the wooden floor, knees bend as she pulls backward. Double keeps its cold smile and retracts with steady force. Sin loses her hold on the frame. Her right shoulder is pulled forward first, then her torso; her rear shoe begins to slide. She resists the whole time and never walks voluntarily into the mirror. 8-11.5 SECONDS — ONE IN, ONE OUT The camera withdraws slightly to reveal the mirror boundary and landing foot. Double steps outward through the screen-right half of the mirror and plants one pointed shoe firmly on the wooden floor before taking weight. Sin is pulled inward through the screen-left half. Double keeps hold until Sin crosses the surface, then releases her wrist. Their identical faces pass on separate paths: Sin terrified, trembling, ragged breath; Double composed with a small victorious smile. Red hair and moving fabric briefly occlude the crossing point. Use one concealed continuity cut inside that occlusion only. When the occlusion clears, the exchange is complete: inside the mirror Sin stumbles one step away, then turns and lunges back toward the glass; outside, Double completes its settling step toward screen-left. The membrane seals back into intact reflective glass before Sin reaches it. Her palms hit the inner surface and stop. The gold frame stays rigid. No shattering. 11.5-13 SECONDS — TURN FIRST Hard cut to a same-side medium close shot that clearly contains both faces. Double starts facing the mirror, then shoulders and torso turn toward the camera until its face is fully visible. Show the full body turn before any frontal smile. Behind it, trapped Sin faces outward from inside the mirror. She looks down at her blocked palms, urgently scans the frame edges, then looks at Double. She strikes the glass once and opens her mouth to call out, unheard. Sin remains an independent trapped person, not a synchronized reflection. 13-14 SECONDS — THEN THE EVIL SMILE Double finishes turning and stands still, shoulders relaxed, eyes on the lens. Only now does one corner of its mouth rise into a clearly wicked, satisfied smile with a little tooth visible. Keep Sin sharply readable behind it: raised inner brows, tense lower lids, downturned mouth, fast chest movement, palms pressed to the glass. Her fear continues throughout Double’s smile. 14-15 SECONDS — FINALLY, “SHH” Double raises its right index finger to its lips, slightly gathers its smile, and whispers directly to camera: “Shh.” The voice is low, intimate, steady. Sin strikes the glass again with one hand while the other stays planted, mouth open in a silent plea. She never mirrors the finger gesture, smile, or gaze. Hard cut to black at exactly 15 seconds. COLOR AND LIGHT Single consistent palette: charcoal brown #211E1B for walls and deep shadow, dark burgundy #4B171A for curtain and red costume shadow, aged brass #9C7544 for mirror frame, crown, and bells, ivory grey #D8D0C1 for makeup and ruff, deep blue-grey #29313B for blue costume fabric and cool shadow. Preserve Image 2’s warm left-side sconce at about 2700-3000K. Localized old-gold highlights, subtly cool shadows, neutral midtones, restrained saturation, dense textured blacks. Protect the white makeup from orange or blue contamination. Mirror glare never hides the reflected face. No color, exposure, or lighting reset during the exchange. AUDIO Heel clicks, fabric movement, and delicate bells establish the room. Sin’s interrupted breath builds into gasps during resistance. Add wrist-grip friction, shoe scrape, frame contact, and restrained membrane tension. After the mirror seals, Sin’s voice and breathing are inaudible from the room; her impacts become faint muffled thuds. Double’s final “Shh” is the only spoken line. No music, narration, or subtitles. CONTINUITY LOCKS Exactly one original Sin and one evil Double. Preserve separate identities, correct wrist ownership, grip contact, resistance, and inward/outward travel paths across cuts. No merged bodies, duplicate occupants, extra hands, or position jumps. Before the anomaly, the reflection behaves naturally. After the exchange, both performances remain independent. prompt:
Create an 11-second cinematic dark-fantasy scene featuring a beautiful blonde female warrior queen wearing intricate medieval silver-and-black metallic armor and a delicate dark crown.

SCENE 1 — 0–3 seconds:
Begin with a dramatic top-down aerial shot. The warrior is flying/falling through thick stormy clouds with her arms stretched outward like she is diving through the sky. Her long blonde hair and pieces of her clothing move naturally in the powerful wind. Far below, a vast fantasy landscape is barely visible through the mist. The camera rapidly moves downward toward her while maintaining a powerful cinematic perspective.

SCENE 2 — 3–5 seconds:
Transition smoothly into a frontal tracking shot as she moves through the clouds. Her armored shoulders and arms remain extended. Her expression is serious, fearless and emotionally intense. Soft sunlight breaks through the clouds behind her, creating a dramatic halo around her silhouette. Tiny particles and mist pass rapidly across the camera lens.

SCENE 3 — 5–9 seconds:
Cut into an extreme cinematic close-up of her face. A huge majestic black raven/eagle suddenly flies beside her face, its dark feathers contrasting against her pale skin and blonde hair. The bird moves extremely close to her, almost touching her cheek. Feathers are released into the air and float dramatically around them. She looks directly ahead with an intense, mysterious expression.

SCENE 4 — 9–11 seconds:
The bird slowly moves away while she turns her head toward it. Her expression changes subtly from determination to curiosity and emotion. Wind continues moving her hair and armor naturally. The background remains filled with bright clouds and atmospheric mist.

VISUAL STYLE:
Epic high-budget fantasy film, photorealistic CGI, dark medieval fantasy, dramatic natural lighting, realistic metallic armor, highly detailed skin and hair, volumetric clouds, atmospheric fog, floating feathers, realistic bird movement, cinematic depth of field, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens characteristics, rich shadows, dramatic contrast, sophisticated color grading.

CAMERA:
Smooth aerial tracking, fast cinematic push-in, gradual transition to extreme close-up, shallow depth of field, realistic handheld micro-movement during the close-up, carefully controlled focus pulls, cinematic composition.

MOTION:
Natural wind physics, realistic hair movement, physically accurate feathers, believable bird flight, flowing fabric, subtle facial expressions and eye movement. No exaggerated or cartoonish motion.

MOOD:
Mysterious, powerful, emotional, majestic, supernatural and epic — like a scene from a premium dark-fantasy feature film.

Maintain consistent facial identity, anatomy and armor throughout the entire video. No face distortion, no extra limbs, no duplicated bird, no unnatural body movement, no text, no s

prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic Korean neighborhood action-comedy scene using the uploaded images as exact visual references. Keep the same characters, faces, hair, outfits and environment consistent throughout.
CHARACTERS:
Young Korean woman, early 20s, long straight black hair, green cropped long-sleeve top, loose blue jeans and silver jewelry; confident, expressive and fearless.
Young Korean man, early 20s, short black hair, gray button-up shirt, dark trousers and white sneakers; cocky at first, then increasingly nervous.
SHOT 1
The woman walks down a quiet residential street carrying a small grocery bag. She notices the man riding a tiny electric scooter toward her way too fast.
SHOT 2
He suddenly rings the bell repeatedly and gestures for her to move. She calmly steps aside, watching him pass with an annoyed expression.
SHOT 3
A few seconds later, the scooter rolls back into frame by itself. The man runs after it, desperately trying to catch it.
SHOT 4
The woman watches him sprint past her. She casually sticks out one foot and stops the scooter before it rolls into the street.
SHOT 5
He finally reaches her, out of breath, and says, “Wait… you stopped it?” She simply looks at him and says, “You’re welcome.”
SHOT 6
He grabs the scooter and tries to ride away again, but the woman notices his grocery bag has fallen open and vegetables are rolling down the sidewalk.
SHOT 7
She quickly catches several vegetables before they reach the road. The man stands there embarrassed while an elderly neighbor watches and quietly laughs.
SHOT 8
The woman hands everything back to him, gives him a playful “seriously?” look and walks away.
SHOT 9 — ENDING
The man starts riding away, then realizes his helmet is still in her hand. She raises it above her head with a tiny satisfied smile. He stops, turns around and walks back toward her as she laughs.
VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic Korean residential neighborhood, early-2000s MiniDV/camcorder aesthetic, handheld camera, imperfect framing, slight autofocus hunting, natural exposure shifts, subtle motion blur, soft digital detail, warm afternoon sunlight, realistic Korean houses, parked scooters, utility poles, narrow streets and authentic everyday atmosphere. Fast comedic timing, natural body language and hard cuts between shots.
AUDIO:
Only natural diegetic sound — footsteps, scooter motor, bell, distant traffic, birds, neighborhood ambience, vegetables hitting the pavement, natural dialogue and laughter. Absolutely no music or score.
NEGATIVE PROMPT:
No gore, blood, serious injuries, identity drift, outfit changes, duplicated people, extra limbs, distorted hands, teleportation, impossible physics, cartoon reactions, CGI look, subtitles, captions, text, logos or watermark.

prompt: [STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE] Real found-footage phone vlog on an alien planet. She is filming as she walks, the way someone records a trip for a friend: uneven clips, hard cuts, the phone too close, then swung out at whatever just moved. Slight shake, bad exposure, soft focus, lens dirt, wind slamming the mic, then creatures and plants filling the frame. When she speaks to the lens, she says the exact short lines written below, clear and plain, in a normal speaking voice. Wind can sit under the words. It does not replace them. No transitions, no slow-mo, no grade, no text, no stickers. It feels raw because the planet is doing too much for a phone. A giant moon hangs in the sky the whole day, pale and huge, even with the suns up. [SUBJECT] A woman about 27 in alien years, off-world traveler filming her own vlog. Cool lilac-grey complexion, faint mint freckles, a short glassy hair-crest messy from wind, gold eyes. Simple field clothes the whole take: dusty linen wrap, travel shirt, boots, a small pack. Fully clothed in every clip. She talks to the lens only at the beats marked below, then forgets the camera and points it at the planet. Same face in every cut. Calm, curious, a little worn. Not performing. [PLACE] An alien wild coast, lived-in and too big for the phone. Chalk shelves, forests of tall ribbed plants that lean and creak, ground-cover that pulls back when a boot lands, a gel-river the color of bottle glass, herds crossing open amber flats, a cliff path under the giant moon. Two small suns. Wind, grit, insect-choir, distant animal calls. No postcard town. The extraordinary stuff is just outside the lane. [ON-CAMERA LINES] She only speaks these lines, in this order, in a clear everyday voice: 1. “Day two. That moon still hasn’t moved.” 2. “It’s fine. It’s just eating.” 3. “They cross here every day. Look at the legs.” 4. “Yeah. I’m not going in.” 5. “Two suns. Moon’s still up.” 6. “Stopping here. I’ll send this later.” [TIMELINE — PHONE VLOG, HARD CUTS] 0-4s: HOOK — she is already walking a chalk shelf, phone in her hand, giant moon filling the upper frame behind her. She turns the lens on herself and says, clear: “Day two. That moon still hasn’t moved.” Then she flips the phone out: a stand of ribbed plants as tall as towers, swaying, seed-pods knocking. Raw, immediate. 4-9s: She pushes through a lane of vegetation. Leaves the size of doors fold aside and settle behind her. Cut to the phone dropped low: ground-cover peeling back from her boots, pale roots clicking. Cut to her stopping, holding the phone steady, filming a slow six-legged grazer the size of a cart chewing a pod. It looks at the lens. She does not get closer. She says, clear, off the side of the frame: “It’s fine. It’s just eating.” Wind under the line, words intact. 9-15s: She crests a rise. The giant moon sits on the horizon, enormous, craters readable. She films it, then the phone dips and catches a herd of long-necked grazers crossing the amber flat, legs too many, moving like a slow traffic jam. Cut to a close of a plant opening as the herd passes, then shutting. Cut to her face for a second, squinting. She says, clear: “They cross here every day. Look at the legs.” Then the phone goes back to the animals. Overexposed, dusty, real. 15-21s: Gel-river. She stands on the bank and films the surface beading and rolling upstream. Something large moves under it, a dark shape, then a fin of shell breaks and sinks. She steps back, laughs once, and says, clear: “Yeah. I’m not going in.” Cut to her crouched, filming a cluster of cube-bodied river birds pecking the mud. One hops onto a rock and stares. She stays quiet. Cut to the moon reflected, broken, in the gel. Phone almost slips. She catches it. 21-26s: Afternoon wind. She follows a dirt track between breathing shell-boulders. A door-sized beetle crosses ahead and she waits, filming its legs, then its eye, then the plants it brushes. She stays quiet. Cut to her wiping the lens with her sleeve. Cut to a high shelf: two suns, the giant moon still up, a valley of moving forest below. She turns the lens on herself and says, clear: “Two suns. Moon’s still up.” Then she holds the wide shot. The audio is wind, the far call, and that line. 26-30s: The light drops. The moon brightens until it is the main light. She films a night-opening grove, pods glowing faint mint, small flyers stitching between them. Cut to her face, tired, hair-crest flat from the wind, the moon over her shoulder. She says, clear: “Stopping here. I’ll send this later.” Last shot: phone pointed out from the shelf at the giant moon and the dark gel-river, a herd still moving as small shapes, her breathing on the mic, then the recording ends mid-step, like a real vlog file. [REALISM LOCK] Found footage alien vlog only. Handheld phone, hard cuts, dirty lens, wind, bad exposure. Same woman, fully clothed, same face. She speaks only the six written lines, in order, intelligible, everyday English. Giant moon in the sky all day. Creatures and vegetation carry the clips: ribbed forest, ground-cover that pulls back, a six-legged grazer, a many-legged herd, cube-bodied river birds, a shape under the gel, a door-sized beetle. prompt:
时长：20 秒
画幅：9:16 竖屏
主题：同一句韩语在韩剧与现实中的反差。
形式：单人角色，双重状态，五组 A/B 硬切对比。

[角色绑定]
使用统一的角色卡。在整个过程中保持相同的人物身份，使用参考图中的面部、发型和服装，不得重新设计外观。
A 和 B 是同一个人的两次表演，而非两人对话，不使用双人构图或分屏。

[状态 A | 韩剧浪漫电影]
韩剧电影中的角色特写，精致、温柔、细腻，带有轻微的浪漫感。

光影：
窗侧的大面积柔光照亮面部，光影过渡细腻；侧后方有一束柔和的暖色逆光，轻轻勾勒出头发和肩膀的轮廓。眼睛有自然的眼神光，面部立体，无平铺的美颜光。

调色：
奶油白高光，低饱和度暖肤色，阴影处带有轻微的蓝灰色调。整体通透，黑色电平略微柔和，亮部过渡平滑。背景偏向米白色、浅灰色和浅暖色。

电影质感：
中长焦人像镜头感，浅景深，眼睛和嘴巴清晰，窗帘和远处灯光虚化为细腻的焦外成像。高光处带有极轻微的柔光晕，保留皮肤纹理和细微的胶片颗粒感。
每个 A 镜头仅有非常轻微、几乎察觉不到的缓慢推镜头。

表演：
眼神柔和，自然呼吸，动作幅度小。说话前有短暂的情感停顿，声音轻柔，句尾轻落，如同韩剧中对亲近之人说话一般。

[状态 B | 普通手机拍摄]
现实室内手机前置直拍，简单的灰色墙面背景，正面直射光。中性白平衡，对比度和锐度比 A 更直接，背景也更清晰。
取消 A 的逆光轮廓、浅景深虚化、柔光晕和电影级调色，但保持正常的曝光和真实的皮肤纹理。
固定机位，构图比 A 略紧，保留轻微的手机广角近距离感，无夸张的面部拉伸。

表演：
直视镜头，眼眉明显紧绷，身体微微前倾，语气简短、直接且不耐烦。喜剧效果来自突如其来的表情变化和说话方式，而非失控的尖叫。

[构图与剪辑]
统一的竖屏头腰中景，眼睛位置保持在相似高度。
A 结束后立即硬切至 B，质感、表情和声音同时切换。
每次切换时保持同一张脸可识别，无畸变、白闪、黑帧或服装变化。

镜头 1 | 00–04 秒 | 别看

主体：
同一个人，温柔细腻与直接斥责的对比。

动作/表演：
00–02 秒，状态 A：
角色先看向侧下方，然后温柔地将视线转向镜头，带着一丝微妙的微笑，轻声说“보지 마”（别看）。说完后视线略微收回，保持自然的羞涩感。
镜头非常缓慢地推进，柔和的暖色逆光照亮少量发丝。

02–04 秒，硬切至状态 B：
角色直视镜头，眉头紧锁，头部略微前倾，以明显更重的语气重复“보지 마”（别看），随后加上一句脏话。
最后一字落下，视线仍固定在镜头上，带着一丝不悦的静止。

对白：
A：“보지 마.”
B：“보지 마, 이 개새끼야.”

环境/摄影/风格：
A 具有柔光窗帘和奶油般虚化的背景，韩剧电影质感。
B 具有灰色墙面、直射光和固定的手机拍摄感。

约束条件：
两句台词均由画面中的人说出，完成 A 后立即切至 B，口型同步准确。

Close-up of characters in a Korean romantic movie, refined, gentle, subtle, with a slight romantic feel.

Large soft light from the window side illuminates the face, with delicate light-shadow transitions; a beam of soft warm backlight from the side-rear gently outlines the hair and shoulder. Eyes have natural catchlights, face is three-dimensional, no flat beautifying light.

Medium-telephoto portrait lens look, shallow depth of field, eyes and mouth clear, curtains and distant lights softened into delicate bokeh. High-intensity highlights with extremely slight soft halo, retaining skin texture and subtle film grain.

Performance:
Soft gaze, natural breathing, small range of movement. Short emotional pause before speaking, voice is soft, sentence ends fall lightly, like speaking to someone close in a K-drama.

Reality indoor mobile front-facing direct shot, simple gray wall background, direct front lighting. Neutral white balance, contrast and sharpness more direct than A, background also clearer.

prompt:
[Main Character] = 黒髪の少女
[Partner/Target] = ポニーテールの母親
[Setting] = 家の中
[Anomaly Gimmick] = テレビ画面

[Video Style]
15 秒。日本のアニメーション、フルカラー。5 億円規模の予算をかけた高密度な 2D アニメーション。映画の予告編のような高速カット。目、手、足、背中、反射、ワイドショット、急激なプッシュインを交互に繰り返す。字幕なし、ウォーターマークなし、BGM なし。音響は呼吸音、環境音、各カットの短い効果音、そして最後のセリフのみ。

[Visual Composition]
[Setting] と [Target] の意味は、[Main Character] の視点のみによって変化する。[Anomaly Gimmick] を各ショットの繋ぎとして使用し、最終的に「見る側」と「見られる側」の役割を反転させる。

[Shot 1: One-Eye Hook]
[Main Character] の片目を画面いっぱいにクローズアップ。瞳の中に [Setting] が映り込んでいる。[Anomaly Gimmick] が瞳の奥を横切る。

[Shot 2: Feet]
[Setting] の床。足音が一歩。光と影を踏みしめる足元。

[Shot 3: Hands]
[Main Character] の手がわずかに動く。何かに触れる直前で止まる。

[Shot 4: Target]
[Target] を一瞬だけ映す。浅い被写界深度で、顔や全身をはっきりと見せない。

[Shot 5: Reflection]
鏡、窓、スマートフォン、金属、あるいは瞳の反射に [Main Character] が映る。現実の立ち位置と反射の立ち位置がわずかにズレている。

[Shot 6: Wide Shot]
[Setting] 全体を短く映す。[Main Character] がどこにいるのか判然としない構図。

[Shot 7: Approach]
急激なプッシュイン。[Target] のすぐ隣に [Anomaly Gimmick] が現れる。

[Shot 8: Reversal]
カメラが振り返るような高速パン。[Main Character] が静かにそこに立っている。

[Shot 9: Fixed Gaze]
[Main Character] がカメラを凝視する。動かない。背景だけがわずかに揺れる。

[Shot 10: Final Line]
[Main Character] が一言、「最初から見ていたよ」と呟く。最後のフレームは片目のクローズアップに戻り、終了。

prompt:
[概要] 1985 年の夏休み、祖父母の田舎の家で過ごす 10 歳の少年の日常。帰省した若い叔父が、手持ちのビデオカメラで遠くから無言で撮影している。480p、16:9、15 秒。ハードカットによる 7 つのショット（各約 2 秒）。7 つの場所はすべて異なる。トランジションやフェードはなし。被写体はカメラを意識した行動を一切しない（アイコンタクト、物を見せる、手を振る、ポーズをとるなどは禁止）。遊びに没頭している様子。演技ではなく、日常の断片を切り取ったもの。セリフやナレーションは一切なし。

[被写体] 美の定義：将来イケメンになると誰もが言うような、子役レベルの日本人少年。水に入る瞬間の子供の表情がベスト。顔：寝癖のある短い黒髪、太い眉、鋭い二重まぶた、日焼けで鼻筋の皮がむけている（リアルな肌の質感）、白い歯、顎に小さなかさぶた。服装（日常着）：白いタンクトップ（洗濯で少し黄ばんでいる）、緑のショートパンツ、麦わら帽子（縁がほつれている）、首に白いタオル、裸足にゴム草履。癖：帽子を後ろにずらす、弟をちらりと見る。顔、髪、服装はすべてのショットで統一。

[キャラクター] 弟（6 歳）：丸顔、坊主頭、白いタンクトップと赤いショートパンツ。兄の真似ばかりしている。怖がり。誰もカメラを見ない。

[時代、場所、光] 1985 年 8 月の日本の田舎。1) 古い日本家屋の縁側（朝の光、蚊取り線香の薄い煙、卵かけご飯） 2) 田んぼのあぜ道（真夏の白い光、自転車） 3) 浅い川（きらめく水面） 4) 川の岩場（小さな岩から浅瀬へ飛び込む） 5) 川岸の石の上（スイカ、強い日差し） 6) 神社の境内の木（木漏れ日、セミ） 7) 夕暮れの縁側（線香花火：細い紙縒りの先で火の玉が弾ける。青い夕闇）。画面内に看板や文字は一切なし。

[カメラ] 1985 年のホームビデオカメラの質感：色のにじみ、低解像度、水面の反射による白飛び、輪郭のぼけ。日付表示はなし。手持ち、自然な揺れ、不完全な構図、ハンティングズーム、露出の変動。被写体から 3 ～ 6 メートルの距離。被写体はカメラを無視。手ブレ補正、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画のような照明、商業的なカラーグレーディングは禁止。カメラは常に人が持っている高さ（立っている、座っている、しゃがんでいる、歩いている、隣の席など）にある。人が立ち入れない場所からのアングルは禁止。撮影者は明らかに同じ空間にいる人物で、被写体が動くと少し遅れて追いかけ、時折フレームが甘くなる。

[ショット] （各約 2 秒。各行＝場所と光 / 行動 / 内面的な感情と小さな仕草 / カメラ位置）
1. 縁側/朝。急いで卵かけご飯を食べる。目はすでに先の庭を見ている。感情：早く川に行きたい。蚊取り線香の煙が横に流れる。カメラ：縁側の外から。
2. あぜ道/自転車。弟を後ろに乗せて立ち漕ぎ。口を真一文字に結んで前を見ている。感情：頼れる兄貴分。風で帽子が後ろにずれる。カメラ：後ろから追従、揺れあり。
3. 浅瀬。網を持って腰まで水に浸かり、息を止めて魚を見つめる。感情：集中。弟は後ろにいる。カメラ：岸から、水面の反射が白飛びしている。
4. 岩場。小さな岩から浅瀬へ飛び込み、水しぶきを上げて顔を出しながら大笑いする。感情：解放感、爽快感。カメラ：岸から少し離れて、水しぶきが画面にかかる。
5. 川岸の石/スイカ。かぶりついて種を遠くに飛ばし、ニヤリと弟を見る。感情：競争心。カメラ：横から、強い日差し。
6. 神社の木/木漏れ日。網で捕まえたセミを弟の目の前に突き出し、弟がのけぞるのを見て笑う。感情：いたずら心。カメラ：弟の後ろから。
7. 縁側/夕方。線香花火の火の玉を真剣に見つめ、落ちた後に消えた場所を眺める。感情：一日の終わりの小さな寂しさ。カメラ：縁側の端に座って横から。この間、約 00:14 に突然録画がブラックアウトする。フェードアウトはなし。

[Overview] A day in the life of a 10-year-old boy spending his summer vacation at his grandparents' rural home in 1985. No transitions or fades. The subject does nothing for the camera: no eye contact, no showing objects, no waving, no posing. Immersed in play. Fragments cut from the middle of daily life, not acting. No dialogue, lines, or narration.

[Subject] Definition of beauty: A Japanese boy of child-actor caliber whom everyone says will be handsome in the future. A child's face the moment they enter water is best. Face: short black hair with bedhead, thick eyebrows, sharp double-lidded eyes, peeling skin on the bridge of the nose from sunburn (realistic skin texture), white teeth, a small scab on the chin. Clothing (everyday wear): white tank top (slightly yellowed from washing), green shorts, straw hat (frayed brim), white towel around the neck, bare feet in rubber sandals. Habits: pushing the hat back, glancing at the younger brother. Face, hair, and clothing are identical in all shots.

[Characters] Younger brother (6 years old): round face, buzzed head, white tank top and red shorts. Mimics everything the older brother does. Easily scared. No one looks at the camera.

[Era, Place, Light] Rural countryside in August 1985. 1) Veranda of an old Japanese house (morning light, thin smoke from a green coil mosquito repellent, rice with raw egg) 2) Rice field path (midsummer white light, bicycle) 3) Shallow river (sparkling water surface) 4) River rocks (jumping from a small rock to the shallows) 5) On a riverbank stone (watermelon, strong sunlight) 6) Tree in a shrine precinct (dappled sunlight, cicadas) 7) Veranda in the evening (sparkler firework: a small ball of fire sparking at the end of a thin paper twist. Blue twilight). No signs or text in the frame.

[Camera] 1985 home video camera texture: bleeding colors, low resolution, blown-out highlights on water reflections, soft outlines. No date display. Handheld, natural shake, imperfect composition, hunting zoom, exposure fluctuations. 3-6m distance from subject. Subject ignores the camera. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading. The camera is always at the height of a person holding it (standing, sitting, crouching, walking, next seat). No angles from places a person couldn't be. The filmer is a person clearly in the same space, following slightly late when the subject moves, occasionally with soft framing.

[Shots] (Approx. 2s each. Each line = Location & Light / Activity / Inner emotion and small leaked gestures / Camera position)
1. Veranda/Morning. Hurriedly eating rice with egg. Eyes already on the garden ahead. Emotion: Wanting to get to the river fast. Mosquito coil smoke drifts sideways. Camera: From outside the veranda.
2. Path/Bicycle. Standing to pedal with the brother on the back. Mouth set in a firm line looking ahead. Emotion: Reliable older brother vibe. Hat slips back in the wind. Camera: Following from behind, shaking.
3. Shallows. Submerged to the waist with a net, holding breath staring at fish. Emotion: Concentration. Brother still behind. Camera: From the bank, water reflections blown out.
4. Rocks. Diving from a small rock into the shallows, laughing loudly with face rising from splashing water. Emotion: Sense of liberation, refreshment. Camera: Slightly away from the bank, spray hits the screen.
5. Bank stone/Watermelon. Biting in, spitting seeds far, glancing at the brother with a smirk. Emotion: Competitiveness. Camera: From the side, strong sunlight.
6. Shrine tree/Dappled light. Thrusting a cicada caught in a net in front of the brother, laughing at him recoil. Emotion: Mischievousness. Camera: From behind the brother.
7. Veranda/Evening. Staring seriously at the fire ball of a sparkler, watching the spot it vanished after falling. Emotion: Small loneliness at the end of the day. Camera: Sitting at the edge of the veranda from the side. During this, at approx 00:14, the recording suddenly blacks out. No fade out.

[Prop Details] Net has a bamboo handle with green mesh. Bicycle is a black utility bike with a carrier. Straw hat brim is frayed. Watermelon is striped, eaten close to the rind. Mosquito coil is a green spiral in a ceramic pig holder. Sparkler has red paper at the tip of the twist.

[Physics & Consistency] Real-world physics. No extra fingers, fused hands, distorted anatomy, floating objects, vanishing items, or sudden deformations. Splashes, wet hair/clothes, and sparks should be realistic. Feet grounded. Hat, towel, and brother's clothes same in all shots.

[Sound] Only natural ambient sounds (switches per shot): clinking of a rice bowl, bicycle chain and wind, river flow, splash of diving, biting watermelon, cicada chorus, crackling of sparklers. No words. Occasional small laughter/breaths from the filmer and subject allowed. No music, no narration, no artificial sound effects.

[Atmosphere] A record of a nondescript day of a boy in Showa-era countryside that makes adults feel 'I had a summer like this.' Fragments of play, not acting. Nostalgic, bright, deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that a camera just happened to be there.

Location: Small old Seoul apartment bedroom on a quiet rainy morning. Simple wooden furniture, unmade bed, small desk, clothes casually placed around the room and a rain-covered window overlooking blurred apartment buildings. Steady rain outside.

Lighting & Atmosphere: Cozy, dim blue-hour ambience. Cold blue-gray light from the rainy window mixed with a weak warm bedside lamp. Dark cloudy sky, muted colors, soft shadows and slightly underexposed interior. Sleepy, intimate rainy-morning atmosphere.

Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video. Completely candid and unstaged. Natural handheld movement, subtle camera shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus hunting, mild exposure shifts, faded colors, soft contrast, authentic DV compression, subtle low-light digital noise and microphone noise. Smooth continuous real-time motion throughout. No stuttering, judder, frame skipping, duplicated frames, stop-motion appearance, excessive motion blur, speed changes or low-frame-rate look. No stabilization or modern cinematic movement.

00:00–00:04: She stands beside her desk casually organizing a few small things, occasionally glancing toward the rainy window. The camcorder watches from a slightly imperfect angle.

00:04–00:07: She suddenly feels a sneeze coming. She pauses, scrunches her face slightly and brings her hand toward her nose.

00:07–00:10: She sneezes naturally into her hand. For a moment she looks a little surprised by how sudden it was.

枚取ります。左手はボウルの縁を支えています。右手は肉をボウルの真上まで運び、麺の上に静かに置き、トングを開きます。同じ動作を 3 回繰り返し、肉を扇状に少しずつ重ねます。次に、右手はトングをトレイの縁に置き、代わりに大きな穴あきお玉を取り、丸い牛団子を 3 つすくい、ボウルの真上まで運び、お玉を傾けて団子を優しく転がり落とします。終了状態：ボウルには白い麺、その上に扇状に重なった茶褐色の肉、手前に 3 つの丸い団子。店主の右手は穴あきお玉を持ったままフレーム内にあります。左手はまだボウルの縁を支えています。カメラの水平移動はここで停止します。音：トングが金属トレイに当たる硬い音、肉が麺に当たる湿った音、団子がボウルの底に当たる鈍い音。 [ステージ 6] 21～26秒 背を向けたまま注ぎ、熱を逃がす。カメラ：2段階でドロップ。最初はカウンター越しのミディアムクローズアップ、立ち姿勢の目線の高さで固定。前景ボケは絶えず前を流れる湯気の筋で、画面の下半分を柔らかく覆います。次に、カメラはボウルの縁の高さまで下がり、ボウルのすぐ横から斜め上を見上げるようにチルトアップ。前景ボケはボウルの縁の曲線と、その真上から立ち上る厚い湯気です。その湯気越しに、画面の上半分には、ボウルを覗き込む店主の首から鎖骨、胸にかけてのラインが見えます。前かがみの姿勢で薄い生地が体からわずかに離れます。顔はフレーム上端で切れており、画面には映りません。主な出来事：店主は画面左のストックポットの方へ振り返り、背中と左肩をカメラに向けます。うなじに張り付いた湿った髪の毛、呼吸に合わせて端子の青色が隙間で点滅し、薄い生地越しに肩甲骨のラインが交互に浮き上がります。店主は右手でお玉にスープをすくい、ゆっくりと体をもとのボウルを覗き込む姿勢に戻し、お玉をボウルの縁の高さまで真っ直ぐ下げ、傾けて熱い琥珀色のスープを注ぎます。湯気が特に濃く立ち上ります。注ぎ終わると、右手はお玉をストックポットの縁に戻し、空いた左手で襟元を優しくつまみ、ゆっくりと布を肌から引き離します。首から熱が逃げて湯気が乱れ、指を離すと布は静かに戻り、湿った肌に追従します。次に、左手で刻みネギとスライスオニオンが入った小さなステンレス容器を持ち上げ、ボウルの真上まで運びます。容器は常に画面内にあります。右手の指で容器からネギとオニオンをつまみ、スープの上に静かに落とし、最後に同じようにパクチーの葉を 2 枚置きます。左手は容器をカウンターに戻します。終了状態：ボウルはスープで満たされ、茶褐色の肉、丸い団子、緑の葉が浮いています。お玉はストックポットの縁にあり、容器はカウンターの中央にあります。店主はカウンターの正面を向くように上体を起こし、両手をボウルの両側に添えます。音：スープがボウルに落ちる音、葉がスープの表面に触れる微かな音、容器が木に当たる音、雨音。 [ステージ 7] 26～30秒 盛り付けと髪を直す。カメラ：カウンター越し、店主と対面するミディアムショット。カメラの高さは座っている人の目線。店主の腰から上がフレームに収まり、顔は画面上半分の中央にあります。前景ボケは右下の小さな薬味皿と、前を立ち上る湯気の筋。カウンターの手前縁が画面の下端を横切り、向こう側は空で、木製丸椅子の背が隅にわずかに見えます。主な出来事：店主は両手でボウルを持ち上げ、体の正面を真っ直ぐ横切ってカウンターの手前縁まで運び、ゆっくりと置きます。ボウルから手を離し、右手で箸を取り、ボウルの右側に水平に置きます。その後、背筋を伸ばして立ち、右手を上げ、頬に落ちていた湿った髪の毛をゆっくりと耳にかけます。首筋が露わになった瞬間、車両の列が頭上を通り過ぎ、白い光の帯が首から鎖骨へと滑り、消えます。店主は視線を落とし、一歩下がります。終了状態：ボウルはカウンターの手前縁にあり、湯気の筋が立ち上り、軒先の隙間に吸い込まれています。箸はボウルの右側に水平に置かれています。店主はカウンターの内側に立ち、両手は体の横に下ろしています。客席は最後まで空席のままです。音：ボウルが古い木に当たる低い音、箸が当たる軽い音、作業音が静寂に落ち着き、雨と霧が砕ける音だけが残る。 [禁止事項] 店主以外の人物を画面に映さないこと。客、通行人、他人の手、顔、肩、影は不可。客席の椅子は最後まで空席にすること。食材や道具は画面外から落ちてきたり、空中に浮いたり、勝手に動いたりしてはならない。何かが動くときは、店主の手がそれを持っていること。生の赤い肉、血の色、調理中に色が変わる食材は決して見せないこと。牛肉は最初から最後まで茶褐色で煮込まれていること。食材を切る動作は描写しないこと。ナイフ、まな板、刃物は画面に映さないこと。食材が二つに分かれる瞬間は映さないこと。ステージ 4 以外で、カメラがカウンターの内側に回り込むことは禁止。ステージ 4 以外で、店主を背後から撮るためにキッチン側に視点を移動することは禁止。店主の顔や体が手のクローズアップに割り込まないようにすること。フレーム外と指定されたステージで顔を映さないこと。前景ボケには指定された 7 つのアイテム以外を配置しないこと。前景ボケで被写体を完全に隠さないこと。前景ボケにピントを合わせないこと。店主はポーズをとらないこと。カメラに対して体をアピールするような姿勢をとらないこと。すべての動作は調理手順として自然に流れること。店主はしゃがまないこと。腰を下げるために膝を曲げないこと。スクワットや上下運動は禁止。店主の足の位置と腰の高さは全編を通して一定であること。前かがみになる動作は各ステージで一度だけ行うこと。上体を何度も上下させないこと。BGM、音楽、台詞、ナレーション、字幕、テキストオーバーレイは生成しないこと。画面に文字、数字、ロゴ、看板の文字を表示しないこと。看板やホログラムは文字のない色の塊としてぼかすこと。発光するのは、浮遊する電球、ストックポット底面の青い層、前腕フレームの関節、うなじの端子、通過する車両の列のみ。他の発光や光の輪郭を追加しないこと。指や関節の数を間違えないこと。店主を全身サイボーグにしないこと。顔、首、肩、脚、指は人間の皮膚のままにすること。店主は歯を見せて笑わないこと。カメラを見ないこと。フェードやディゾルブを使用しないこと。スープの中に生き物を描かないこと。頼まれていない食材や余分なボウルを出さないこと。ロボットア。

variants.text: [素材角色定义] @Image1 定义了 <Owner> 的面部特征、发型、发色和服装。不使用图像中的背景、道具、构图和姿势。[通用设置] 角色定义：画面中仅出现店主一人。严禁出现顾客、路人、其他人的手、脸或肩膀。摊位顾客一侧始终空无一人，木制圆凳保持空置。店主始终站在柜台后，不会移动到前方。动作定义：所有物体均由店主的手移动。食材、碗、汤勺、夹子和筷子不会自行移动、从画框外掉落或悬浮在半空中。向碗中添加物品时，店主的手必须将其带入画面，直接移至碗上方，然后放下。在物体被放下之前，手必须保持在画面内。摄像机路线：原则上，摄像机位于柜台外侧的街道一侧。唯一的例外是第 4 阶段，摄像机通过摊位侧面靠近地面的开口置于内部，从后方拍摄店主。在其他阶段，摄像机不进入摊位内部；当展示店主的背部或颈部时，摄像机不会绕行，而是店主转身面向汤锅。遵循此路线，并在该范围内，在每个阶段显著改变角度、高度和镜头，以避免出现相似的镜头。积极使用俯视镜头、靠近地面的低角度镜头、微距特写和正面中景镜头。[前景虚化定义] 在每个阶段，将物体放置在最靠近摄像机的位置并进行显著虚化。仅使用这 7 种物品作为前景虚化，不得添加新物品：蒸汽条纹、从屋檐悬挂的干面束和塑料条、悬挂灯球的虚化光斑、柜台前缘、从屋檐落下的雨滴条纹、小调料碟、碗沿的弧线。将前景虚化放置在屏幕边缘或下半部分，不要遮挡主体。焦点始终对准中景的店主及其双手；前景虚化需模糊至失去轮廓。[视差定义] 前景、中景和背景以不同的速度移动。前景的蒸汽和悬挂物流动与摇摆最快且最慢，中景的店主和摊位位置不变，背景的城市灯光几乎不动。在摄像机移动的阶段，前景快速流过屏幕，中景因视差轻微位移，背景看起来保持静止。[环境] 近未来夜晚，东南亚市区一条小巷内的河粉摊。小雨持续落下，路面反射着灯光。优先真实呈现蒸汽、水滴、汤中的油光、不锈钢上的细微划痕以及木制柜台上的陈年污渍。摊位是木头和金属制成的老式手工结构，一侧开放无墙，可以看到店主的脚部。屋檐下悬挂着干面束和褪色的塑料条，并粗糙地加装了新技术。[风格] 日本全彩剧场版动画。电影级高质量画作。等效于全画幅 35mm F1.4 的极浅景深，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感。双色调配色，城市夜景为冷青色，摊位为琥珀色。阴影不会死黑，而是沉入蓝灰色。只有摊位的琥珀色和背景的人造灯光具有饱和度。[布局] 悬浮汤锅位于屏幕左侧，盛放炖牛肉片的不锈钢托盘在中央，白色深碗和小调料碟在右侧。动作从左向右进行。保持这种左右关系。但在第 4 阶段，由于摄像机在店主身后，屏幕左右反转：汤锅出现在右侧，深碗在左侧。这是正确的；除第 4 阶段外，所有阶段汤锅均在左侧，深碗在右侧。[光线] 主要光源是悬挂在屋檐下的暖琥珀色灯球。它没有灯丝；一个拳头大小的球体悬浮在支架末端并发出光芒。辅助光是城市夜景的冷蓝色。在整个过程中保持光照和时间一致。[近未来元素] 仅限以下 6 项；所有其他工具、食材和动作均与现代摊位的手工劳动相同。1. 雨水在屋檐外的一道无形边界处破碎成细雾，横向流动而非落下。边界轮廓呈现虹彩色，摊位内部保持干燥。2. 一列磁悬浮列车静默地从头顶上方经过，一道白光条从后向前扫过柜台后消失。3. 汤锅悬浮在支架上方几厘米处，锅底与底座之间有一层薄薄的蓝光。4. 蒸汽被吸入屋檐后的一道细缝中，在吸入前产生涡流。5. 店主双前臂上纤细的哑光黑色外骨骼框架。手腕以下是裸露的手，手指和手掌为人类皮肤。6. 店主后颈发际线处嵌入了一个小型连接终端，随呼吸频率发出微弱的蓝光。[食物] 仅一碗牛肉河粉。所有牛肉均经长时间炖煮至熟透，呈现沉稳的棕褐色，边缘带有白色脂肪带。严禁出现生红肉、血色或烹饪过程中变色的食材。碗内包含白色扁河粉、薄炖牛肉片、圆形牛肉丸、清澈的琥珀色汤底、葱花、洋葱片和香菜。小碟中装有豆芽、泰国罗勒、青柠角和红辣椒圈。所有食材均已切好并煮熟，摆放在托盘和小碟中。碗为带有缺口和裂纹的老式白瓷；始终只出现一个。[角色设计] <Owner> 20 多岁的东南亚女性。面部特征、发型、发色和服装严格参考 @Image1；以下为图像中未显示的补充元素。皮肤为温暖的蜜色，因锅的热气，颈部和锁骨处渗出细密的汗珠，在光线下微微发光。保持真实的毛孔和皮肤纹理。由于潮湿，几缕碎发粘在额头和后颈的发际线上。薄薄的织物因热气和潮湿贴合在皮肤上，随着每一次动作静静勾勒出身体的自然线条。腰间系着棉质围裙。骨骼结构纤细柔韧。双眼始终注视着手部，从不看向摄像机；表情几乎没有变化，眼神略显慵懒。工作中流露出脆弱感，未意识到自己正被他人注视。[表演核心] 通过指尖、手背、手腕、颈部、后颈、锁骨、胸线、肩胛骨、大腿线条、侧脸和背部来讲述故事，而非整个面部。在展示身体部位的阶段，以该部位的特写进行拍摄，描绘织物随身体移动、摇摆、离开并贴回皮肤的物理细节。展示人类皮肤与前臂黑色框架之间的对比。所有动作缓慢，不省略中间步骤。[第 1 阶段] 0-3 秒 空摊位。摄像机：广角，靠近路面的低位。在保持手持微震的同时缓慢推向摊位。前景虚化为占据屏幕下三分之一的湿润路面，反射的光环快速向左流动。中景的摊位缓慢变大，背景的城市灯光保持静止。店主站在柜台后中后方，注视着汤锅。脸部较小，表情难以解读。主要事件：小雨开始，雨滴在屋檐外的无形边界处破碎成雾，产生流动的虹彩轮廓并消失。一列列车从头顶经过，一道白光条从后向前扫过柜台一次后消失。结束状态：摄像机停在柜台前。店主位于中后方，汤锅在左，托盘在中央，碗在右。三张木制圆凳均为空置。此后雨持续落下。声音：小雨声，雨滴在边界破碎的干脆声，低沉的电磁嗡嗡声，汤锅炖煮声。[第 2 阶段] 3-7 秒 擦拭柜台。摄像机：俯视，固定。四角昏暗，只有中央柜台被琥珀色照亮。前景虚化为右上角巨大的悬挂灯球，变成微微摇摆的模糊金色光球。店主脸部不在画面内。主要事件：店主前倾，用右手拿着湿布缓慢擦拭木制柜台。薄织物贴合着她的背部，肩胛骨在布料下交替隆起。透过粘在后颈的碎发缝隙，可以看到嵌入的终端随呼吸频率闪烁着微弱的蓝光。前臂上的黑色框架在皮肤上轻微滑动。结束状态：柜台前半部分湿润并反射光线。店主用右手折叠抹布，放在柜台右端，直起身，转身面向左侧的汤锅。声音：湿布摩擦老木头的低沉声，汤锅炖煮声，雨声。[第 3 阶段] 7-12 秒 闻汤香。摄像机：三步变焦。首先，从斜下方对汤锅进行极度特写。一层薄薄的蓝光填满锅底与底座之间的缝隙；上方，琥珀色的汤底安静地炖煮，八角和焦姜缓慢旋转，表面闪烁着细小的油星。前景虚化为一道穿过前方的蒸汽条纹。接着，摄像机降至锅沿高度并斜向上倾斜。屏幕下三分之一被上升的蒸汽填满。蒸汽上方，屏幕中央，透过蒸汽可以看到从店主颈部到锁骨和胸部的线条。前倾姿势下，薄织物略微离开身体，随后又贴回被汗水浸湿的皮肤。汗膜在光线下微微发光。通过蒸汽，可以看到顶部边缘模糊的脸部。最后，半身像，回到跨过柜台的微低角度，店主脸部位于屏幕上半部分中央。主要事件：店主缓慢俯身在汤锅上方，将脸靠近上升的蒸汽以检查香气。她眯起眼睛，安静地吸气。随后直起身，右手拿起汤勺，舀起汤，高高举起手臂，将其以细弧线倒回锅中。液体在蒸汽中发光。接着，店主将汤勺边缘触碰嘴唇，抿了一口汤，喉咙缓慢移动，她闭上眼睛，微微点头。此时，一列列车从头顶经过，一道白光条瞬间勾勒出她锁骨和下颌线的轮廓后消失。结束状态：店主用右手将汤勺挂在汤锅边缘。身体挺直，双眼睁开，视线回到手上。声音：液体落下的声音，汤锅炖煮声，安静的呼吸声，列车经过的低沉切风声。[第 4 阶段] 12-17 秒 烫面。摄像机：仅此阶段，摄像机通过摊位侧面开口置于内部，高度距地面 30 厘米。从斜后方拍摄店主的特写构图。摄像机紧贴店主，指向她的背部，在五秒内垂直上升约 60 厘米至腰部高度，上升过程中仰角逐渐变浅。上升过程为连续镜头。上升开始时，湿润的地板和凉鞋后跟在屏幕底部，从围裙下摆到膝盖以上的大腿线条在中央，蒸汽在顶部。随着摄像机上升，画面移动到围裙结和从腰部隆起的臀部线条，最后停在腰部上方。前景虚化为沿地面爬行的蒸汽，柔和地覆盖屏幕底边。背光蒸汽将身体轮廓勾勒成白色，背景的城市灯光作为小光斑透过身体侧面闪烁。店主的脸和后脑勺不在画面内。主要事件：店主双腿微张，面向摊位后方的煮面锅，背对摄像机。从始至终，她的脚部位置和腰部高度完全不变；只有手臂、上半身和摄像机在移动。店主双手拿着装有白色扁河粉的金属漏勺，缓慢浸入沸水中，安静地摇晃两三次。腰后的围裙带随着手臂动作缓慢摇摆，薄织物沿着身体线条移动。蒸汽剧烈上升，模糊了屏幕顶部，并在被吸入屋檐缝隙前产生涡流。随后她双手提起漏勺，沥干水分，直接移至身体右侧的深碗上方，倾斜漏勺将面滑入碗底。结束状态：深碗底部只有白色河粉。店主背对镜头，站在相同位置和高度，将空漏勺放在热水旁。摄像机停在腰部上方。声音：沸水声，漏勺触碰表面的声音，落下的水滴声，细微的气流声。[第 5 阶段] 17-21 秒 摆放肉片。摄像机：跨过柜台的斜上方中特写，拍摄店主胸部到碗的范围。店主脸部在画面顶部边缘被切掉，未出现在屏幕上。仅在此阶段，摄像机水平向右缓慢移动约 30 厘米。前景虚化由悬挂在屋檐下的干面束和褪色塑料条组成，占据屏幕左边缘并快速向左流动。中景的店主和碗因视差仅轻微位移，背景城市灯光保持静止。主要事件：店主右手拿金属夹，从中央托盘中夹起一片薄薄的棕褐色炖牛肉。左手扶住碗沿。右手将肉片直接移至碗上方，安静地放在河粉上，松开夹子。重复此动作三次，肉片呈扇形略微重叠。接着，右手将夹子放在托盘边缘，改用大漏勺，舀起三颗圆形牛肉丸，直接移至碗上方，倾斜漏勺将肉丸轻轻滚入。结束状态：碗内有白色河粉，顶部铺有扇形重叠的棕褐色肉片，前方有三颗圆形肉丸。店主右手在画面内拿着漏勺。左手仍扶着碗沿。水平摄像机移动在此停止。声音：夹子触碰金属托盘的硬声，肉片触碰河粉的湿润声，肉丸触碰碗底的沉闷声。[第 6 阶段] 21-26 秒 转身浇汤，散热。摄像机：分两步下降。首先，站立视平线跨过柜台的中特写，固定。前景虚化为不断流过前方的蒸汽条纹，柔和地覆盖屏幕下半部分。接着，摄像机降至碗沿高度，从碗旁斜向上倾斜。前景虚化为碗沿弧线和直接上方升起的浓厚蒸汽。透过蒸汽，在屏幕上半部分，可以看到店主俯身在碗上方时，从颈部到锁骨和胸部的线条。前倾姿势下，薄织物略微离开身体。脸部在画面顶部边缘被切掉，未出现在屏幕上。主要事件：店主转身面向屏幕左侧的汤锅，向摄像机展示背部和左肩。一缕潮湿的头发粘在后颈，终端的蓝色随呼吸在缝隙中闪烁，肩胛骨线条透过薄织物交替隆起。店主右手舀汤入勺，身体缓慢转回俯身在碗上方，将汤勺平稳降至碗沿高度，倾斜倒下滚烫的琥珀色汤底。蒸汽升腾得格外浓厚。倒完后，右手将汤勺放回汤锅边缘，空闲的左手轻轻捏住衣领，缓慢将织物从皮肤上拉开。热气从颈部散发，扰动了蒸汽，当手指松开时，织物静静贴回潮湿的皮肤。接着，左手拿起装有葱花和洋葱片的小不锈钢容器，直接移至碗上方。容器始终在画面内。右手手指从容器中捏起洋葱和葱花，安静地撒在碗中的汤上，最后以同样方式用手指放入两片香菜叶。左手将容器放回柜台。结束状态：碗中盛满汤，棕褐色肉片、圆形肉丸和绿叶漂浮其中。汤勺在汤锅边缘，容器在柜台中央。店主直起身面向柜台前方，双手扶在碗的两侧。声音：汤落入碗中的声音，叶片触碰汤面的微弱声，容器触碰木头的声音，雨声。[第 7 阶段] 26-30 秒 摆放并整理头发。摄像机：跨过柜台面向店主的中景。摄像机高度为坐姿视平线。店主腰部以上的上半身在画面内，脸部位于屏幕上半部分中央。前景虚化为右下角的小调料碟和前方升起的蒸汽条纹。柜台前缘横跨屏幕底边；另一侧为空，角落隐约可见木制圆凳的背部。主要事件：店主双手端起碗，平稳地横向移至柜台前缘，缓慢放下。她松开碗，右手拿起一双筷子，水平放置在碗右侧前方。随后她挺直背部站立，抬起右手，缓慢将一缕落在脸颊上的潮湿碎发别到耳后。就在颈部露出时，一列列车从头顶经过，一道白光条从颈部滑向锁骨后消失。店主垂下视线，退后一步。结束状态：碗位于柜台前缘，一道蒸汽升起并被吸入屋檐缝隙。筷子水平放置在碗右侧。店主站在柜台后，双手垂在身侧。顾客座位始终保持空置。声音：碗触碰老木头的低沉声，筷子触碰的轻声，工作声音归于寂静，只剩下雨声和雨滴破碎声。[禁止事项] 严禁在画面中出现店主以外的任何人。无顾客、路人、其他人的手、脸、肩膀或阴影。顾客凳子需保持空置直至结束。食材和工具不得从画框外掉落、在空中漂浮或自行移动。当物体移动时，店主的手必须持有它。严禁展示生红肉、血色或烹饪过程中变色的食材。牛肉从始至终必须是棕褐色的炖煮状态。严禁描绘切割食材的动作。画面中不得出现刀具、砧板或刀刃。不得展示食材分裂成两半的瞬间。除第 4 阶段外，严禁摄像机绕行至柜台内部。除第 4 阶段外，不得将视角移至厨房侧拍摄店主背影。不得让店主的脸部和身体侵入手的特写镜头。在指定不出现脸部的阶段，不得展示脸部。除指定的 7 项物品外，不得在前景虚化中放置任何其他物品。不得用前景虚化完全遮挡主体。不得对前景虚化进行对焦。店主不得摆姿势。不得采取向摄像机展示身体的姿势。所有动作应如烹饪流程般自然流动。店主不得蹲下。不得弯曲膝盖降低腰部。不得做深蹲或上下移动身体。店主脚部位置和腰部高度始终保持不变。前倾动作在每个阶段仅限一次；不得反复上下移动上半身。不得生成背景音乐、对话、旁白、字幕或文字叠加。屏幕上不得显示字符、数字、标志或招牌文字。将招牌和全息图模糊处理为无文字的色块。唯一发光的事物是悬浮灯球、汤锅底部的蓝光层、前臂框架的关节、后颈的终端以及经过的列车光线。不得添加其他光晕或光轮。不得破坏手指或关节的数量。不得将店主制作成完全的赛博格。脸部、颈部、肩膀、腿部和手指保持人类皮肤。店主不得微笑或露出牙齿。不得看向摄像机。不得使用淡入淡出或叠化。不得在汤中绘制生物。不得摆出未经要求的食材或额外的碗。机器人 ar。

variants.text: [Material Role Definition] @Image1 defines the facial features, hairstyle, hair color, and clothing of the <Owner>. The background, props, composition, and pose of the image are not used. [General Settings] Character definition: The owner is the only person shown on screen. Do not show customers, passersby, other people's hands, faces, or shoulders. The customer side of the stall remains vacant throughout, and the wooden round stools are empty. The owner always stands behind the counter and does not move to the front. Motion definition: All objects are moved by the owner's hands. Ingredients, bowls, ladles, tongs, and chopsticks do not move on their own, fall from outside the frame, or appear suspended in mid-air. When adding something to the bowl, the owner's hand must bring it into the frame, carry it directly above the bowl, and then release it. The hand remains in the frame until the object is released. Camera Line: In principle, the camera is on the outside, the street side of the counter. The only exception is Stage 4, where the camera is placed inside through an opening at the side of the stall near the floor, capturing the owner from behind. In other stages, the camera does not go inside the stall; when showing the owner's back or neck, the camera does not circle around, but the owner turns back toward the stockpot. Follow this line, and within that range, significantly vary the angle, height, and lens in each stage so as not to create a similar shot twice. Actively use top-down views, low-angle shots near the floor, macro close-ups, and front medium shots. Foreground Bokeh Definition: In every stage, place something at the position closest to the camera and blur it significantly. Only use these 7 items for foreground bokeh, and do not add new items: streaks of steam, bundles of dried noodles and vinyl strips hanging from the eaves, bokeh from hanging light globes, the front edge of the counter, streaks of raindrops falling from the eaves, small condiment dishes, the arc of the bowl's rim. Place the foreground bokeh at the edges or bottom half of the screen, not covering the subject. Focus is always on the middle-ground owner and their hands; foreground bokeh is blurred until it loses its outline. Parallax Definition: The foreground, middle ground, and background move at different speeds. The foreground steam and hanging objects flow and sway most quickly and slowly, the middle-ground owner and stall do not change position, and the background city lights hardly move. In stages where the camera moves, the foreground flows quickly across the screen, the middle ground shifts slightly due to parallax, and the background appears stationary. Environment: A small pho stall facing an alley in a downtown area of Southeast Asia on a near-future night. Light rain continues to fall, and the road surface reflects the light. Prioritize the realistic portrayal of steam, water droplets, the sheen of oil in the soup, fine scratches on stainless steel, and old stains on the wooden counter. The stall is an old handmade structure of wood and metal, with one side open without a wall, allowing a view down to the owner's feet. Bundles of dried noodles and faded vinyl strips hang from the eaves, with new technology crudely grafted on later. Style: Japanese full-color theatrical anime. Cinematic high-quality drawing. Extremely shallow depth of field equivalent to a full-frame 35mm F1.4, with subtle film grain. Two-color color grading with cold teal for the city night and amber for the stall. Shadows are not crushed to black but sink into a bluish-gray. Only the stall's amber and the background's artificial lights have saturation. Layout: The floating stockpot is on the left of the screen, the stainless steel tray with stewed beef slices is in the center, and the white deep bowl and small condiment dishes are on the right. The work moves from left to right. Maintain this left-right relationship. However, only in Stage 4, because the camera is behind the owner, the left and right on the screen are reversed: the stockpot appears on the right and the deep bowl on the left. This is correct; in all stages except Stage 4, the stockpot is on the left and the deep bowl is on the right. Light: The main light source is a warm amber light globe hanging from the eaves. It has no filament; a fist-sized sphere floats and glows at the end of a support. The auxiliary light is the cold blue of the city night. Keep the lighting and time of day consistent throughout. Near-future elements: Only the following 6 items; all other tools, ingredients, and actions are the same manual labor as modern stalls. 1. Rain breaks into a fine mist at an invisible boundary outside the eaves, flowing sideways instead of falling. The boundary's outline bleeds into iridescent colors, and the inside of the stall stays dry. 2. A line of maglev vehicles passes silently overhead, and a strip of white light licks the counter from back to front and disappears. 3. The stockpot floats a few centimeters off the stand, with a thin layer of blue light between it and the base. 4. Steam is sucked into a thin slit behind the eaves, swirling just before it. 5. Thin matte-black exoskeleton frames on both of the owner's forearms. From the wrists down are bare hands, with human skin on fingers and palms. 6. A small connection terminal is embedded at the owner's hairline at the nape of the neck, blinking a faint blue in time with her breathing. Food: Only one bowl of beef pho. All beef is cooked through after long stewing, appearing a calm brownish-tan with a white band of fat at the edges. Never show raw red meat, the color of blood, or ingredients that change color during cooking. The bowl contains white flat noodles, thin slices of stewed beef, round beef meatballs, clear amber soup, chopped green onions, sliced onions, and cilantro. Small dishes have bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime wedges, and red chili rings. All ingredients are already cut and cooked, arranged on trays and small dishes. The bowl is old white porcelain with chips and crazing; only one is shown until the end. [Character Design] <Owner> A Southeast Asian woman in her late 20s. Strictly refer to @Image1 for facial features, hairstyle, hair color, and clothing; the following are added for elements not shown in the image. Skin is a warm honey color, with a fine film of sweat appearing on the neck and collarbone from the heat of the pot, glowing slightly in the light. Maintain real pores and skin texture. A few strands of stray hair stick to the hairline on the forehead and nape due to humidity. Thin fabric follows the skin due to heat and humidity, quietly tracing the natural lines of the body with every movement. A cotton apron at the waist. A slender and supple skeletal structure. Eyes are always down at the hands and never look at the camera; the expression hardly changes, a slightly listless gaze. Vulnerable actions during business, not conscious of being seen by others. [Acting Core] Tell the story through fingertips, the backs of hands, wrists, neck, nape, collarbone, chest line, shoulder blades, thigh line, profile, and back, rather than the whole face. In stages showing a body part, zoom in as a close-up of that part, depicting even the physics of the cloth following, swaying, leaving, and returning to the skin. Show the contrast between human skin and the black frames on the forearms. All movements are slow, not omitting intermediate steps. [Stage 1] 0-3 seconds Empty Stall. Camera: Wide shot, low position near the road surface. Slowly dolly into the stall while maintaining hand-held micro-vibrations. Foreground bokeh is the wet road surface occupying the bottom third of the screen, where reflected rings of light flow quickly toward the left. The middle-ground stall slowly grows larger, and the background city lights are stationary. The owner stands behind the counter in the center-back, looking at the stockpot. The face is small, and the expression is unreadable. Main events: Light rain begins, raindrops break into mist at an invisible boundary outside the eaves, creating an iridescent shimmering outline that flows sideways and disappears. A line of vehicles passes overhead, and a strip of white light licks the counter from back to front once and disappears. Ending state: The camera stops in front of the counter. The owner is in the center-back, stockpot on the left, tray in the center, bowl on the right. All three wooden round stools are empty. The rain continues from this point on. Sound: Light rain, the dry, fine sound of raindrops breaking at the boundary, low electromagnetic hum, the pot simmering. [Stage 2] 3-7 seconds Wiping the Counter. Camera: Top-down view, fixed. The four corners are dark, and only the center counter is lit in amber. Foreground bokeh is a hanging light globe largely in the upper right corner, becoming a blurry golden orb swaying slightly. The owner's face is not in the frame. Main events: The owner leans forward and slowly wipes the wooden counter with a wet cloth in her right hand. Thin fabric follows her back, and shoulder blades alternately rise under the cloth. Through the gaps in the stray hair sticking to the nape, the faint blue of the embedded terminal can be seen blinking in time with her breathing. The black frame on the forearm slides slightly over the skin. Ending state: The front half of the counter is wet and reflects light. The owner folds the cloth with her right hand, places it on the right end of the counter, straightens up, and turns back to the stockpot on the left. Sound: The low sound of a damp cloth rubbing old wood, the pot simmering, rain. [Stage 3] 7-12 seconds Checking the Soup's Aroma. Camera: Zooming in three steps. First, an extreme close-up of the stockpot from diagonally below. A thin layer of blue light fills the gap between the bottom of the pot and the stand at the bottom of the screen; above it, the amber soup simmers quietly, star anise and charred ginger swirl slowly, and tiny stars of oil sparkle on the surface. Foreground bokeh is a streak of steam crossing the front. Next, the camera drops to the level of the pot's rim and tilts up diagonally. The bottom third of the screen is filled with rising steam. Above that steam, in the center of the screen, the line from the owner's neck to the collarbone and chest is visible through the steam. The thin fabric hangs slightly away from the body in the leaning posture and returns to follow the sweat-dampened skin. The film of sweat glows slightly in the light. The face is seen blurred at the top edge of the frame through the steam. Finally, a bust shot, returning to a slight low angle from across the counter, with the owner's face in the center of the upper half of the screen. Main events: The owner slowly leans over the stockpot, bringing her face close to the rising steam to check the aroma. She narrows her eyes and inhales quietly. Then she straightens up, takes a ladle with her right hand, scoops up the soup, raises her arm high, and pours it back into the pot in a thin arc. The liquid glows in the steam. Next, the owner touches the rim of the ladle to her lips, takes one sip of the soup, her throat moves slowly, she closes her eyes, and nods slightly. At that moment, a line of vehicles passes overhead, and a strip of white light momentarily outlines the hollow of her collarbone and jawline before disappearing. Ending state: The owner hangs the ladle on the rim of the stockpot with her right hand. Her body is upright, her eyes are open, and her gaze is back at her hands. Sound: The sound of liquid falling, the pot simmering, quiet breathing, the low wind-cutting sound of the vehicle line. [Stage 4] 12-17 seconds Blanching the Noodles. Camera: Only for this stage, place the camera inside through the opening at the side of the stall, set at a height of 30 cm from the floor. A close-up composition capturing the owner from diagonally behind. The camera stays close to the owner, pointing at her back, and rises straight up about 60 cm to waist height over five seconds, with the angle of the tilt-up becoming shallower as it rises. The ascent is one continuous shot. At the start of the ascent, the wet floor and the heels of the sandals are at the bottom of the screen, the line of the thighs from the hem of the apron to above the knees is in the center, and steam is at the top. As the camera rises, the screen moves to the knot of the apron and the line of the hips rising from the waist, finally stopping just above the waist. Foreground bokeh is steam crawling along the floor, softly covering the bottom edge of the screen. Backlit steam outlines the body in white, and city lights from the background peek through the side of the body as small bokeh circles. The owner's face and the back of her head are not in the frame. Main events: The owner stands with her legs slightly apart facing the noodle pot at the back of the stall, with her back to the camera. Her foot position and waist height do not change at all from beginning to end; only her arms, upper body, and the camera move. The owner holds a metal noodle strainer with white flat noodles in both hands, slowly submerges it in the boiling water, and quietly shakes it twice or thrice. The apron strings at the back of the waist sway slowly with the movement of her arms, and the thin cloth moves along the lines of her body. Steam rises vigorously, blurring the top of the screen, and swirls just before being sucked into the slit of the eaves. Then she lifts the strainer with both hands, drains the water, carries it directly over the deep bowl on the right side of her body, and tilts the strainer to slide the noodles into the bottom of the bowl. Ending state: Only white noodles are in the bottom of the deep bowl. The owner stands in the same position at the same height with her back turned, placing the empty strainer next to the hot water. The camera has stopped just above the waist. Sound: The boiling water, the sound of the strainer hitting the surface, falling water droplets, the sound of a thin air current. [Stage 5] 17-21 seconds Arranging the Meat. Camera: Medium close-up from diagonally above across the counter, capturing from the owner's chest to the bowl. The owner's face is cut off at the top edge of the frame and is not on screen. During this stage only, the camera moves horizontally about 30 cm to the right very slowly. OSSGAROTH, THE HOLLOW WARDEN 🗿🔥

Long before the rifts scarred Valdir, an order of oath-keepers sealed the first rift beneath the earth. A seal of magic alone would not hold — so they bound their greatest guardian's soul into a body of consecrated stone and the bones of fallen oath-keepers, burying him in the catacombs as a living lock.

For a thousand years he slept in the dark, and the roots of the world grew through him.

When the new rifts tore through the land, one opened inside his tomb. Void energy flooded the ancient cracks of his body and rekindled the ember-core in his chest. The seal broke. The lock now walks.

He does not leave the dungeon because the rift still bleeds beneath it — he is bound to the wound itself. And so the Hollow Warden waits in the torchlight, judging every soul that descends by a single question:

Are you an oath-breaker?

prompt:
[概要] 5 歳の女の子の幼稚園帰りから就寝までの記録。母親がスマートフォンを持ち、少し離れた場所から無言で撮影している。現代。480p、16:9、15 秒間。7 つの異なる場所で撮影された 7 つのハードカット（各約 2 秒）。トランジションやフェードはなし。被写体はカメラを意識せず、視線を合わせたり、物をカメラに向けたり、手を振ったり、ポーズをとったりしない。目の前のことに夢中になっている様子。演技ではなく、日常の断片。セリフやナレーションは一切なし。

[被写体] 美の定義：子役のオーディションに合格するほど可愛い日本人の女の子。何かに夢中になっている横顔が最も可愛い。顔：ふっくらとした丸い頬、大きな二重の黒目、長いまつげ、小さく丸い鼻、笑うと乳歯が見える小さな口、血色の良い透明感のある白い肌（リアルな質感）。髪：肩までの長さの黒髪のツインテール、片方が少し崩れている。服装：水色のコットンワンピース（膝にわずかな汚れ）、白いレギンス、光るスニーカー、うさぎの耳がついた小さなリュックサック（文字なし）。癖：片足でぴょんぴょん跳ねる、興味のあるものに顔を近づけすぎる。顔、髪、服装はすべてのカットで統一する。

[登場人物] 母親（撮影者）：画面には映らないが、時折漏れる小さな笑い声、吐息、カメラを構え直す際の衣擦れの音は含める（言葉はなし）。最初のカットで母親の手のみがフレームインする。

[時間・場所・光] 現代の夏の夕方から夜。1. 幼稚園前の道（オレンジ色の夕日、看板なし）。2. 帰宅途中の花壇（西日）。3. 公園の水飲み場（夕暮れの光）。4. 玄関（暖色系の照明）。5. リビングの床（クレヨン、暖色系の照明）。6. 洗面所（ドライヤー、白色照明、鏡は映さない）。7. 布団（薄暗い常夜灯）。看板、文字、ロゴ、画面などが映り込まない場所やアングルを選ぶ。

[カメラ] 横向きのスマートフォン手持ち撮影。自然な揺れ、不完全な構図、子供の目線の高さからのローアングル、時折発生するオートフォーカスの迷い、露出の変動。被写体から 1.5 ～ 3 m の距離。被写体はカメラを無視する。手ブレ補正、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画のような照明、商業的なカラーグレーディングは一切なし。カメラは常に撮影者の手の位置（立っている、座っている、膝をついている、歩いている）にある。不可能なアングル（空中、水中、天井など）はなし。撮影者は同じ空間にいる実在の人物で、被写体を少し遅れて追いかけている。

[ショット] 1. 幼稚園の道／夕方。母親の手を握り、嬉しそうに片足で跳ねる。感情：会えて嬉しい。リュックが揺れる。カメラ：膝立ちの高さ、横からのアングル。2. 花壇／西日。花に顔を近づけてしゃがみ込み、鼻先を花びらに触れさせ、鼻をこする。感情：優しい気持ち。カメラ：横からのアングル、一瞬花にピントが合う。3. 水飲み場。蛇口をひねり、水が勢いよく出て顔が濡れ、呆然とする。感情：驚きから楽しさへ。カメラ：距離を置いて撮影。4. 玄関。靴を脱ごうとしてつまずき、呆然としてから笑う。感情：おかしみ。カメラ：廊下から見下ろすアングル。5. リビングの床。クレヨン画を描き終え、持ち上げて満足げに頷く。感情：誇らしげ。カメラ：床近く、斜め後ろからのアングル。6. 洗面所／ドライヤー。ドライヤーの風で顔が崩れる様子に笑う。感情：くすぐったくて楽しい。カメラ：アップ、髪がなびく。7. 布団／常夜灯。本を読みながらまぶたが下がり、眠気と戦って負ける。感情：眠いが認めない。カメラ：優しく近づく。0:14 でフェードなしの暗転。

[小道具] うさぎのリュックはフェルトの耳が少し汚れている。光る靴はピンク色で、かかとが光る。16 色のクレヨン（箱に文字なし）。本の表紙は見せない。白いプラスチック製のドライヤー。

[禁止事項] 判読可能な文字、ロゴ、看板、ラベル、パッケージ、デジタルディスプレイの映り込みは禁止。

[物理的整合性] リアルな物理法則。指の数が多い、手が融合している、物体が浮いている、突然の変形はなし。足は地面についていること。髪、リュック、靴の整合性を保つ。

[音] 自然な環境音のみ：鳥、虫、水、靴の音、クレヨンで描く音、ドライヤーの音、衣擦れの音。言葉はなし。撮影者と被写体の時折の小さな笑い声や吐息は許可。音楽やナレーションはなし。

[雰囲気] 「うちの子もこんなだったな」と思わせる、ありふれた夕方の記録。演技ではなく、集中している瞬間の断片。愛おしく、温かく、人間味にあふれたもの。カメラがたまたまそこにあったという感覚を最優先する。

prompt:
I. 任务目标

生成一段严格时长为 15 秒、16:9 横屏比例的视频，具备电影级照片写实质感。

整体概念如下：

将现代职场焦虑演绎为一场古代仙门试炼。

这并非简单的喜剧，也不依赖摔倒或扮丑来制造笑点，而是通过庄严的对峙感、克制的冷面表演以及音乐突然切断的节奏反差，将一场普通的视频面试拍摄得如同生死判决般庄重。

模型使用：

Seedance 2.0 Mini

重点利用其以下能力：

多模态参考
15 秒多镜头叙事
复杂角色互动
稳定的镜头控制
原生音画同步

II. 参考图使用规则

角色参考

图 1 和图 2 中的人物保留之前的设定作为固定的身份锚点。

背景参考

所有新上传的图片仅严格用作背景和地点参考。

必须从参考图中保留：

建筑结构

空间布局
地面材质
光线方向
主色调
空间深度
天气状态
环境陈设
不得随意替换地点，不得将背景更改为其他空间，不得模糊成泛化场景。

III. 角色设定

角色 ID A | 剑仙师姐 | 遵循图 1

始终保持同一人物，面部和服装不得改变：

25–30 岁东亚女性

鹅蛋脸

自然白皙皮肤
锐利深棕色眼睛
黑色长直发
高挑纤细身材
玉簪
白色刺绣丝绸汉服
半透明层叠宽袖
银色腰饰
白布靴
同一把银色长剑
角色气质：
冷静

高阶

强烈的压迫感
如面对宗门试炼般庄重克制
角色 ID B | 自行车师姐 | 遵循图 2
始终保持同一人物，面部和服装不得改变：

25–30 岁东亚女性

表情丰富

棕色马尾辫
固定身体比例
黄色夹克
蓝色牛仔裤
白色运动鞋
固定配饰
同一辆自行车
角色气质：
熟悉现代生活节奏

负责推动情节发展

具有轻微的辅助喜剧功能
但表演保持克制，不夸张
IV. 整体风格与氛围
整体视觉风格：

电影级照片写实质感

古代仙侠角色进入现代职场场景

冷蓝色环境光与暖色实景灯光及电脑屏幕光形成冲突

湿润的空气感和真实的光影层次
自然的头发和丝绸织物运动
高端庄重的构图
克制的冷面幽默
喜剧不依赖摔倒、扮丑或夸张表演
整体情绪关键词：
试炼感
紧张

压迫

严肃
荒诞但不混乱
将现代焦虑转化为古风表达
V. 镜头结构
镜头 1 | 0–5s | 试炼开场
景别与运镜

低角度广角镜头

镜头缓慢推进

运动稳定且克制

无炫技，无抖动

视觉内容
上传的背景地点必须完全可识别
同一位剑仙师姐静止站在画面中央
表情如面对生死仙门试炼

同一位自行车师姐站在她身后

自行车师姐将一台轻薄的现代笔记本电脑放入同一辆自行车的前车篮中
自行车、电脑、人物和背景的空间关系必须稳定清晰
动作与表演
剑仙师姐保持绝对克制，不四处张望
自行车师姐动作干脆自然，不夸张
头发和丝绸织物轻微自然飘动

环境光保持冷蓝色主调，暖色实景光和屏幕光形成层次对比

声音
存在自然的空间环境音
突然响起视频会议连接通知声
此声音作为“试炼正式开始”的信号

镜头 2 | 5–10s | 英雄技能与现代审问
景别与运镜
牛仔镜头或中景
镜头缓慢进行半圆形环绕

保持人物、电脑、自行车和背景空间的连续性

视觉内容

同一位剑仙师姐转向同一台笔记本电脑

背景始终保持相同的上传地点
保持同一辆自行车、同样的光照、同样的天气
表演与对白

仅在电脑中出现画外音面试官，无需真人出镜。

面试官问道：
“请介绍一下你的核心技能。”
剑仙师姐以极其庄重的语气回答，仿佛在正殿汇报宗门机密：

“御剑百里，护阵破邪。”

面试官不动声色，立即追问：

“精通 Excel 吗？”

节奏反差

这句话出现的瞬间，必须完成清晰的喜剧节奏反转：

原本的英雄主义弦乐戛然而止

剑仙师姐周围极度微弱、克制的剑气氛围同时消失

不是爆发式的笑声表演，而是通过史诗感的突然丧失形成冷面幽默

镜头 3 | 10–15s | 表格阵法
景别与运镜
特写至大特写
镜头靠近面部表情
保持画面克制、稳定且易读

视觉内容

同一位自行车师姐从画面边缘探身进来

动作幅度小，不搞笑

她低声耳语：
“说是。”
表演与对白

剑仙师姐缓缓转向电脑摄像头，依然保持着绝世高手的尊严与冷静，认真回答：

“是的。精通……表格阵法。”
场景安静了半秒钟。
电脑中的面试官平静地回复：

“好的。”
此时，同一辆自行车的车铃轻轻“响”了一声，宛如最终判决的法槌落下。

结束帧

剑仙师姐依然严肃的眼睛的大特写
旁边的同一位自行车师姐紧紧咬住嘴唇忍住笑意
不要夸张地大笑出声
让荒诞感停留在克制的瞬间

VI. 环境与连续性规则

背景必须始终生动，但在叙事上绝对中立。

需要持续自然存在的内容：
风
环境光变化
轻微的头发飘动

丝绸织物的自然摆动

空间深度

场景中真实的氛围感

如果背景包含其他可见的环境元素，它们也必须根据参考图逻辑自然存在，但不得喧宾夺主。

连续性要求
全程严格保持以下稳定性：
剑仙师姐身份稳定
自行车师姐身份稳定
自行车稳定
笔记本电脑稳定

长剑稳定

地点稳定

光线方向稳定
天气稳定
主色调稳定
摄像机位置变化合理
人物面部不能漂移
服装不能改变
VII. 声音设计
必须原生同步生成的音频和视觉。
重点强化这些声音：
视频会议连接通知声
面试官画外音
剑仙师姐普通话对白
自行车师姐低声耳语

自行车铃声轻响

轻微的环境底噪

织物摩擦声

必要的呼吸感

声音节奏重点
第一个通知声如同“试炼开启”
当出现“精通 Excel 吗？”时，音乐必须突然切断
最后的铃声如同结案法槌
声音必须服务于喜剧反差，而非嘈杂
VIII. Seedance 2.0 Mini 执行重点
请将模型能力聚焦于以下几点：
角色身份一致性
图 1 的剑仙师姐和图 2 的自行车师姐绝不改变面部或服装

背景参考严格落地
新上传的图片仅负责背景地点
不换地点，不换空间，不模糊环境

精准的喜剧节奏
由庄重的语气与现实面试问题之间的落差建立
通过音乐撤退和面部克制完成
可靠的音画同步
连接声、画外音、对白、铃声必须严格对应动作和表情
现代物体与古代角色的共存自然
笔记本电脑、自行车、前车篮必须真实可信
无廉价拼贴感
IX. 严格避免

视觉问题

模糊

质量差

低质量

低分辨率

噪点
jpeg 伪影
水印

text

错误
构图不佳

出框

畸形

角色问题

变形
突变

解剖结构错误
手部绘制糟糕
面部 morphing（变形）
换装
角色不一致
尴尬的表情
夸张的喜剧表演
连续性问题
背景偏移
道具消失
剪辑故障
自行车形状改变
笔记本电脑大小或位置改变
剑不一致
风格问题

无闹剧喜剧

无刻意扮丑
无夸张的故障反应
无动画感
无游戏 CG 感
无无意义特效
无字幕
无廉价短视频滤镜感
X. 最终效果目标

I. Task Objective

Generate a short video strictly 15 seconds long, 16:9 landscape, with cinematic photorealistic texture.

The overall concept is:

Film modern workplace anxiety as an ancient immortal sect trial.

It is not simple comedy, nor relying on falls or ugliness for laughs, but using a sense of solemn confrontation, restrained deadpan performance, and rhythmic contrast of suddenly cutting music, to film an ordinary video interview as a scene as solemn as a life-and-death verdict.

Model Usage:

Seedance 2.0 Mini

Focus on utilizing its capabilities:

Multimodal reference
15-second multi-shot narrative
Complex character interaction
Stable camera control
Native audio-visual synchronization

II. Reference Usage Rules

Character Reference

Figures in Image 1 and Image 2 retain previous settings as fixed identity anchors.

Background Reference

All newly uploaded images are strictly used only as background and location references.

Must preserve from reference images:

Architectural structure

Spatial layout
Ground material
Light direction
Main color tone
Spatial depth
Weather state
Environmental furnishings
Do not arbitrarily replace locations, do not change the background to other spaces, do not blur into generalized scenes.

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Sister | Follows Image 1

25–30 year old East Asian female

Oval face

Natural fair skin
Sharp dark brown eyes

Tall slender figure
Jade hairpin
White embroidered silk Hanfu
Semi-transparent layered wide sleeves
Silver waist ornament

Calm

High-tier

Strong oppressive presence
Dignified and restrained like facing a sect trial

Always maintain the same person, no face or outfit changes:

25–30 year old East Asian female

Expressive face

Brown ponytail
Fixed body proportions
Yellow jacket
Blue jeans
White sneakers
Fixed accessories
Same bicycle
Character temperament:
Familiar with modern life rhythm

Responsible for driving the situation forward

Has slight auxiliary comedic function
But performance remains restrained, not exaggerated
IV. Overall Style and Atmosphere
Overall visual style:

Cinematic photorealistic texture

Ancient Xianxia characters entering modern workplace scenes

Cold blue ambient light clashing with warm real-scene lights and computer screen light

Moist air and realistic light layers
Natural hair and silk fabric movement
High-end solemn composition
Restrained deadpan comedy
Comedy does not rely on falls, ugliness, or exaggerated performance
Overall emotional keywords:
Sense of trial
Tension

Oppression

Seriousness
Absurd but not chaotic
Modern anxiety translated into ancient style
V. Shot Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Trial Opening
Shot Size & Camera Movement

Low-angle wide shot

Camera slowly tracks in

Movement is stable and restrained

No showing off, no shaking

Visual Content
The uploaded background location must be fully recognizable
The same Sword Immortal Sister stands in the center of the frame, motionless
Expression like facing a life-or-death immortal sect trial

The same Bicycle Sister stands behind her

Bicycle Sister places a thin modern laptop onto the front basket of the same bicycle
Bicycle, computer, characters, and background spatial relationships must be stable and clear
Action & Performance
Sword Immortal Sister maintains absolute restraint, not looking around
Bicycle Sister moves crisply and naturally, not exaggerated
Hair and silk fabric move slightly and naturally

Ambient light maintains cold blue main tone, warm real-scene lights and screen light form layered contrast

Sound
Natural spatial ambient sound exists
Suddenly a video conference connection notification sound rings
This sound acts as the signal for "the trial officially begins"

Shot 2 | 5–10s | Hero Skills and Modern Interrogation
Shot Size & Camera Movement
Cowboy shot or medium shot
Camera slowly performs a semi-circular orbit

Maintain continuity of characters, computer, bicycle, and background space

Visual Content

The same Sword Immortal Sister turns toward the same laptop

Background always keeps the same uploaded location
Keep the same bicycle, same lighting, same weather
Performance & Dialogue

Only an off-screen interviewer appears in the computer, no live-action person needed.

Interviewer asks:
"Please introduce your core skills."
Sword Immortal Sister answers in an extremely solemn tone, as if reporting sect secrets in the main hall:

"Control sword for hundred miles, protect formation and break evil."

The interviewer shows no emotion, immediately follows up:

"Proficient in Excel?"

Rhythmic Contrast

The moment this line comes out, a clear comedic rhythmic reversal must be completed:

Original heroic string music instantly stops abruptly

The extremely faint, restrained sword qi atmosphere around Sword Immortal Sister disappears simultaneously

Not explosive laughter performance, but forming deadpan comedy through sudden loss of epic feel

Shot 3 | 10–15s | Spreadsheet Formation
Shot Size & Camera Movement
Close-up to extreme close-up
Camera gets closer to facial expressions
Keep the frame restrained, stable, and readable

Visual Content

The same Bicycle Sister leans in from the edge of the frame

Small action amplitude, not funny

She whispers:
"Say yes."
Performance & Dialogue

Sword Immortal Sister slowly turns to the computer camera, still maintaining the dignity and calm of a peerless expert, seriously answering:

"Yes. Proficient... in spreadsheet formations."
The scene is quiet for half a second.
The interviewer in the computer calmly replies:

"Okay."
At this moment, the bell of the same bicycle lightly "rings", like the final gavel of judgment falling.

Ending Frame

Extreme close-up on Sword Immortal Sister's still serious eyes
The same Bicycle Sister beside her bites her lip tightly to hold back laughter
Do not laugh out loud exaggeratedly
Let the absurdity stop at the moment of restraint

VI. Environment and Continuity Rules

Background must always be vivid, but absolutely neutral narratively.

Content that needs to persistently exist naturally:

始终保持同一人：

20–25 岁东亚女性

圆脸灵动
黑色编发
身材娇小
穿着同一套绿色亚麻汉服
深色腰带
木发簪
黑布鞋
手持同一把深钢剑
三、环境 DNA 与空间原则

本轮新上传的所有背景和地点参考图像共同决定同一组环境 DNA。

在正式构图前，静默重组并统一以下内容：

真实地形

建筑语言

空间尺度材质
植被
水体
天气
山雾
云层
反射
主光方向
空气深度
然后重新规划一个仅属于本轮的新地点，完全统一、真实且可信。
通用环境规则

背景必须始终生动，但在叙事上绝对中立：

风自然持续存在

水持续流动

山雾随地形游走
植被随风自然响应
衣物和头发受风自然影响
反射和远景持续微妙变化
远处人物和空间环境声持续存在
但这些环境元素：
不能主动制造情节

不能帮助任何人做决定

不能推动冲突解决
不能抢夺戏剧焦点
四、剧情结构
镜头 1 | 0–5s

景别

全景或远景

画面调度

剑仙大师姐和小师妹位于主要前景区域

正前方有一名敌方指挥官

一名长老师父、两名门派弟子、几名受伤平民、少量敌兵分布在不同景深层

地理关系清晰稳定
摄像机克制稳定，清晰建立所有人物关系和道具位置
关键道具
一份停战文书
一支毛笔

桌子或等效的古代书写支撑面

剧情与对白
敌方指挥官当众展开停战文书，说道：
“认输，今晚撤军。不认输，日落再战。”

师父冷冷回答：

“我门下无降字。”

小师妹没有争辩，只是默默伸手拿起桌上的毛笔。

本镜头关键点

建立“认输”与“门派尊严”之间的第一层冲突

小师妹拿笔的动作必须稳重、缓慢、清晰

让观众开始预期她将做出违背常理的决定

镜头 2 | 5–10s
景别
中景或牛仔镜头（Cowboy Shot）

连续性要求

全程保持以下内容稳定：

相同的两位主角

相同的服装

相同的停战文书

相同的毛笔

完全一致的地理空间
配角位置连续
剧情与动作
小师妹在众人面前于停战文书上签下自己的名字。
师父突然喝道：
“这一笔，你知道留下了什么吗？”

小师妹没有抬头，只回答：

“我知道。”

完整停顿半拍，然后补上一句：

“留下明天。”

此时，剑仙大师姐突然伸手，从她手中夺过毛笔。

在这一刻，画面必须给观众造成明显的误判，认为大师姐想要阻止她，甚至可能划掉名字。

下一秒，大师姐极其冷静地在小师妹的名字下方签下了自己的名字。

师父真正震惊，问道：

“你也认输？”

大师姐回答：

“败是我们。”

再停顿一拍，然后说道：

“名字不能只留给她一个人。”

在浅景深后方，敌方指挥官原本冷酷坚硬的表情第一次发生明显变化。

本镜头关键点

小师妹的书写必须果断，表演中不能犹豫太久

大师姐夺笔的动作必须克制，制造一个干净的误导时刻

双签名是本片核心反转的视觉确立点

戏剧焦点在于“共同责任”，而非“阻止”或“煽情”

镜头 3 | 10–15s
景别
特写或大特写
连续性要求

全程保持以下内容稳定：

相同的大师姐

相同的小师妹

相同的停战文书

毛笔、墨迹、长剑和服装一致

配角位置和空间关系连续

剧情与对白
小师妹看着大师姐，低声问道：
“师姐，你不怕被后人耻笑吗？”
白衣剑仙真正迎上她的目光，只回答：
“怕。”

完整保留一个干净、沉重的停顿。

然后她将目光移向那些受伤的普通平民，只说：

“先让今天的人活到后世。”

结尾动作与余韵

小师妹原本一直紧绷的表情终于极轻微地放松

敌方指挥官默默收起已签署的停战文书

他转身命令士兵放下武器

年长的师父并未轻易被说服，也未做总结

他只是经过长久的沉默后，缓缓侧身让开一步

最终镜头情绪
最后两位女性并肩站立：
没有胜利的姿态
没有羞耻的表情
她们失去了名义上的胜负

她们主动保全了明天

五、表演原则

剑仙大师姐
克制
清醒
不喊口号

情感保持非常平稳

真正的力量体现在“主动分担败名”

小师妹

前段默默承受压力
中段书写时坚定
后段情感松动极轻
无哭泣/呐喊，无煽情，不要演脆弱
师父

强烈但克制

不是纯粹的反派，也不会立即被说服
他的沉默和最后的让步必须带有代价感
敌方指挥官
前半部分将“认输”视为耻辱

后半部分第一次意识到对手是在为更多人争取生存机会

表情变化清晰，但不能抢主角风头
群体配角
仅作见证者

在不同景深层保持自然存在

不抢台词，不抢镜头主导权
六、摄影与拍摄要求
16:9 横屏

严格三个连续的清晰镜头

运镜稳定、克制、清晰
不炫技
镜头服务于人物关系和道具逻辑

前景、中景、背景保持真实的视差

让观众清晰看到毛笔、停战文书、书写、双签名、配角反应

光影与质感
自然体积光
细腻胶片颗粒感
稳定锐利的面部微表情细节
墨迹、纸张、丝绸衣物、金属武器必须有真实质感
七、声音与音画同步
必须原生同步普通话对白并精确匹配口型。

关键声音包括：

毛笔书写声
纸张摩擦声
停战文书被触碰和收起的声音
织物细微声响

长剑与剑鞘轻微的金属声

环境风声、水声、远处人群轻微动静

声音原则：

环境声持续自然存在

不压过对白
停顿必须具有真实的戏剧重量
签署和收起停战文书时，声音应清晰但克制
八、Seedance 2.0 Mini 执行重点
对于 Seedance 2.0 Mini，重点增强以下四项能力：
多人视觉主次分明
主体始终是大师姐和小师妹
群体配角仅为见证者和压力源

动作设计简单清晰
拿笔、书写、夺笔、再次签字、收文书、让步
每个动作必须可读，不能模糊

角色身份与核心道具连续性
两位主角身份稳定
停战文书、毛笔、墨迹、长剑连续稳定
配角位置尽可能稳定
克制的微表演与光影连续性
通过眼神接触、停顿、呼吸、手指细微变化完成情感表达
不依赖夸张表演
九、严格避免
画面问题

variants.text:
Seedance 2.0 Mini | 15-second three-shot Xianxia short film prompt | "Writing Defeat"

I. Task Objective

Generate a complete continuous 15-second Chinese Xianxia movie short film, 16:9 landscape, strict three-shot structure, each segment about 5 seconds.

Overall Tone:

Cinematic realistic texture
Pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetic
Mature wartime moral tension
Restrained but constantly taut emotional power
Veteran screenwriter-style dialogue driven by subtext and consequences
Advanced wuxia character scheduling
Arri Alexa cinema camera texture
Stable sharp facial micro-details
Natural volumetric light
Fine film grain

Core reversal revolves around a harder kind of courage:

When continuing to fight for the word "win" will cause more ordinary people to die, does a truly responsible person dare to personally write "defeat" under everyone's gaze?

II. Reference Images and Character Anchors

Character Identity Anchors

Strictly use the 1st image in upload order and 2nd image in upload order as character identity anchors for the two protagonists.

Character ID A | 1st Image | Sword Immortal Senior Sister

Always maintain same person:

25–30 year old East Asian female

Oval fair face
Dark almond eyes
Black hair half-up
Fixed with white jade hairpin
Tall slender figure
Same set of white embroidered silk Hanfu
Silver waist seal
Jade pendant
White cloth boots
Holding same silver long sword
Character ID B | 2nd Image | Junior Sister

Always maintain same person:

20–25 year old East Asian female

Round lively face
Black braided hair
Petite figure
Same set of green linen Hanfu
Dark belt
Wooden hairpin
Black cloth shoes
Holding same dark steel sword
III. Environment DNA and Spatial Principles

All background and location reference images newly uploaded in this round jointly determine the same set of Environment DNA.

Before formal composition, silently reorganize and unify the following content:

Real terrain

Architectural language

Spatial scale
Materials
Vegetation
Water bodies
Weather
Mountain mist
Cloud layers
Reflections
Main light direction
Air depth
Then replan a new location unique to this round, completely unified, real and credible.
General Environment Rules

Background must always be vibrant, but narratively absolutely neutral:

Wind exists naturally continuously

Water flows continuously

Mountain mist wanders according to terrain
Vegetation responds naturally to wind
Clothes and hair naturally affected by wind
Reflections and distant views continuously subtly change
Distant characters and spatial environmental sounds continuously exist
But these environmental elements:
Cannot actively create plot

Cannot help anyone make decisions

Cannot drive conflict resolution
Cannot steal dramatic focus
IV. Plot Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s

Shot Size

Full shot or long shot

Screen Scheduling

Sword Immortal Senior Sister and Junior Sister located in main foreground area

One enemy commander directly ahead

One elder master, two sect disciples, several wounded civilians, small number of enemy soldiers distributed in different depth layers

Geographic relationship clear and stable
Camera restrained and stable, clearly establishing all character relationships and prop positions
Key Props
A ceasefire document
A brush pen

Table or equivalent ancient writing support surface

Plot and Dialogue
Enemy commander unfolds ceasefire document publicly, says:
"Admit defeat, troops stand down tonight. Don't admit, fight again at sunset."

Master answers coldly:

"There is no surrender character under my tutelage."

Same Junior Sister doesn't argue, only silently reaches out to pick up brush pen on table.

Key Point of This Shot

First layer of conflict established between "admitting defeat" and "sect dignity"

Junior Sister picking up brush action must be steady, slow, clear

Let audience begin to anticipate she will make a decision contrary to expectations

Shot 2 | 5–10s
Shot Size
Medium shot or cowboy shot

Continuity Requirements

Keep following content stable throughout:

Same two protagonists

Same clothing

Same ceasefire document

Same brush pen

Completely consistent geographic space
Supporting character positions continuous
Plot and Actions
Junior Sister writes her own name on ceasefire document in front of everyone.
Master suddenly shouts:
"With this stroke, do you know what you leave behind?"

Junior Sister doesn't look up, only answers:

"I know."

Complete pause for half a beat, then drops one sentence:

"Leaving tomorrow."

Same Sword Immortal Senior Sister suddenly reaches out, takes brush pen from her hand.

In this moment, screen must cause clear misjudgment for audience, thinking Senior Sister wants to stop her, or even might scratch out name.

Next second, Senior Sister extremely calmly writes her own name below Junior Sister's name.

Master truly stunned, asks:

"You also admit defeat?"

Senior Sister answers:

"Defeat is ours."

Pause another beat, then says again:

"Name cannot just leave her alone."

Behind shallow depth of field, enemy commander's originally cold hard expression changes noticeably for first time.

Key Point of This Shot

Junior Sister's writing must be decisive, cannot hesitate too much in performance

Senior Sister's snatching brush action must be restrained, creating one clean misleading moment

Double signature is visual establishment point of core reversal in this film

Dramatic focus on "joint responsibility", not "stopping" or "sentimentality"

Shot 3 | 10–15s
Shot Size
Close-up or extreme close-up
Continuity Requirements

Keep following content stable throughout:

Same Senior Sister

Same Junior Sister

Same ceasefire document

Brush, ink traces, long sword and clothing consistent

Supporting character positions and spatial relationships continuous

Plot and Dialogue
Same Junior Sister looks at Senior Sister, lowers voice asking:
"Senior Sister, aren't you afraid of being laughed at by posterity?"
Same White-robed Sword Immortal truly meets her gaze, only answers:
"Afraid."

Completely retain one clean, weighty pause.

Then she shifts gaze to those injured ordinary civilians, only says:

"First let today's people live until posterity."

Ending Actions and Aftermath

Junior Sister's originally constantly tense expression finally extremely lightly relaxes

Enemy commander silently collects signed ceasefire document

He turns and orders soldiers to lower weapons

Same elder master not easily persuaded, nor makes summary

He only after long silence, slowly steps aside one pace

Final Shot Emotion
Finally two women stand side by side:
No victory posture
No shame expression
They lost a nominal win/loss

They actively preserved next day

V. Performance Principles

Sword Immortal Senior Sister
Restrained
Sober
Doesn't shout slogans

Emotions held very steady

True strength reflected in "actively sharing defeat name"

Junior Sister

Front section silently bears pressure
Middle section firm when writing
Back section emotional loosening extremely light
No crying/shouting, no sentimentality, don't act fragile
Master

Intense but restrained

Not pure villain, nor immediately persuaded
His silence and final concession must carry sense of cost
Enemy Commander
First half treats "admitting defeat" as humiliation

Second half realizes for first time opponent is saving lives for more people

Expression changes clear, but cannot steal protagonist spotlight
Group Supporting Cast
Only witnesses

Maintain natural existence in different depth layers

Don't steal dialogue, don't steal camera dominance
VI. Camera and Photography Requirements
16:9 Landscape

Strictly three continuous clear shots

Camera movement stable, restrained, clear
No showing off techniques
Camera serves character relationships and prop logic

Foreground, middle ground, background maintain real parallax

Let audience clearly see brush, ceasefire document, writing, double signature, supporting character reactions

Lighting and Texture
Natural volumetric light
Fine film grain
Stable sharp facial micro-details
Ink traces, paper, silk clothes, metal weapons must have real texture
VII. Sound and Audio-Visual Sync
Must natively synchronize Mandarin dialogue and precisely match lip movements.

Key sounds include:

Brush writing sound
Paper rustling
Ceasefire document being touched and collected sound
Fabric fine sound

Long sword and scabbard slight metal sound

Environmental wind sound, water sound, distant crowd slight movement

Sound Principles:

Environmental sound continuously naturally exists

Doesn't overpower dialogue
Pauses must have real dramatic weight
When signing and collecting ceasefire document, sound should be clear but restrained
VIII. Seedance 2.0 Mini Execution Focus
For Seedance 2.0 Mini, focus on enhancing following four capabilities:
Multi-person visual primary/secondary clear
Subjects always Senior Sister and Junior Sister
Group cast only witnesses and pressure sources

Action design simple and clear
Picking up brush, writing, snatching brush, signing again, collecting document, conceding
Every action must be readable, cannot be ambiguous

Character identity and core prop continuity
Two protagonists' identities stable
Ceasefire document, brush, ink traces, long sword continuous stable
Supporting character positions as stable as possible
Restrained micro-performance and lighting continuity
Complete emotions via eye contact, pauses, breathing, finger subtle changes
Don't rely on exaggerated performance
IX. Strictly Avoid
Screen Issues

blurry

bad quality

low quality

low resolution

noisy
jpeg artifacts

watermark

text
error

deformed

mutated
bad anatomy
poorly drawn hands

bad composition
