prompt:
I. 任务目标

生成一段严格为 15 秒、16:9 横屏、具有电影级写实画质的中国仙侠短片。

整体风格：

纯粹的中国古代仙侠美学
Arri Alexa 电影摄影机质感
稳定清晰的面部微细节
细腻的胶片颗粒感
自然的体积光
成熟的战术悬疑感
克制但持续紧张的情感张力
资深编剧风格的对话，以误导和潜台词驱动
动作设计简单、清晰、易读，符合真实的武术身体逻辑

核心反转：

起初所有人都认为白衣剑仙大师姐将小师妹推出去挡剑是为了逃避决斗。随着剧情推进，观众意识到真正被困住的是敌人。他花了十年时间研究如何击败最著名的白衣剑仙，却从未认真看过一直站在她身边、被所有人轻视的小师妹。

模型使用：

Seedance 2.0 Mini

II. 参考素材使用规则

角色参考

将第 1 张上传的角色参考图片和第 2 张上传的角色参考图片作为两位主角的固定身份锚点。

背景参考

本轮中所有新上传的环境和地点参考图片共同决定一个新的统一环境 DNA。

在正式构图前，静默地重组并统一以下要素：

真实地形

建筑语言
空间尺度
材质
植被
水体
天气
山雾
反射
主光方向
空气深度
为本轮形成一个独特、完整、统一且可信的新空间。

通用环境原则

背景保持持续生动，但在叙事上绝对中立。

自然持久并保持连续性的元素包括：

风

水体
山雾
植被
衣物轻微摆动
反射
远处人影
环境空间音效
这些元素仅负责建立真实世界感，不主动制造冲突、帮助任何一方或决定胜负。

III. 角色设定

角色 ID A | 白衣剑仙大师姐 | 对应第 1 张角色参考图片

始终保持同一人物，不要改变面部、服装或武器：

25-30 岁东亚女性

椭圆白皙脸庞

深杏眼
黑色长发半束
用白玉发簪固定
身材高挑纤细
白色刺绣丝绸汉服
银色腰带
玉佩
白布靴
一把银色长剑
角色气质：
冷静

克制

权威感强
对局势有更深的判断
情感表达极少，但冲击力沉重
角色 ID B | 小师妹 | 对应第 2 张角色参考图片
始终保持同一人物，不要改变面部、服装或武器：

20-25 岁东亚女性

圆润灵动的脸庞

黑发编辫
身材娇小
青蓝色亚麻汉服
深色腰带
木质发簪
黑布鞋
一把深色钢剑
角色气质：
通常被低估

反应敏锐

实战时简单直接
起初略显犹豫，随后迅速坚定
其他角色
一名真正强大的敌手剑客

一名年迈师父

两名门派弟子
若干远处旁观者
其他角色仅负责衬托主线，不抢夺情感中心。
IV. 镜头结构

镜头 1 | 0-5s | “她来了”

景别与镜头运动

远景或全景

克制、稳定的镜头运动

清晰地确立角色站位和空间关系

保持真实的视差
视觉内容
同一名敌手剑客站在两名女子正前方
同一名年迈师父、两名门派弟子和若干远处旁观者仅作为次要人物存在

画面清晰地确立三方对峙关系

对白与表演
敌手直接喊道：
“白衣剑仙，出来。”

同一大师姐站立不动，平静地说：

“她来了。”

同一小师妹瞬间转头：

“我？”

敌手忍不住冷笑：

“用小师妹来挡剑？”

表演重点

大师姐不做解释，无多余动作

小师妹的第一反应应自然、简短，带有一丝惊讶

敌手的语气中包含真正的蔑视

观众必须在这一镜头中被误导，认为大师姐真的把她推了出去
镜头 2 | 5-10s | “所以他只能打败我”
景别与镜头运动
中景或牛仔镜头（Cowboy Shot）

保持与上一镜头完全相同的地理空间

动作和对白必须清晰易读

对白与表演

小师妹盯着大师姐：
“你真的让我去战斗吗？”
大师姐平静回答：

“他已经拆解我的剑谱十年了。”

保持半拍停顿。

小师妹压低声音：

“所以用我来试探他？”

直到这时，大师姐才真正看向她：

“所以他只能打败我。”

场景瞬间寂静。

动作设计

斜向突进

切入敌手盲区

一次清晰的刃口接触

将敌手武器偏出中线

动作要求
所有动作必须简单、迅捷、符合物理逻辑
无花哨
无招式堆砌

武器轨迹必须让观众能够理解

胜利的关键在于敌手对她完全陌生
镜头 3 | 10-15s | “从未计算过她”
景别与镜头运动
特写或大特写
表情、停顿、眼神交流是核心

保持画面稳定，无夸张推拉

视觉内容

敌手失去平衡，单膝跪地

主体仍是三人关系
远处的师父和其他人保持浅景深存在感
对白与表演

敌手首次表现出真正的震惊：

“这是什么剑法？”
小师妹本能地回头看大师姐，像过去一样等待答案。

小师妹短暂停顿，回头看向敌手：

“我不知道。”

敌手僵住：

“你不知道？”

小师妹稳住架势，只回答：

“我只是想到了。”

在大特写中，大师姐克制的表情终于露出一丝微小、真诚的骄傲微笑。

敌手越过小师妹看向大师姐：

“你早就算计好了？”

大师姐直接回答：

“没有。”

保持半拍停顿。

然后重新聚焦于小师妹，说出最后一句台词：

“但他算计了我十年，却从未计算过她一次。”

表演重点

当小师妹说“我只是想到了”时，应自然、直接，不炫耀

大师姐的最后一句台词应平静但极具力量

敌手在这一刻真正意识到自己输在哪里

结尾停留在角色关系和认知反转上，无多余动作

V. 视觉与动作控制原则

摄影
电影写实主义
Arri Alexa 质感
清晰稳定的面部细节

胶片颗粒克制且自然

光线方向稳定

镜头运动干净、连续、可信

动作
少而精
简单清晰
快速易读
每个动作都服务于剧情反转
不允许复杂的炫技

不允许夸张的仙术终极招式

不允许不合逻辑的剑气流
角色调度
大师姐始终掌控局势但不抢走小师妹完成战斗的高光时刻
小师妹从被推出的假象中逐渐站立成为真正的主角
敌手从蔑视，到震惊，再到完全理解自己的盲点
师父和弟子仅负责衬托，不干扰战斗
VI. 声音设计

原生同步普通话对白。

重点增强以下声音：
剑破风声
金属碰撞声

声音要求：

I. Task Objective

Generate a strictly 15-second, 16:9 landscape, cinematic realistic Chinese Xianxia short film.

Overall Style:

Core Twist:

Everyone initially thinks Sword Immortal Senior Sister pushed Junior Sister out to block the sword to avoid the duel. As the plot progresses, the audience realizes the enemy is the one truly trapped. He spent ten years studying how to defeat the most famous White-robed Sword Immortal, but never seriously looked at the Junior Sister who always stood beside her, despised by everyone.

Model Usage:

Seedance 2.0 Mini

II. Reference Usage Rules

Character References

The 1st Character Reference Image and 2nd Character Reference Image in upload order serve as fixed identity anchors for the two protagonists.

Background References

All newly uploaded Environment and Location Reference Images in this round jointly determine a new unified Environment DNA.

Before formal composition, silently reorganize and unify the following content:

Real terrain

Architectural language
Spatial scale
Materials
Vegetation
Water bodies
Weather
Mountain fog
Reflections
Main light direction
Air depth
Form a unique, complete, unified, credible new space for this round.

General Environment Principle

Background remains continuously vivid, but narratively absolutely neutral.

Elements persisting naturally and maintaining coherence include:

Wind

Water bodies
Mountain fog
Vegetation
Slight fabric swaying
Reflections
Distant characters
Spatial ambient sound
These elements only establish a sense of real world, do not actively create conflict, do not help either side, do not decide victory/defeat.

III. Character Settings

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister | Corresponds to 1st Character Reference Image

Always maintain same person, no face/costume/weapon changes:

25-30 year old East Asian female

Oval fair face

Dark almond eyes
Black long hair half-tied
Fixed with white jade hairpin
Tall slender figure
White embroidered silk Hanfu
Silver waist seal
Jade pendant
White cloth boots
Unique silver long sword
Character Temperament:
Calm

Restrained

Strong authority
Deeper judgment of situation
Minimal emotional expression, but weighty
Character ID B | Junior Sister | Corresponds to 2nd Character Reference Image
Always maintain same person, no face/costume/weapon changes:

20-25 year old East Asian female

Round lively face

Black hair braided
Petite figure
Green linen Hanfu
Dark belt

Unique dark steel sword
Character Temperament:
Often underestimated

Sharp reactions

Simple direct when actually acting
Initial slight hesitation, then quickly stands firm
Other Characters
One truly capable enemy swordsman

One elderly Master

Two sect disciples
Several distant witnesses
Other characters only serve to highlight the main line, do not steal emotional center.
IV. Shot Structure

Shot 1 | 0-5s | "She Comes"

Shot Size & Movement

Full shot or long shot

Movement restrained, stable

Establish character positioning and spatial relationships cleanly

Maintain real parallax
Visual Content
Same enemy swordsman stands directly in front of two women
Same elderly Master, two sect disciples, and several distant witnesses exist only as secondary figures

Frame clearly establishes three-way standoff relationship

Dialogue & Performance
Enemy shouts directly:
"White-robed Sword Immortal, come out."

Same Senior Sister stands in place, does not move, only calmly says:

"She comes."

Same Junior Sister instantly turns head:

"Me?"

Enemy can't help sneering:

"Using junior sister to block sword?"

Performance Focus

Senior Sister does not defend, no extra movements

Junior Sister's first reaction must be natural, brief, with a hint of surprise

Enemy's tone contains real contempt

Audience must be misled in this shot, thinking Senior Sister really pushed her out
Shot 2 | 5-10s | "So He Only Knows How to Beat Me"
Shot Size & Movement
Medium shot or cowboy shot

Maintain completely consistent geographic space with previous shot

Actions and dialogue must be clear, easy to read

Dialogue & Performance

Junior Sister stares at Senior Sister:
"You really want me to go up?"
Senior Sister calmly answers:

"He dismantled my sword manual for ten years."

Keep half-beat pause.

Junior Sister lowers voice:

"So testing with me?"

Only then does Senior Sister truly look at her:

"So he only knows how to beat me."

Scene instantly quiet.

Action Design

Immediately after, enemy suddenly draws sword.

Enemy uses a mature counter-action set obviously prepared for years, specifically restraining Senior Sister's habitual sword path.

Junior Sister does not use complex big moves, only completes a group of simple, fast, clear actions:

Diagonal advance

Cut into enemy blind spot

One clear blade contact

Push enemy weapon away from center line

Action Requirements
All actions must be simple, quick, physically reasonable
No flashiness
No stacking moves

Weapon trajectories must be understandable to audience

Key to victory/defeat must come from enemy being completely unfamiliar with her
Shot 3 | 10-15s | "Never Calculated Her Once"
Shot Size & Movement
Close-up or extreme close-up
Expressions, pauses, eye-line relationships are core

Keep frame stable, no exaggerated push/pull

Visual Content

Enemy loses balance, lands on one knee

Subject remains three-person relationship
Distant Master and others maintain shallow depth of field presence
Dialogue & Performance

Enemy shows genuine shock for first time:

"What sword technique is this?"
Junior Sister instinctively looks back at Senior Sister, waiting for answer as before.
Senior Sister says nothing.

Junior Sister pauses briefly, looks back at enemy:

"I don't know."

Enemy stunned:

"Don't know?"

Junior Sister stabilizes her stance, answers simply:

"I just thought of it."

In extreme close-up, Senior Sister's restrained expression finally shows a tiny, truly proud smile.

Enemy looks past Junior Sister at Senior Sister:

"You calculated this early?"

Senior Sister answers directly:

"No."

Keep half-beat pause.

Then refocuses gaze on Junior Sister, delivering final line:

"But he calculated me for ten years, never calculated her once."

Performance Focus

When Junior Sister says "I just thought of it", must be natural, direct, no showing off

Senior Sister's last line must be calm, but extremely powerful

Enemy only realizes where he lost at this moment

Ending stays on character relationship and cognitive flip, no extra actions

V. Visual and Action Control Principles

Character Blocking

Junior Sister gradually becomes true protagonist from illusion of being pushed out
Enemy goes from contempt, to shock, to fully understanding his blind spot

VI. Sound Design

prompt:
Create a 25-second cinematic AI music video / music MV with a clear short musical story.

STYLE:
High-end cinematic pop music video, emotional but modern, photorealistic, realistic human movement, natural facial expressions, dramatic night lighting, beautiful neon city atmosphere, professional music-video cinematography, smooth camera movements, realistic physics, consistent character identity throughout the entire video.

MAIN CHARACTER:
A beautiful young female singer with long dark hair, expressive eyes, natural realistic face, subtle makeup, elegant modern black outfit, confident but emotional personality. Keep exactly the same face, hairstyle, body proportions and outfit throughout every scene.

MUSIC:
Create an original emotional modern pop song with a cinematic beat.
Female vocal, soft emotional singing at the beginning, gradually building into a catchy powerful chorus.
Modern pop production with atmospheric synths, soft piano, subtle drums and a strong beat drop near the middle.
The music should feel emotional, cinematic and memorable.

VOCAL / LYRICS:

0–5 seconds:
Soft female singing:
"One more night, I call your name..."

5–11 seconds:
The beat slowly builds while she sings:
"Running through the memories,
nothing feels the same..."

11–19 seconds:
Beat becomes stronger and she sings the main chorus with emotion:
"But I'm still here, I'm still alive,
leaving yesterday behind."

19–25 seconds:
Music becomes instrumental and emotional.
No additional lyrics.
End with a beautiful cinematic musical outro.

STORY AND VISUALS:

SCENE 1 — 0–5 SEC:
Rainy neon city at night.
The female singer walks alone down a beautiful empty street.
Wet pavement reflects colorful city lights.
She looks emotional but calm.
Camera starts with a cinematic wide shot and slowly moves toward her face.
She looks into the camera and softly sings:
"One more night, I call your name..."
Natural lip-sync matching the lyrics.
Rain falling naturally, realistic reflections, cinematic depth of field.

SCENE 2 — 5–11 SEC:
She continues walking through the glowing city.
As she sings:
"Running through the memories, nothing feels the same..."
Show quick cinematic memory flashes around her:
warm sunlight, laughing, walking through a beautiful location, then the memories disappear.
Use smooth transitions between memories and reality.
Camera moves around her in a slow 180-degree cinematic motion.
Her expression becomes more emotional.
Perfect lip-sync.

SCENE 3 — 11–15 SEC:
The beat suddenly becomes stronger.
She enters an empty subway station and walks toward the camera.
Lights flicker subtly with the beat.
Camera tracks backward smoothly as she sings:
"But I'm still here..."
Her expression changes from sadness to confidence.
Realistic walking, natural hair movement and realistic clothing physics.

SCENE 4 — 15–19 SEC:
She reaches a rooftop overlooking the city skyline.
The wind blows her hair and clothes dynamically.
She sings the chorus line:
"I'm still alive, leaving yesterday behind."
Cinematic wide shot showing the vast city lights below.

SCENE 5 — 19–25 SEC:
Instrumental outro.
The singer stands silhouetted against the bright city lights.
Slow zoom out revealing the full scale of the neon metropolis.
Fade to black with lingering atmospheric sound.

激活（1-4.5 秒）：轻声说出“Berubah!”。当手指触及水面时，圆形电磁脉冲向外爆发。紫色粒子涌动，空气颤抖。镜头以第一人称视角冲出水面，沿着手指、手臂和躯干移动，发光的脉冲图案层层攀爬身体。眼睛燃起白紫色光芒，紫色烟雾从眼眶中渗出，机械系统在开裂的皮肤下苏醒。空气向内弯曲，形成涟漪状冲击波。

撕裂（4.5-9.5 秒）：镜头略微拉回，展现一只外星昆虫从背后攻击。深红色裂纹蔓延全身，紫色液体能量渗出。黑色雾气伴随着细微的电弧爆发，衣物从内部撕裂燃烧。

变形与战斗（9.5-13 秒）：装甲板伴随着紫色闪光和冲击波猛烈地扣合在身体上。主角格挡住一把刀，旋转踢出一记扫腿，将敌人撕裂；绿色液体和黑色雾气四散。头盔形成，带有发光的复眼，有些像故障单元一样闪烁。战斗依然残酷而近身：骨折般的打击，缠斗，最终主角捏碎了生物的喉咙，直到它化为黑雾消散。

结局（13-15 秒）：镜头环绕到前方并缓慢拉远。主角在荒凉的湖畔环境中大口喘息。定格三秒。无对话，无爆炸。

prompt:
Create a 30-second premium cinematic advertisement centered around a powerful heavy motorcycle and a striking adult female rider.

The film should initially feel like a serious, high-budget cinematic action thriller — NOT a motorcycle commercial.

For the first 20 seconds, create mystery and tension. The audience should wonder where she is going, what she is searching for, and why she is riding alone through such a dangerous environment.

The motorcycle should feel heavy, powerful, expensive and mechanically realistic.

The story should naturally build from:

MYSTERY → PURSUIT → DANGER → DESTINATION → REVEAL → HERO PRODUCT

Do NOT copy any existing advertisement, film, commercial, character, composition, scene or visual sequence. Create an entirely original story.

VISUAL STYLE

Photorealistic cinematic filmmaking.

Premium high-budget automotive commercial production.

Large-format cinema look with 35mm anamorphic photography.

Deep cinematic contrast, natural skin texture, realistic motorcycle materials, metal, leather, glass and rubber.

Realistic engine vibration, suspension movement and mechanical motion.

Subtle film grain, natural motion blur and realistic environmental lighting.

No cartoon appearance.
No generic AI aesthetic.
The motorcycle must remain physically believable and visually consistent throughout the entire film.

Use dramatic wide landscapes contrasted with intimate close-ups.

The color palette begins cold and desaturated and gradually transitions into rich, warm golden tones toward the final reveal.

MAIN CHARACTER

A strikingly beautiful adult woman in her late 20s.

Dark flowing hair naturally tucked beneath a premium black motorcycle helmet.

Confident, focused expression.

Natural makeup.

She wears a fitted black leather motorcycle jacket, dark riding pants, black gloves and realistic protective riding boots.

Her appearance, clothing, helmet and motorcycle remain perfectly consistent throughout the entire film.

She should look like a real professional rider, not a fashion model posing on a motorcycle.

MOTORCYCLE

A massive premium heavy motorcycle.

Muscular proportions.

Large engine.

Wide rear tire.

Heavy metallic frame.

Premium black and brushed-metal finishes.

Realistic suspension movement.

Visible engine vibration.

Powerful headlight.

Subtle reflections across the fuel tank.

The motorcycle should feel extremely powerful but elegant.

Keep the exact motorcycle design consistent throughout every shot.

SCENE 1 — THE UNKNOWN ROAD

0–5 SECONDS

EXTREME WIDE CINEMATIC SHOT.

A gigantic empty mountain road disappears into dense fog.

Cold early-morning atmosphere.

Wind moves across the landscape.

Nothing else is visible.

A distant engine roar slowly grows louder.

A heavy motorcycle suddenly emerges from the fog.

The female rider sits completely steady as the enormous machine moves through the empty road.

Camera gradually moves closer.

CUT TO an extreme close-up of her eyes inside the helmet.

Focused. Unemotional.

She looks toward something far ahead.

Her hand subtly tightens around the throttle.

The engine note rises.

Transition naturally into the next shot while maintaining continuous motion and sound.

SCENE 2 — THE PURSUIT

5–10 SECONDS

Rapid cinematic sequence.

The motorcycle accelerates through a winding mountain road.

Low camera almost touching the asphalt.

The rear tire throws tiny particles of water from the wet road.

Close-up of her gloved hand twisting the throttle.

The engine responds with a deep mechanical roar.

Close-up of her boot shifting naturally through the gear.

Close-up of the speedometer climbing.

Wide aerial-style shot:

The tiny motorcycle cuts through an enormous mountain landscape.

She suddenly checks her rear-view mirror.

Something appears to be following her in the far distance, but it is never clearly revealed.

Music intensifies.

She accelerates harder.

Maintain continuous visual flow between shots with no black frames or unnecessary transitions.

SCENE 3 — THE DANGER

10–16 SECONDS

The weather suddenly becomes violent.

Heavy rain begins.

Lightning briefly illuminates the mountains.

The road narrows dramatically beside a massive cliff.

The rider slows.

A large fallen tree partially blocks the road.

She stops.

For a moment, everything becomes quiet except the motorcycle idling in the rain.

She looks at the obstacle.

Then notices a narrow dirt path disappearing into the dark forest.

A subtle confident smile.

She turns the handlebars.

The heavy motorcycle leaves the paved road.

The massive tires crush wet gravel.

Mud and water splash naturally around the wheels.

The camera follows closely as she enters the forest.

She disappears deeper into the darkness.

SCENE 4 — THE DESTINATION

16–21 SECONDS

The dark forest suddenly opens.

The motorcycle emerges onto a spectacular mountain overlook.

The storm has cleared.

Golden sunlight breaks through the clouds.

The entire visual atmosphere transforms from cold and desaturated into rich, warm cinematic tones.

The rider slowly stops.

She removes her helmet.

Her dark hair falls naturally around her shoulders.

She looks toward the enormous horizon.

For the first time, the mystery becomes clear:

She wasn't running from anything.

She was searching for this place.

She walks toward the edge of the overlook.

Then slowly turns back toward the motorcycle.

SCENE 5 — THE MOTORCYCLE REVEAL

21–26 SECONDS

The music drops into a restrained, almost silent moment.

The camera begins a slow, elegant cinematic orbit around the motorcycle.

Golden sunlight glides across the metallic bodywork.

Show beautiful macro details through fluid transitions:

Engine components.

Brushed-metal frame.

Fuel tank reflections.

Headlight.

Leather seat.

Brake assembly.

Wide rear tire.

Suspension.

Small mechanical vibrations are visible while the engine idles.

The rider sits back on the motorcycle.

She starts the engine.

A deep, powerful mechanical sound fills the mountain landscape.

She gives the throttle one controlled twist.

VOICEOVER:

“Some roads aren't meant to be easy.”

Brief pause.

“They're meant to be remembered.”

No text appears on screen during the story.

SCENE 6 — FINAL HERO SHOT

26–30 SECONDS

Ultra-premium cinematic hero shot.

The woman sits confidently on the heavy motorcycle at the edge of the mountain overlook.

Golden sunset behind her.

Wind moves her hair and leather jacket naturally.

The motorcycle dominates the foreground.

The camera slowly pushes toward the front headlight.

The headlight switches on.

Hold for a powerful final composition.

Only now introduce minimal elegant typography:

BUILT FOR THE ROAD.

After a brief beat, reveal the motorcycle brand name beneath it.

Final sound:

ONE DEEP ENGINE REV.

CUT TO BLACK ONLY AT THE VERY END.

variants.text:
创作一支 30 秒的高端电影级广告，核心围绕一辆强大的重型摩托车和一位引人注目的成年女性骑手。

影片初期应呈现出严肃、高预算的电影动作惊悚片质感——而非传统的摩托车商业广告。

在前 20 秒内，营造神秘感与紧张氛围。观众应好奇她要去哪里，她在寻找什么，以及为何独自骑行穿越如此危险的环境。

摩托车需显得沉重、强劲、昂贵且机械结构真实可信。

故事应自然地从以下阶段推进：

神秘 → 追逐 → 危险 → 目的地 → 揭示 → 英雄产品

切勿复制任何现有的广告、电影、商业短片、角色、构图、场景或视觉序列。请创作一个完全原创的故事。

视觉风格

照片级真实的电影制作。

高端高预算的汽车商业广告制作水准。

采用大幅面电影外观，使用 35mm 变形宽银幕摄影。

深邃的电影对比度，自然的皮肤纹理，真实的摩托车材质（金属、皮革、玻璃和橡胶）。

真实的引擎振动、悬挂运动和机械动态。

细微的胶片颗粒感、自然的运动模糊和逼真的环境光照。

无卡通外观。
无通用的 AI 美学风格。
在整个影片中，摩托车必须保持物理上的可信度和视觉一致性。

使用戏剧性的广阔景观与亲密的特写镜头形成对比。

色调起初寒冷且去饱和，随着最终揭示逐渐过渡为丰富、温暖的金色调。

主要角色

一位在 20 多岁后期、极具魅力的成年女性。

深色飘逸的头发自然地收拢在高端黑色摩托车头盔下。

自信、专注的表情。

自然的妆容。

她穿着合身的黑色皮革摩托车夹克、深色骑行裤、黑色手套和逼真的防护骑行靴。

她的外貌、服装、头盔和摩托车在整个影片中保持完美一致。

她看起来应该像一名真正的专业骑手，而不是在摩托车上摆姿势的时尚模特。

摩托车

一辆巨大的高端重型摩托车。

肌肉感十足的尺寸比例。

大排量引擎。

宽大的后轮胎。

沉重的金属车架。

高端黑色和拉丝金属饰面。

真实的悬挂运动。

可见的引擎振动。

强大的前大灯。

油箱上微妙的反射。

摩托车应感觉极其强大但优雅。

在每个镜头中保持完全一致的摩托车设计。

场景 1 — 未知的道路

0–5 秒

极远景电影镜头。

一条巨大的空旷山路消失在浓雾中。

寒冷的清晨氛围。

风掠过景观。

除此之外什么都看不见。

远处引擎的轰鸣声逐渐变大。

一辆重型摩托车突然从雾中出现。

女骑手坐得稳如泰山，巨大的机器在空荡的道路上移动。

摄像机逐渐靠近。

切至她头盔内眼睛的极端特写。

专注。毫无情绪波动。

她望向远方某处。

她的手微妙地收紧油门。

引擎音调升高。

在保持连续运动和声音的同时，自然过渡到下一个镜头。

场景 2 — 追逐

5–10 秒

快速电影序列。

摩托车加速穿过蜿蜒的山路。

低角度摄像机几乎触及沥青路面。

后轮胎从湿滑的路面上溅起微小的水珠。

她戴着手套的手扭转油门的特写。

引擎以深沉的机械轰鸣回应。

她的靴子自然换挡的特写。

速度表攀升的特写。

广角航拍风格镜头：

小小的摩托车切入巨大的山地景观中。

她突然查看后视镜。

远处似乎有什么东西在跟踪她，但从未清晰揭示。

音乐增强。

她更用力地加速。

保持镜头之间连续的视觉流动，无黑帧或不必要的转场。

场景 3 — 危险

10–16 秒

天气突然变得恶劣。

大雨开始落下。

闪电短暂照亮山脉。

道路在巨大悬崖旁急剧变窄。

骑手减速。

一棵倒下的大树部分阻挡了道路。

她停下。

片刻间，除了雨中摩托车的怠速声外，一切归于寂静。

她看着障碍物。

然后注意到一条消失黑暗森林中的狭窄土路。

一丝自信的微妙微笑。

她转动车把。

重型摩托车离开铺装路面。

巨大的轮胎碾过湿润的碎石。

泥水和雨水在车轮周围自然飞溅。

摄像机紧随其后，看着她进入森林。

她消失在更深的黑暗中。

场景 4 — 目的地

16–21 秒

黑暗的森林突然开阔。

摩托车驶出一处壮观的山顶观景台。

风暴已停。

金色的阳光穿透云层。

整个视觉氛围从寒冷去饱和转变为丰富、温暖的电影色调。

骑手慢慢停下。

她摘下头盔。

她的深色头发自然地垂落在肩膀周围。

她望向巨大的地平线。

第一次，谜底揭晓：

她不是在逃避什么。

她是在寻找这个地方。

她走向观景台的边缘。

然后慢慢转身回到摩托车旁。

场景 5 — 摩托车揭示

21–26 秒

音乐降至克制、近乎寂静的时刻。

摄像机开始围绕摩托车进行缓慢、优雅的电影式环绕拍摄。

金色的阳光滑过金属车身。

通过流畅的转场展示美丽的微距细节：

引擎部件。

拉丝金属车架。

油箱反射。

前大灯。

皮革座椅。

制动组件。

宽后轮胎。

悬挂系统。

引擎怠速时可见微小的机械振动。

骑手重新坐上摩托车。

她启动引擎。

深沉有力的机械声充满山地景观。

她给油门一次受控的拧动。

画外音：

“有些路并非为了轻松而行。”

短暂停顿。

“它们是为了被铭记。”

故事期间屏幕上不出现文字。

场景 6 — 最终英雄镜头

26–30 秒

超高端电影英雄镜头。

女人自信地坐在山顶观景台边缘的重型摩托车上。

身后是金色的日落。

风自然地吹动她的头发和皮夹克。

摩托车占据前景主导地位。

摄像机缓慢推向车头大灯。

大灯亮起。

保持强有力的最终构图。

直到此刻才引入极简优雅的排版：

BUILT FOR THE ROAD.

短暂节奏后，在其下方揭示摩托车品牌名称。

最终音效：

一声深沉的引擎轰鸣。

仅在最后切至黑屏。

prompt:
**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on the floor or a mat for hands-free core shots. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — genuine strain mixed with humor, complaining about core work while still pushing through it. Quick handheld cuts, energy staying light and funny throughout rather than fully exhausted.

**Character**

CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers or fitted leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers off or socks, no jewelry.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening — mirror wall nearby, water bottle on the floor, soft overhead lighting, other equipment visible in the background.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 cuts)**

1. *(~2.5s, propped camera, medium shot)* She lies down on the mat, propping up on her elbows, already sighing dramatically. CHASE: "Okay, core day — my least favorite day."

2. *(~2.5s, propped camera, plank position)* She holds a plank, arms shaking slightly, talking through gritted teeth. CHASE (strained): "Why does this get harder every single time—"

3. *(~2.5s, medium propped shot, crunches)* She moves into a set of crunches, breathing hard, complaining between reps. CHASE: "Nobody warns you how much this actually burns."

4. *(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF)* Close-up on her hands gripping the mat edges during a leg raise, abs visibly working. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.

5. *(~2.5s, handheld, leg raises)* She finishes a slow leg raise set, flopping back onto the mat immediately after, laughing at herself. CHASE (breathless): "Okay— that's it, I'm done—"

6. *(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish)* Still lying on the mat, she lifts the camera above her face, grinning tiredly. CHASE: "Core day never gets easier — see you guys tomorrow, hopefully."

prompt:

Hundreds of tiny realistic adult workers are visible continuously, working simultaneously with tools, ladders, ropes, carts and miniature cranes. Fast but readable construction, macro cinematic photography, natural sunlight, realistic wood, stone, soil, moss and vegetation, 4K HDR, live-action realism.

0–2s: Workers clear the ground, mark foundations and dig around the giant tree roots.

2–4s: Foundation stones and wooden floor beams are placed; workers erect the first timber posts.

4–6s: Wall panels, floorboards and support beams are assembled piece-by-piece.

6–8s: Workers lift rafters, build pitched roofs and place wooden shingles one-by-one.

8–10s: Teams climb the trunk and construct elevated platforms around the massive branches.

10–12s: Treehouses rise as workers install walls, windows, doors, balconies and roofs.

12–14s: Workers build wooden bridges and spiral staircases connecting the treehouses.

14–16s: More cottages are physically constructed outward from the giant tree, foundation-to-roof.

16–18s: Hundreds of workers lay stone pathways, fences and a small wooden stream bridge.

18–20s: A marketplace is assembled beneath the tree with stalls, counters and storage huts.

20–22s: Higher platforms, balconies and connected treehouses expand through the branches.

22–24s: Workers install railings, ladders, rope bridges, lantern posts and flower boxes.

24–26s: Teams place stones, plant flowers and trees, create gardens and finish winding paths.

26–28s: Final construction details are secured while hundreds of workers continue moving materials and working across the entire village.

28–30s: Golden-hour reveal. Tiny villagers cross bridges and paths as the camera smoothly pulls backward and rises, revealing the enormous ancient tree surrounded by the completed multi-level village.

KEY RULE: Every 2 seconds introduces a NEW visible construction stage while previous teams continue working. Buildings must visibly progress foundation → beams → walls → roof → details. No instant completion.

NEGATIVE: cartoon, toy, plastic, CGI look, magical construction, instant appearance, morphing, teleportation, floating objects, disappearing materials, duplicated workers, giant humans, children, anatomy glitches, changing tree, inconsistent architecture, empty scenes, text, logos, watermark.

prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic cinematic action video featuring Elsa.

Use the provided Elsa Master Character Set only as the strict identity reference for Elsa. Use the provided 20-panel Master Storyboard as the exact visual and chronological guide for the entire video.

Do not copy any identity from the storyboard. The storyboard controls the action, shot progression, locations, framing and choreography, while the Master Character Set controls Elsa's face and physical identity.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
Preserve Elsa's exact facial identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions and recognizable appearance throughout the entire video.

Keep her outfit consistent: black cropped top, fitted black pants, black leather jacket, black boots and a black shoulder bag.

The same Elsa must appear in every shot.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic live-action cinematic action sequence set inside a modern underground subway corridor.

The environment should feel real and lived-in: tiled walls, fluorescent ceiling lights, concrete floors, distant commuters, signage, subway entrances and realistic urban details.

Use cinematic handheld camera work combined with controlled action cinematography.

Natural motion blur, realistic lighting, realistic shadows, physically accurate movement and believable human reactions.

No fantasy powers, no supernatural effects, no exaggerated wire-fu and no impossible movements.

ACTION:
Keep the confrontation clearly fictional and choreographed for cinematic storytelling. Avoid graphic injury, blood or gore.

SHOT 1 — 00:00–00:01
Elsa walks alone through the subway corridor carrying her shoulder bag.

Use a medium-wide tracking shot from the front as commuters move naturally in the background.

SHOT 2 — 00:01–00:02
Cut to a closer side angle as Elsa senses movement behind her.

She slightly turns her head and looks over her shoulder.

Her expression becomes alert but controlled.

SHOT 3 — 00:02–00:03
Reveal several suspicious figures approaching from behind.

Use a longer lens perspective that compresses the corridor and creates tension.

SHOT 4 — 00:03–00:04
Close-up on Elsa's face.

She notices the situation and remains calm and focused.

Use shallow depth of field with the subway corridor softly blurred behind her.

SHOT 5 — 00:04–00:05
Elsa turns into a narrower side passage.

The camera follows quickly behind her as the atmosphere becomes more confined.

SHOT 6 — 00:05–00:06
The figures block Elsa's path.

Use a frontal medium shot showing Elsa surrounded by the group while maintaining clear spatial geography.

SHOT 7 — 00:06–00:08
One attacker reaches toward Elsa's arm.

Elsa reacts immediately, pulling her arm away and creating distance.

Use a dynamic side angle with realistic body mechanics.

SHOT 8 — 00:08–00:09
Elsa performs a quick defensive movement to escape the grab.

Keep the choreography controlled and realistic.

The camera moves with the action rather than using exaggerated effects.

SHOT 9 — 00:09–00:11
A second attacker moves toward her.

Elsa pivots out of the way and uses a controlled defensive counter, causing the attacker to lose balance and fall safely.

Use a wider shot so the complete movement is readable.

SHOT 10 — 00:11–00:12
Elsa creates space between herself and the attackers.

Her shoulder bag swings naturally with the movement.

Use a fast handheld camera adjustment.

SHOT 11 — 00:12–00:14
An attacker moves toward Elsa again.

Elsa uses the shoulder bag defensively to create distance and escape the immediate threat.

Do not depict graphic impact.

SHOT 12 — 00:14–00:15
Elsa performs a fast controlled kick that stops the attacker's advance.

Use a low three-quarter angle emphasizing the movement while keeping realistic proportions.

SHOT 13 — 00:15–00:17
Another attacker approaches.

Elsa quickly changes direction, evades the incoming movement and performs a controlled defensive strike.

Use a dynamic tracking camera.

SHOT 14 — 00:17–00:18
Close action beat as Elsa completes the defensive sequence and creates separation.

Keep the movement realistic and clearly choreographed.

SHOT 15 — 00:18–00:20
Wide shot of the corridor.

The attackers are now on the ground or backing away while Elsa remains standing and composed.

No blood, wounds or graphic injury.

SHOT 16 — 00:20–00:22
The tension disappears.

Elsa calmly fixes her hair and adjusts her jacket.

Use a close-up that contrasts her calm expression with the action that just occurred.

SHOT 17 — 00:22–00:24
Elsa picks up and adjusts her shoulder bag.

Use a medium close-up with natural handheld movement.

SHOT 18 — 00:24–00:27
Elsa walks confidently down the subway corridor.

The camera tracks backward in front of her.

Commuters naturally move through the background.

SHOT 19 — 00:27–00:29
Elsa approaches the subway exit stairs.

Use a rear tracking shot as she walks toward the brighter exit.

The lighting gradually becomes warmer and brighter.

SHOT 20 — 00:29–00:30
Before leaving, Elsa briefly turns her head and looks back toward the camera with a calm, confident expression.

Hold for a short cinematic beat.

Cut to black.

CAMERA LANGUAGE:
Use a mixture of wide establishing shots, handheld tracking shots, close facial shots, side angles, low three-quarter angles and dynamic action framing.

Every camera movement should be motivated by the action.

Use short speed ramps only where they naturally emphasize an important movement. Do not overuse slow motion.

Maintain clear spatial continuity so the viewer always understands where Elsa and the other characters are positioned.

PHYSICS & CONTINUITY:
Realistic human anatomy and movement.
Realistic weight transfer.
Natural hair and clothing movement.
Natural shoulder-bag physics.
Realistic footsteps and body momentum.
No teleportation.
No duplicated characters.
No disappearing props.
No impossible body deformation.

AUDIO:
Authentic subway ambience throughout.

Footsteps, distant train sounds, station announcements, ventilation, commuters talking, clothing movement, bag movement and subtle action impacts.

Music should be minimal and cinematic, building tension during the confrontation and becoming quieter as Elsa walks toward the exit.

No dialogue.
No subtitles.
No text overlays.
No logos.
No watermark.

FINAL LOOK:
Premium ultra-realistic live-action action cinema with believable choreography, strong visual continuity and a grounded urban atmosphere.

The sequence should feel tense, stylish and cinematic while remaining physically realistic and non-graphic.

prompt:
电影级写实质感，16:9 横屏，15 秒现代中国都市情感剧，原生同步普通话对白，无字幕。核心并非指责男性角色，而是让师妹自行意识到：那个反复为你收拾烂摊子的人，并不天然等同于安全感；如果许多麻烦也与这段关系有关，那么“被照顾”可能正慢慢变成“只能依赖他”。

整体采用 Arri Alexa 电影摄影机质感，可信的现代住宅走廊，真实顶灯与电梯区域的混合照明，自然肤色，稳定清晰的面部微表情细节，轻微胶片颗粒感，浅景深。情绪尖锐但克制，无口号式台词，无短剧式歇斯底里，不安排任何角色突然黑化。

严格三个连续镜头，每个约 5 秒。针对 Seedance 2.0 Mini，所有复杂性集中在三人的眼神、停顿、简单动作，以及一个行李箱、一部碎屏手机；不要设计复杂的肢体冲突。

角色身份严格锁定。

角色 ID A：始终为 @Image1 中相同的成年东亚女性，27–32 岁，高挑纤细。严格保留参考图中的面部特征、脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色及整体气质。现代造型：象牙白衬衫，深灰色长裤，黑色皮鞋，银色腕表。她是师姐型角色，冷静，有判断力，但不替他人做决定。

角色 ID B：始终为 @Image2 中相同的成年东亚女性，22–26 岁，身形较小。严格保留参考图中的面部特征、脸型、发型及角色气质。现代造型：青绿色针织上衣，宽松深色长裤，白色运动鞋。她身旁始终放着同一个行李箱，手中拿着同一部碎屏手机。

男友：约 27–28 岁，穿着整洁的深色大衣。外貌和行为必须真实普通，不油腻，不刻板凶狠。他真心认为自己一直在保护她，因此他的反应源于误解和防御，而非纯粹的恶意。

00:00—00:05
第一个镜头，35mm 广角至中景，一次性清晰建立住宅走廊的空间关系。
师妹站在行李箱旁，手持碎屏手机。男友站在她和师姐之间，三人之间有明确距离。

男友压抑情绪，声音不高：
“哪次出事，不是我陪着你？”

师妹几乎本能地回答：
“他说得对。”

师姐不看男友，只看师妹：
“我知道。”

极短暂的停顿。
“但为什么总是你出事？”
这句话后，保持半秒沉默。
师妹第一次僵住。
不要震惊地瞪大眼睛，只是停止目光接触，原本准备继续为男友解释的话没有说出口。

00:05—00:10
第二个镜头，50mm 中近景，三人仍保持完全相同的空间关系，道具不能漂移。

男友立即转向师姐：
“别挑事。”

师姐依然不与他争辩，只平静地看着师妹说：
“工作，房东，朋友。”
每个词之间有轻微停顿。
然后补充一句：
“每次，他都在。”

男友立即跟进：
“因为我在帮她。”

师姐看着他，语气没有攻击性：
“也许吧。”
短暂停顿。
“但为什么最后只剩下你一个？”
这句话落下后，不加任何解释。
不配合夸张的音乐重音。
只留下住宅走廊轻微的底噪和一声远处的电梯提示音。
师妹缓缓低头看向手中的碎屏手机。
这是她第一次自己将之前的事件联系起来。

00:10—00:15
第三个镜头，85mm 特写逐渐聚焦于师妹。

她缓缓抬眼看向男友，没有哭泣，没有愤怒，也不向师姐寻求确认。
她问自己：
“你是在帮我……”
停顿约 0.3 秒。
“还是让我只能找到你？”
完全寂静。
男友显然想回答，嘴唇微动，但组织不出语言。
师姐绝不表现出胜利、满意或“我早就知道”的表情，且绝对不可伸手引导师妹离开。
师妹弯腰自己拉起行李箱。
男友下意识地问：
“你要去哪？”
她瞥了他一眼，平静地回答：
“我想一个人待会儿。”
然后拖着行李箱，独自从两人身边走过。
师姐只是侧身，真正让出通道。
最后，不要跟拍师姐，不要在男友脸上停留。
镜头停在师妹拖着行李箱走向走廊尽头的背影上，轮声渐弱，电梯灯亮起，结束。

全片表演原则：无赢家，无反派定性，无情绪爆发。师姐只提出一个问题；男友仍认为自己在照顾她；真正完成判断的人必须是师妹自己。
对白必须听起来像真实成年人在争吵时会说的话，短句，口语化，避免文学腔、金句风格、心理学术语和短剧式呐喊。当所有角色说话时，其他人必须闭嘴并有真实的倾听反应。普通话口型同步准确，视线目标清晰。
严格保持三镜头结构：
0—5s：建立“他总是救她”
5—10s：初步意识“为什么他总在场”
10—15s：她自己提出问题并独自离开

声音设计：住宅空调低频，电梯提示音，织物摩擦声，握持碎屏手机的声音，行李箱轮声需真实同步。背景音乐极弱甚至缺失，让最后的轮声成为情感的收束。
角色面部、发型、服装、碎屏手机、行李箱、走廊门位置、电梯方向以及三人空间位置必须持续保持稳定。禁止角色身份漂移、道具消失、随机位置交换、多人视线错误，以及男友突然变得具有攻击性。
负面提示：模糊，低质量，低分辨率，噪点，jpeg 伪影，水印，文字，字幕，畸形手，多余手指，角色不一致，面部变形，身份漂移，换衣服，行李箱消失，手机变化，修复的手机屏幕，背景偏移，不稳定的走廊，瞬移，随机角色位置，错误的视线方向，重叠对话，口型不同步，夸张哭泣，尖叫，攻击性男性刻板印象，反派表情，得意的年长女性，胜利表情，戏剧化表演，肥皂剧式表演，舞台式停顿，励志演讲，治疗术语，过度的音乐提示，故障剪辑，随机镜头运动。

variants.text:
Cinematic realistic texture, 16:9 horizontal screen, 15-second modern Chinese urban relationship drama, native synchronized Mandarin dialogue, no subtitles. The core is not to accuse a male character, but to make the junior sister realize on her own: the person who repeatedly cleans up your messes is not naturally equal to security; if many of those messes are also related to this relationship, then "being cared for" may slowly be turning into "only being able to rely on him."

Overall adopt an Arri Alexa cinema camera texture, credible modern residential corridor, mixed lighting from real ceiling lights and elevator area, natural skin tones, stable sharp facial micro-details, slight film grain, shallow depth of field. Emotions are sharp but restrained, no slogans, no short-drama-style hysteria, no arrangement for any character to suddenly turn dark.

Strictly three consecutive shots, each about 5 seconds. For Seedance 2.0 Mini, all complexity is concentrated on the gazes, pauses, simple movements of the three people, and one suitcase, one cracked-screen phone; do not design complex physical conflicts.

Character identities strictly locked.

Character ID A: Always the same adult East Asian female as in @Image1, 27–32 years old, tall and slender. Strictly preserve the facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall temperament from the reference image. Modern styling: ivory white shirt, dark gray trousers, black leather shoes, silver wristwatch. She is a senior sister type character, calm, judgmental, but does not make decisions for others.

Character ID B: Always the same adult East Asian female as in @Image2, 22–26 years old, smaller build. Strictly preserve the facial features, face shape, hairstyle, and character temperament from the reference image. Modern styling: cyan-green knit top, loose dark trousers, white sneakers. She always has the same suitcase beside her and holds the same cracked-screen phone in her hand.

Boyfriend: Around 27–28 years old, wearing a clean dark coat. Appearance and behavior must be real and ordinary, not greasy, not stereotypically fierce. He truly believes he has been protecting her, so his reactions come from misunderstanding and defense, rather than pure malice.

00:00—00:05
First shot, 35mm wide to medium shot, clearly establishing the spatial relationship of the residential corridor at once.
The junior sister stands next to the suitcase, holding the cracked-screen phone. The boyfriend stands between her and the senior sister, with clear distance among the three.

The boyfriend suppresses emotions, voice not high:
"Which time when something happened, wasn't it me accompanying you?"

The junior sister almost instinctively replies:
"He's right."

The senior sister does not look at the boyfriend, only looks at the junior sister:
"I know."

Pause extremely briefly.
"But why do things always happen to you?"
After this sentence, maintain half a second of silence.
The junior sister freezes for the first time.
Do not shockingly widen eyes, just stop the gaze, the words originally prepared to continue explaining for the boyfriend are not spoken out.

00:05—00:10
Second shot, 50mm medium close-up, the three people still maintain exactly the same spatial relationship, props cannot drift.

The boyfriend immediately turns to the senior sister:
"Don't stir things up."

The senior sister still does not argue with him, only calmly looks at the junior sister and says:
"Work, landlord, friends."
Slight pauses between each word.
Then adds one sentence:
"Every time, he was there."

The boyfriend immediately follows up:
"Because I am helping her."

The senior sister looks at him, tone without aggression:
"Maybe."
Pause briefly.
"But why are you the only one left in the end?"
After this sentence falls, do not add any explanation.
Do not match with exaggerated musical accents.
Only leave the slight ambient sound of the residential corridor and one distant elevator chime.
The junior sister slowly lowers her head to look at the cracked-screen phone in her hand.
This is the first time she connects the previous events herself.

00:10—00:15
Third shot, 85mm close-up gradually focusing on the junior sister.

She slowly raises her eyes to look at the boyfriend, no crying, no anger, nor confirming with the senior sister.
She asks herself:
"Are you helping me..."
Pause about 0.3 seconds.
"Or making me only able to find you?"
Complete silence.
The boyfriend obviously wants to answer, lips slightly move, but cannot organize words.
The senior sister never shows victory, satisfaction, or "I knew it all along" expressions, and absolutely must not reach out to lead the junior sister away.
The junior sister bends down to pull up the suitcase herself.
The boyfriend subconsciously asks:
"Where are you going?"
She glances at him, answers calmly:
"Just be alone for a while."
Then drags the suitcase, walking alone past the two people.
The senior sister only steps aside, truly clearing the passage.
Finally, do not chase-shoot the senior sister, do not linger on the boyfriend's face.
The camera stops on the back view of the junior sister dragging the suitcase towards the end of the corridor, wheel sounds fade away, elevator light turns on, end.

Whole film performance principles: No winner, no villain verdict, no emotional explosion. The senior sister only raises one question; the boyfriend still believes he is caring for her; the person who truly completes the judgment must be the junior sister herself.
Dialogue must sound like what real adults would say during arguments, short sentences, colloquial, avoiding literary lines, golden quote style, psychological terminology, and short-drama shouting. While all characters speak, others must shut up and have real listening reactions. Mandarin lip-sync accurate, gaze targets clear.
Three-shot structure strictly maintained:
0—5s: Establish "He always saves her"
5—10s: First realization "Why is he always there"
10—15s: She poses the question herself and leaves alone

Sound design: Residential air conditioner low frequency, elevator chime, fabric rustle, cracked phone grip sound, suitcase wheel sounds realistically synchronized. Background music extremely weak or even absent, letting the final wheel sound become the emotional convergence.
Character faces, hairstyles, clothing, cracked-screen phone, suitcase, corridor door positions, elevator direction, and the three-person spatial positions must remain continuously stable. Prohibit character identity drift, prop disappearance, random position swaps, multi-person gaze errors, and the boyfriend suddenly becoming aggressive.
Negative: blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, subtitles, malformed hands, extra fingers, inconsistent character, face morphing, identity drift, changing clothes, disappearing suitcase, changing phone, repaired phone screen, background shift, unstable hallway, teleportation, random character position, incorrect eyeline, overlapping dialogue, inaccurate lip sync, exaggerated crying, screaming, aggressive male stereotype, villain expression, smug senior woman, triumph expression, melodramatic acting, soap opera acting, theatrical pause, motivational speech, therapy jargon, excessive music cue, glitch cut, random camera movement.

prompt:
电影级写实质感，纯粹的中国古代仙侠美学。
核心聚焦于成熟的体制压力、克制而持续紧绷的情感张力，以及资深编剧风格的对话，围绕以下主题展开：
要求所有人统一表现出“一切正常”的压力
疲惫是否可以被承认
诚实是削弱还是增强集体力量
采用 Arri Alexa 电影摄影机质感，稳定清晰的面部微表情细节，细腻的胶片颗粒感，自然的体积光，以及简洁明了的高层次角色调度。
严格使用 @Image 1 和 @Image 2 作为角色身份锚点。
首先静默地将所有新上传的背景和地点参考图像重组为新的统一环境 DNA：自然融合兼容的真实地形、古建筑语言、空间尺度、风化材质、植被、水体、缭绕的山雾、缓慢移动的云层、反射、主光源方向及大气深度；整个环境保持持续生动但叙事上绝对中立。
角色设定
角色 ID A
始终为同一位 @Image 1 资深剑仙师姐：
25-30 岁东亚女性
椭圆白皙脸庞
深色杏眼
黑色长发半束，以白玉发簪固定
身材高挑纤细
穿着同一套白色刺绣丝绸汉服
半透明分层宽袖
银色腰封
玉佩
白布靴
手持一柄银色长剑
角色 ID B
始终为同一位 @Image 2 年轻剑仙师妹：
20-25 岁东亚女性
圆润灵动的脸庞
黑发编辫
身材娇小
穿着同一套绿色亚麻汉服
深色腰带
木质发簪
黑布鞋
手持一柄深色钢剑
其他次要角色
以下角色仅作为次要见证者存在：
一位年迈的师父
一位医师
几位大战后明显疲惫的弟子
一位敌方使者
片段结构
0-5s | 远景或全景
清晰建立角色与环境的关系。
师父公开下令：
“汇报伤情，统一四字——并无阻碍，随时可战。”
周围弟子如习惯般齐声回答：
“并无阻碍，随时可战。”
同一位师妹没有出声。
经过半拍的完整停顿后，她在众人注视下说道：
“弟子有阻碍。”
在前 3 秒内立即形成钩子，让观众误以为她将在敌方使者面前公开示弱。
5-10s | 中景或牛仔镜头
保持相同的两位女性、相同的服装、相同的剑以及完全一致的地理空间。
师父明显压低声音：
“敌方使者在此，你非要示弱吗？”
同一位师妹不反驳，只平静回答：
“我能战。”
经过半拍的完整停顿后，补充道：
“但痛就是痛。”
在浅景深背景中，敌方使者的嘴角露出一丝看戏的微笑。
就在所有人认为师姐会训斥师妹时，
同一位白衣剑仙走到她身边，与她并肩站立，只说道：
“我也有阻碍。”
师父突然转头：
“你也敢放肆？”
风、水、山雾、植被、云影、织物和背景中的远处人物继续自然变化，但绝不介入角色冲突。
10-15s | 特写或大特写
同一位师父压抑着怒火问道：
“若人人都喊痛，士气何在？”
同一位资深剑仙不立即反驳，只回答：
“士气不是靠人人说没事来维持的。”
留下一个真正沉重的完整停顿。
她将目光转向那些明显疲惫但仍挺直站立的弟子，继续说道：
“而是有人敢说有问题——而其他人能承担得起。”
随着话音落下，同一位医师未置一词，默默拿着绷带走上前。
在浅景深背景中，敌方使者原本的笑容慢慢消失，因为他看到的不是崩溃，而是一个允许彼此承认痛苦的群体。
同一位师妹轻声问师姐：
“明天怎么办？”
大特写落在师姐冷静清澈的眼睛上，她回答：
“该战时便战。”
经过半拍的完整停顿后，给出最后一句台词：
“今晚先疗伤。”
不要安排掌声。
不要安排师父突然认错。
不要安排师妹哭泣。
只让几位一直强撑着的弟子最终缓缓放松肩膀。
硬性要求
严格总时长 15 秒
16:9 横屏
严格三个连续清晰的镜头
原生同步普通话对白
精确的口型同步和视线关系
角色身份、发型、服装、剑、医师道具、配角位置和地理空间全程保持稳定
角色微表情必须克制且真实
动作节点少但清晰
丝绸织物、头发、绷带和武器的物理效果自然
前景、中景和背景之间保持真实的视差和同步的空间环境音
不生成字幕
Seedance 2.0 Mini 执行重点
对于 Seedance 2.0 Mini，强调：
参考角色一致性
多角色间清晰的视觉层级
有限但具有戏剧意义的动作设计
稳定的摄像机连续性
光影连续性
核心道具连续性
对白、脚步声、织物摩擦声、绷带展开声、剑鞘沙沙声和环境音效的精确视听同步
负面提示词
模糊，质量差，低质量，低分辨率，噪点，jpeg 伪影，水印，文字，错误；变形，突变，解剖结构错误，手部绘制不佳，构图糟糕，出框，畸形；角色不一致，服装变化，面部变形，背景偏移，故障剪辑，道具消失

Cinematic realistic texture, pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetics.
Core focus on mature institutional pressure, restrained yet continuously tense emotional power, and veteran screenwriter-style dialogue revolving around the following themes:
The demand to uniformly act like everything is fine
Whether exhaustion can be acknowledged
Whether honesty weakens a collective or makes it stronger
Adopt Arri Alexa film camera texture, stable sharp facial micro-details, delicate film grain, natural volumetric lighting, and simple clear high-level character blocking.
Strictly use @Image 1 and @Image 2 as character identity anchors.
Silently reassemble all newly uploaded background and location reference images into a new unified environment DNA first: naturally blend compatible real terrain, ancient architectural language, spatial scale, weathered materials, vegetation, water bodies, wandering mountain mist, slowly moving clouds, reflections, main light direction, and atmospheric depth; the entire environment remains persistently alive but absolutely neutral narratively.
Character Settings
Character ID A
Always the same @Image 1 Senior Sword Immortal Sister:
25-30 year old East Asian female
Oval fair face
Dark almond eyes
Black long hair half-tied, fixed with a white jade hairpin
Tall and slender figure
Wearing the same set of white embroidered silk Hanfu
Semi-transparent layered wide sleeves
Silver waist sash
Jade pendant
White cloth boots
Holding a single silver longsword
Character ID B
Always the same @Image 2 Junior Sword Immortal Sister:
20-25 year old East Asian female
Round lively face
Black hair braided
Petite figure
Wearing the same set of green linen Hanfu
Dark belt
Wooden hairpin
Black cloth shoes
Holding a single dark steel sword
Other Secondary Characters
The following characters exist only as secondary witnesses:
An elderly master
A physician
Several visibly exhausted disciples after a great battle
An enemy envoy
Segment Structure
0-5s | Wide or Long Shot
Clearly establish the relationship between characters and environment.
The master publicly orders:
"Report injuries, uniform four words — No impediment, ready for battle."
The surrounding disciples answer in unison as if accustomed:
"No impediment, ready for battle."
The same junior sister does not speak up.
After a full pause of half a beat, she says under everyone's gaze:
"This disciple has an impediment."

0–3 sec — THE ESCAPE
A church wedding is happening when the bride suddenly bursts through the giant church doors and sprints down the steps, still holding her bouquet. Her expression is determined but hilariously excited. Her veil and dress fly wildly behind her. Camera rapidly tracks backward in front of her as she runs. A few confused wedding guests appear in the background, realizing what is happening.
3–5 sec — GET TO THE CAR
She spots a bright red 1950s vintage car waiting at the curb. She kicks off one white bridal heel while running, then throws herself toward the driver's door. Fast whip-pan follows her movement.

5–8 sec — PEEL OUT
She jumps into the car, slams the door, starts the engine and PEELS AWAY at ridiculous speed. Tires squeal, a tiny cloud of smoke appears, and her long white veil gets caught in the closing door and streams dramatically behind the car. The bouquet lands on the passenger seat.
8–11 sec — CHAOS

Bride gripping the steering wheel and laughing → her veil whipping around her face → bouquet bouncing around the passenger seat → her other bridal heel flying through the air → wedding guests running helplessly behind the disappearing car.

11–15 sec — SHE’S FREE
Dynamic side tracking shot of the red car racing down a sunny vintage highway. The bride drives one-handed, completely carefree. She looks into the rearview mirror, sees the church disappearing in the distance, grins, then blows a huge pink bubblegum bubble.
Final frame:
The red car speeds toward the horizon, veil flying behind it.

prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic fictional home-video featuring an adult Korean man in his late 20s spending a cheerful afternoon in an older Seoul residential neighborhood.

CHARACTER:
A fictional adult Korean man in his late 20s with medium-to-long dark hair tied in a casual low ponytail, natural masculine facial features, realistic skin texture and a friendly expressive personality. Keep his appearance consistent throughout the entire video.

OUTFIT:
He wears a bold, fashionable summer outfit consisting of a vivid red fitted T-shirt, high-waisted relaxed-fit white denim shorts, clean casual sneakers, a simple bracelet, small understated earrings and a small shoulder bag. The outfit is youthful, colorful and stylish, appropriate for a warm summer day.

SCENE 1 — LEAVING HOME
He steps out of an older Seoul apartment building carrying a small reusable shopping bag. He closes the gate behind him, notices the camera and gives a spontaneous smile before walking down the quiet residential lane.

SCENE 2 — LOCAL BAKERY
He enters a tiny neighborhood bakery, looks through the pastry display and chooses a small baked treat. He pays the shopkeeper with coins, thanks them and walks back outside.

SCENE 3 — FRIENDLY ENCOUNTER
While walking through the narrow lane, he suddenly sees his adult male friend approaching from the opposite direction. They smile, greet each other warmly and share a quick friendly hug. They chat and laugh for a moment before waving goodbye and continuing in opposite directions.

SCENE 4 — FRUIT STAND
He stops at a small roadside fruit stall and chooses a peach. He pays the vendor, places it inside his shopping bag and continues walking.

SCENE 5 — EVERYDAY NEIGHBORHOOD MOMENT
He walks beneath trees while eating his pastry. A bicycle passes nearby, and he naturally steps aside. He looks around at the quiet houses and smiles as the camera follows him from a short distance.

SCENE 6 — ENDING
He reaches the end of the lane, turns toward the camera and gives a cheerful wave.

He smiles naturally and says, “Bye bye!”

He then turns around and walks away down the residential street while carrying his bag and peach. The camera stays behind him until he disappears around the corner.

CAMERA STYLE:
Authentic early-2000s consumer MiniDV home-video footage. Handheld camera shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, automatic exposure fluctuations, soft digital detail, mild digital noise, slight compression artifacts, realistic motion blur and occasional awkward zooms.

It should feel like a genuine recording made by a friend or family member, not a professional production.

AUDIO:
Only natural neighborhood sounds: footsteps, bicycles, distant traffic, bakery activity, casual conversations, birds, children playing and light wind.

No music, no narration, no subtitles, no text overlays, no beauty filter, no sexualized

prompt:
电影级写实纹理，纯粹的中国古代仙侠美学。

核心：成熟的身份冲突、克制的武侠角色表演、依赖潜台词和站位反转的老练编剧式对话。
采用：
Arri Alexa 电影摄影机质感

自然体积光
细腻胶片颗粒感
核心反转

打破以往使用的结构：

反抗
替罪羊
投降
救援
忠诚测试
将冲突直接置于“传承”本身之上。
所有人都认为：
对师妹最大的认可，就是让她接过师姐的剑、头衔和位置。

真正的反转在于——
正因为师姐真正认可她，她才拒绝让师妹的人生仅仅成为：

“我的第二个版本。”
参考与环境

严格使用 @Image 1 和 @Image 2 作为角色身份锚点。
所有上传的背景/地点参考决定相同的环境基因。
在正式构图前，静默重组兼容的：

真实地形

建筑语言

材质年代

水体
天气

山雾
反射

空气深度
形成全新的统一场景。
背景原则
背景保持生动但叙事中立。
角色设定
角色 ID A | 师姐（剑仙）
始终为同一位 @Image 1 师姐：

25–30 岁东亚女性

鹅蛋脸白皙面容
深色杏眼

黑色长发半挽，以白玉发簪固定

高挑纤细身材

身着同款白色刺绣丝绸汉服
半透明宽袖

银色腰带
玉佩
白布靴
手持唯一一把银色长剑
角色 ID B | 师妹
始终为同一位 @Image 2 师妹：
20–25 岁东亚女性
圆润灵动面容
黑色编发
娇小身材
身着同款青绿色亚麻汉服

深色腰带
木质发簪

黑布鞋
手持唯一一把带有使用磨损痕迹的深钢剑
其他次要角色
一位年迈师父
两名门派弟子
一名外部使者
这些角色仅作为次要见证者存在。
分段结构
0–5s | 远景或全景镜头

年迈师父主持正式的传承仪式。

他双手呈上象征剑首身份的仪式银剑，深沉说道：
“接剑。从今日起，你继承她的位置。”
师妹本能地伸手去接。

手指尚未触及剑身，
白衣剑仙突然拔剑，用一次极其干净、克制的刃击将仪式银剑侧向拨开，绝不可攻击任何人。

她只说：

“她不接。”

师妹立即转头看向她：

“为什么？”

5–10s | 中景或牛仔镜头

保持：

同样的两位女性

同样的服装
同样的长剑

同样的仪式剑

完全相同的地理空间

师父明显不悦：

“你不认可她？”
师姐真诚地看着师妹，回答：

“正因为我认可她。”
完整停顿半拍，然后落下台词：

“我的位置，只容得下一个我。”
浅景深背景下，外部使者忍不住轻笑：
“那她算什么？”
师姐甚至没有转头回应，继续看着师妹：
“问你自己。”

此时，无煽情音乐强行渲染情绪，仅保留自然空间声和低抑克制的配乐基底。

以下背景元素继续自然运动，完全不参与剧情：

风

水体

山雾

衣袖

发丝

倒影

远处人影

10–15s | 特写或大特写镜头

师妹先低头看向被拨开的仪式银剑，再看向陪伴她多年的旧深钢剑。

她不再询问能否继承，而是改变问题，低声问道：

“我该站在哪里？”
师姐不为她定义身份，只回答：
“别站在我身后。”
完整停顿半拍。
师妹真正理解后，从师姐身后半步走出，第一次并肩而立，歪头问道：
“这里？”
师姐目光直视前方，无赞许，无安慰，只说三个字：

“往前走。”
大特写跟随师妹眼神的变化：

她短暂凝滞，随后真正向前迈出一整步，第一次站到师姐身前。

师姐没有拉住她，也没有唤回她。

浅景深背景：

年迈师父彻底沉默

之前轻笑的外部使者缓缓收敛笑容
最终画面清晰定格于：

“师妹手持自己的旧剑，立于最前”
被拨开的传承银剑留在原地，无人拾起。

这意味着：
并非师妹继承了师姐的位置，
而是师姐第一次将自己的前路让给她。

戏剧核心

完成的不是“拒绝传承”，而是：

拒绝将师妹定义为“下一个师姐”

拒绝将认可等同于复制

让她存在，而非作为任何人的延续
让她第一次站在属于自己的位置上

剑仙师姐

态度必须稳定、克制、坚定

不是否定师妹，而是拒绝师妹被她的头衔吞噬

师妹

【风格】新中式武侠，水墨流体模拟粒子特效，高速摄影，真人与 CG 结合，黑白红视觉冲击，极快节奏。
【时长】15 秒
【人物】
墨武士：动作刚猛，招招如泼墨山水般厚重。
赤刺客：动作轻灵诡谲，锋利如朱砂点漆。
【场景】纯白虚空，地面铺满宣纸。

[00:00-00:05] 镜头 1：觉醒（由静至动）。
从极致的静到极致的动。场景初始为一幅静态的黑白水墨画，两个墨点遥遥相对。突然，古琴音爆裂。【动作】两个墨点瞬间化为真人残影，向彼此冲去。墨武士一记重拳，空中瞬间炸开一团浓郁的黑墨（取代尘土），墨迹凝固成遒劲的书法笔触。赤刺客侧身闪避，手中匕首划出一道鲜艳的朱砂红线。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头 2：水墨对决（快速剪辑）。
超高速的快速剪辑。两人展开眼花缭乱的近身搏斗（武术套路级别）。【视觉奇观】每一次肢体碰撞（拳脚相加）都不是血肉之声，而是水墨爆裂的声响。墨武士一记扫堂腿，掀起墨色巨浪海啸；赤刺客空中连踢，留下红色残影。地面宣纸被他们的步法撕裂，墨迹洇开。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头 3：次元破壁。
慢动作渐进。两人同时放出绝招，对撞。一记墨龙拳和一柄朱雀赤刃在空中僵持。【高能时刻】巨大的能量冲击导致整个二维水墨世界崩塌。镜头快速拉远，揭示他们打破了“次元壁”，从一幅挂在墙上的撕裂水墨画中“跌落”到真实世界的木地板上。他们周身萦绕着残余的墨雾和纸屑，定格在最后的战斗姿态，气喘吁吁。

prompt:
KAZEMIRU — WILD-WIND NIGHT HUNT — 5 SAMURAI
Duration: 15s | 16:9 | No Music

STYLE:
Ultra-photorealistic REAL LIVE-ACTION, AAA Japanese dark-action cinema, restrained semi-CGI VFX. ARRI ALEXA 65, IMAX, Panavision anamorphic. Nighttime Edo Japan, cold moonlight, warm lanterns, deep shadows, mist, realistic atmosphere.

@Image1 — STRICT IDENTITY LOCK:
Preserve exact male face, facial geometry, white hairstyle, body proportions, torn-white outfit, tattoo, accessories and identity. Exactly ONE male Kazemiru, TWO real metal swords, FIVE adult samurai. Kazemiru ALWAYS remains a photorealistic real human male.

COMBAT:
Wild, aggressive, acrobatic anime-inspired dual-sword choreography translated into live action. BURST → CROSS-SLASH → PIVOT → REVERSE CUT → WEAVE → DOUBLE SLASH → RE-BURST. Both swords remain physical and clearly visible. ZERO idle, posing, waiting or neutral resets.

SUPERSONIC WIND:
Kazemiru physically crosses every distance; NO teleportation. Each short-range burst creates restrained emerald-green wind trails, subtle particles, air distortion, dust, leaves, bending lantern flames and realistic clothing reaction.

LOCATION:
Edo castle district at night: broad dirt road, wooden houses, stone walls, gates, tiled roofs, lanterns and trees. Five samurai surround Kazemiru.

CAMERA:
Strong 25–35° Dutch angle. Camera is always moving and intentionally slower than Kazemiru. Kazemiru moves first → camera reacts 0.1–0.3s late → whip-pan → overshoots → corrects → reacquires at contact. Use rear OTS, 3/4 tracking, aggressive side tracking and low-angle pursuit. NEVER static, floating or robotic.

00:00–00:03 — #1:
Five samurai rush from different directions. Kazemiru bursts forward, air blast throws dust and leaves. Camera loses him, whip-pans, reacquires. He reaches #1 and delivers a brutal dual-sword CROSS-SLASH. Clear contact. #1 collapses. No blood/gore.

00:03–00:06 — #2:
#2 attacks. Kazemiru weaves beneath the blade, redirects it with one sword and reverse-slashes with the second. Clear contact. He plants one foot on a stone wall and explosively pushes off. Wind and dust erupt. Camera overshoots toward #3.

00:06–00:09 — #3:
Kazemiru flies into frame. Camera catches him mid-air. Real human body twists through a descending dual-blade attack. Both swords remain readable. Clear contact. He lands low and instantly bursts again.

00:09–00:12 — #4:
Low Dutch tracking above dirt. #4 charges. Kazemiru weaves past by centimeters, pivots and performs two distinct reverse-slashes. Clear contact. Pressure wave throws dirt outward. Camera loses him and violently reacquires.

00:12–00:15 — #5:
#5 searches desperately. Emerald wind crosses background. Kazemiru bursts from the side. He ducks the sword, rotate

黎明前的九重天之上，无数浮空仙岛悬浮于无尽云海之中。

场景主要由以下元素构成：

白玉桥
破碎的仙宫
浮空石台
巨大的断裂雕像
云海
星空裂隙
高空仙岛群

俯瞰视角保持深邃的星河，而远处地平线则显露出黎明的第一缕金光。

整体采用低饱和度的靛灰、月白、冰蓝和暗金色调。

大型技能拥有不同的元素光色，但始终保持韩金（Hanjin）的冰蓝与暗金视觉作为统一基调。

战斗造成的裂痕、冰层、焦痕、断桥、巨坑、剑痕和怪物残骸持续累积且不会自动恢复。

碎石、白玉碎片和怪物外壳遵循真实的重力和惯性。

云海会因冲击波、风暴和大型能量技能而产生体积翻滚效果。

角色的头发、长袍和流苏始终受高速移动和高空气流的影响。

16:9 比例。

[主角 | 大师姐 · 韩金剑客]

角色资产 @Image1。

严格保持：

冷艳的东方女性面孔。

黑色高马尾长发。

额头上的三个蓝色纹章标记。

深蓝黑分层战袍与铠甲。

暗银、铜金雕刻结构。

蓝色流苏和玉饰。

多角度角色参考属于同一角色。

禁止：换脸、改变发型、改变额头标记、修改体型、随机更换服装或生成角色克隆。

[武器 | 韩金]

武器资产 @Image2。

韩金是整部影片中唯一的武器。

保持冰蓝透明水晶剑刃、冰裂纹、暗银雕刻护手、蓝宝石、深色剑柄和蓝色流苏。

韩金始终是所有大型技能激活的核心。

不同元素可以改变剑的外部光效和环境染色，但不能重新设计物理武器。

禁止：复制、双持、随机变色、改变剑形或将剑鞘生成为第二把武器。

[怪物 | 噬星兽潮]

战场上有许多统一设计的噬星怪物。

普通小兵主要由以下特征组成：

黑曜石虚空躯体 + 无面黑曜石外壳 + 紫色星核 + 利爪。

空中存在快速飞行的噬星生物。

怪物潮汐从以下位置补充：

星空裂隙。

浮岛后方。

云层下方。

仙宫废墟。

怪物必须主动执行以下行为：

追击。

杀戮。

包围。

空袭。

远程压制。

不能只是站在主角周围等待被摧毁。

被击败时，怪物崩解为黑曜石碎片、紫色星尘和熄灭的星核。

残骸落在浮岛和废墟上并持久存在。

[全局战斗规则]

30 秒高速 1vN 仙侠动作砍杀。

无对话。

无战吼。

无技能名称喊叫。

无慢动作。

无定格画面。

无打击停顿（Hit-stop）。

主要战斗要素为：

高速移动 + 巨型技能 + 大规模清怪。

十种类型的技能必须具有独特的视觉概念，而不仅仅是改变颜色的相同剑气。

技能元素系统可涵盖：

星河。

雷霆。

风暴。

天体坠落。

月光与镜光。

日相。

巨型剑阵。

空间裂隙。

极光天幕。

穹顶终结现象。

这些元素无需按文本中出现的顺序执行。

不同元素之间必须有明显的视觉差异。

[高速移动]

大师姐始终处于高机动状态。

主要移动方式包括：

贴地冲刺。

高速侧向回旋。

在浮岛间跳跃。

短距离瞬移。

垂直上升。

俯冲。

环绕盘旋。

空中变向。

短距离瞬移保留带有明确终点的冰蓝和暗金残影。

角色到达终点后立即继续战斗。

残影不是物理克隆体。

禁止：长时间将角色变成无法辨认的能量线条。

[小技能]

仅在大型技能之间使用极短的辅助动作。

包括：

短距离剑气。

步法换位。

高速连续斩击。

点射式剑光。

这些动作主要用于：

处理近距离怪物。

调整空间位置。

衔接下一个大型技能。

不要使用大量普通攻击来拖延时间。

[巨型技能系统]

星河系列

韩金可以调动高空星河。

巨大的冰蓝星河能量从天穹进入战场，在浮岛和桥梁之间形成 massive 洪流。

战场可以留下冻结的星河痕迹或冰蓝能量带。

雷霆系列

天空雷云响应韩金。

巨大闪电降落在核心战区。

闪电可以形成：

雷霆之剑。

雷霆之柱。

电弧网络。

大型剑阵。

怪物群在密集闪电中失去平衡并被连续抛飞。

浮岛表面显示烧焦、电击和裂痕痕迹。

风暴系列

韩金挥剑引发大型冰蓝风暴。

多个巨型龙卷风横跨浮岛和云海。

风暴可以同时卷起：

怪物。

碎石。

云雾。

仙宫残骸。

大师姐在风暴内部高速穿梭继续追击。

环境显示明显的风蚀和旋转损伤。

天体系列

高空星河出现异常。

许多带有冰晶、星光或暗金能量的天体从天空急速坠落。

不同的浮岛遭受连续的巨大撞击。

产生：

巨坑。

冷雾。

碎石。

冲击波。

大规模怪物潮崩解。

月光系列

战场上出现大规模的月白视觉现象。

可以通过以下方式实现：

月光镜面。

冰晶反射。

多方向折射剑光。

形成大面积切割网络。

切割光从多个方向同时穿过怪物潮。

一些月光结构在技能结束后仍留在环境中。

太阳系列

随着黎明临近，第一缕阳光进入战场。

韩金可以调动暗金太阳能。

巨大的金色神鸟、炽热的太阳剑火或大规模金色天象穿越浮岛群。

冰蓝和暗金形成强烈的冷暖叠加。

剑阵系列

大型仙宫广场或浮岛地面被韩金的剑意激活。

许多冰蓝巨剑从建筑、冰层或地面升起。

剑的尺寸远大于常规武器。

大师姐在剑阵内高速移动。

怪物从不同位置被连续击飞、被能量体刺穿或被抛向空中。

裂隙系列

韩金可以短暂撕裂战场空间。

天空或浮岛之间形成巨大的黑色空间裂隙。

裂隙边缘由冰蓝和暗金能量勾勒。

许多剑光或空间切割沿裂隙边缘向外扩散。

大师姐可以快速围绕裂隙变换位置。

空间裂隙结束后留下明显的视觉残留。

禁止：使用普通的黑洞吞噬代替空间裂隙。

极光系列

高空中出现大面积的冰蓝、月白和淡金极光。

极光从天穹垂下，覆盖多个浮岛。

极光帷幕具有巨大的深度和空间尺度。

进入其中的怪物：

冻结。

失去平衡。

崩解为能量。

大师姐在不同的极光层之间高速穿梭。

此阶段逐渐将整个战场推向最终高潮。

[最终阶段]

之前战斗留下的视觉效果仍然存在于场景中。

例如：

冰层。

焦痕。

风蚀。

撞击坑。

镜面碎片。

剑林。

空间裂缝。

极光余晖。

怪物残骸。

在最终阶段，这些视觉元素不需要全部直接变成同一个技能，但应产生一定程度的环境共鸣。

韩金成为最终的能量核心。

大师姐释放覆盖核心浮岛群和天空的大规模终结现象。

可以表现为：

巨型星环。

多层天穹冲击波。

冰蓝和暗金环形剑光。

大范围星空能量扩张。

终结技能的规模必须明显高于之前的单一元素技能。

星河、闪电、日月和极光视觉效果可以在终结效果中短暂出现，但不能完全重放之前的技能。

variants.text:
[Global Image Quality Settings]

UE5.4 Path Tracing, Lumen Global Illumination, Nanite, PBR Physical Materials. High-quality Chinese-style Xianxia 3D CG animation, 8K, HDR, ACES color management, cinematic camera work, 60fps high-speed smoothness.

Chaos physics destruction, realistic rigid-body debris with gravity arcs, cloth simulation, volumetric lighting, godrays, contact shadows, ray-traced reflections.

Above the nine heavens before dawn, numerous floating immortal islands hover amidst an endless sea of clouds.

The scene consists mainly of:

White jade bridges
Broken immortal palaces
Floating stone platforms
Giant broken statues
Sea of clouds
Starry sky rifts
High-altitude immortal island groups

The overhead view remains a deep starry river, while the distant horizon reveals the first golden light of dawn.

Overall use low-saturation indigo gray, moon white, ice blue, and dark gold tones.

Large skills have different element light colors, but always maintain Hanjin's ice-blue and dark-gold visual as the unified base.

Battle-caused cracks, ice layers, scorch marks, broken bridges, giant pits, sword marks, and monster debris accumulate continuously and do not auto-recover.

Gravel, white jade fragments, and monster shells follow real gravity and inertia.

The sea of clouds will experience volumetric rolling due to shockwaves, storms, and large energy skills.

Character hair, robes, and tassels are always affected by high-speed movement and high-altitude airflow.

16:9.

[Protagonist | Senior Sister · Hanjin Swordsman]

Character asset @Image1.

Strictly maintain:

Cold Eastern female face.

Black high ponytail long hair.

Three blue pattern marks on forehead.

Deep blue-black layered battle robe and armor.

Dark silver, copper gold carved structure.

Blue tassels and jade ornaments.

Multi-angle character references belong to the same role.

Only one senior sister in the entire film.

Forbidden: face swap, hairstyle change, forehead mark change, body type modification, random outfit change, or generating character clones.

[Weapon | Hanjin]

Weapon asset @Image2.

Hanjin is the only weapon in the entire film.

Maintain ice-blue transparent crystal blade, ice cracks, dark silver carved guard, blue gemstone, dark sword handle, and blue tassel.

Hanjin is always the core of all large skill activations.

Different elements can change the external light effects and environmental coloring of the sword, but cannot redesign the physical weapon.

Forbidden: duplication, dual wielding, random color changes, changing sword shape, or generating the sheath as a second weapon.

[Monsters | Star-Devouring Horde]

There are many uniformly designed star-devouring monsters on the battlefield.

Common minions mainly consist of:

Obsidian void body + faceless obsidian shell + purple star core + claws.

Fast-flying star-devouring creatures exist in the air.

Large units have a size significantly larger than immortal palace buildings, attacking with giant palms, obsidian boulders, and star core energy.

Monster tides replenish from:

Starry sky rifts.

Back of floating islands.

Below the sea of clouds.

Immortal palace ruins.

Monsters must actively:

Chase.

Kill.

Surround.

Air raid.

Long-range suppression.

Cannot just stand still around the protagonist waiting to be destroyed.

When defeated, monsters disintegrate into obsidian shards, purple stardust, and extinguished star cores.

Debris falls on floating islands and ruins and persists.

[Global Battle Rules]

30-second high-speed 1vN Xianxia hack-and-slash.

No dialogue.

No battle cries.

No skill name shouting.

No slow motion.

No freeze frames.

No hit-stop.

Main combat elements are:

High-speed movement + Giant skills + Large-scale monster tide clearing.

The entire film includes ten large skill bursts.

Ten types of skills must have distinct visual concepts, not just the same sword qi with changed colors.

Skill element system can cover:

Star River.

Thunder.

Storm.

Celestial Body Fall.

Moonlight and Mirror Light.

Sun Phenomenon.

Large Sword Array.

Space Rift.

Aurora Sky Curtain.

Sky Dome Termination Phenomenon.

These elements do not need to be executed in the order they appear in text.

Different elements must have clear visual differences.

[High-Speed Movement]

Senior Sister is always in a high-mobility state.

Main movement methods include:

Ground-skimming charge.

High-speed lateral turn-back.

Jumping between floating islands.

Short-distance teleportation.

Vertical ascent.

Dive.

Side circling.

Mid-air direction change.

Short-distance teleportation retains ice-blue and dark-gold afterimages with a clear endpoint.

Character continues fighting immediately upon reaching endpoint.

Afterimages are not physical clones.

Forbidden: turning the character into unrecognizable energy lines for a long time.

[Small Skills]

Only extremely short auxiliary actions are used between large skills.

Including:

Short-distance sword qi.

Step-change position.

High-speed consecutive slashes.

Point-shot style sword light.

These actions mainly serve to:

Handle close-range monsters.

Adjust spatial position.

Connect to the next large skill.

Do not use many normal attacks to delay time.

[Giant Skill System]

Star River Series

Hanjin can mobilize the high-altitude star river.

Huge ice-blue star river energy enters the battlefield from the sky dome, forming a massive flow between floating islands and bridges.

Monster hordes are scattered by the star river torrent, and the sea of clouds rolls to both sides after impact.

The battlefield can leave frozen star river traces or ice-blue energy bands.

Thunder Series

Sky thunder clouds respond to Hanjin.

Massive lightning descends on the core war zone.

Lightning can form:

Thunder swords.

Thunder pillars.

Arc networks.

Large sword arrays.

Monster hordes lose balance and are thrown continuously in dense lightning.

Floating island surfaces show charred, electric shock, and crack marks.

Storm Series

Hanjin swings sword causing a large ice-blue storm.

Multiple giant whirlwinds span across floating islands and sea of clouds.

Storm can simultaneously sweep up:

Monsters.

Gravel.

Cloud mist.

Immortal palace debris.

Senior Sister speeds through the inside of the storm continuing pursuit.

Environment shows obvious wind erosion and rotational damage.

Celestial Body Series

Anomalies occur in the high-altitude star river.

Many celestial bodies with ice crystals, starlight, or dark gold energy fall rapidly from the sky.

Different floating islands suffer continuous large impacts.

Producing:

Giant pits.

Cold fog.

Gravel.

Shockwaves.

Large-scale monster tide disintegration.

Moonlight Series

Large-scale moon-white visual phenomena appear on the battlefield.

Can be achieved through:

Moonlight mirrors.

Ice crystal reflection.

Multi-directional refracted sword light.

Forming a large-area slashing network.

Slash lights cut through monster tides from multiple directions simultaneously.

Some moonlight structures remain in the environment after the skill ends.

Sun Series

As dawn approaches, the first sunlight enters the battlefield.

Hanjin can mobilize dark gold solar energy.

Giant golden divine birds, blazing sun sword fire, or large-scale golden celestial phenomena traverse the floating island group.

Ice-blue and dark gold form strong cold-warm overlay.

Many monster hordes disintegrate into stardust under solar energy.

Sword Array Series

Large immortal palace squares or floating island grounds are activated by Hanjin's sword intent.

Many ice-blue giant swords emerge from buildings, ice layers, or ground.

Sword scale is far larger than normal weapons.

The entire area quickly forms a large sword forest or array.

Senior Sister moves at high speed within the sword array.

Monsters are consecutively knocked away, pierced by energy bodies, or thrown into the air from different positions.

Rift Series

Hanjin can briefly tear open battlefield space.

Huge black space rifts form between sky or floating islands.

Rift edges are outlined by ice-blue and dark gold energy.

Many sword lights or space cuts spread outward along rift edges.

Senior Sister can quickly change positions around the rift.

Obvious visual residuals remain after space rifts end.

Forbidden: using ordinary black hole swallowing instead of space rifts.

Aurora Series

Large-area ice-blue, moon-white, and pale gold auroras appear in the high sky.

Auroras descend from the sky dome, covering multiple floating islands.

Aurora curtains have huge depth and spatial scale.

Monsters entering them:

Freeze.

Lose balance.

Disintegrate into energy.

Senior Sister shuttles at high speed between different aurora layers.

This stage gradually brings the entire battlefield to the final climax.

[Final Phase]

Visuals left by previous battles still exist in the scene.

For example:

Ice layers.

Scorch marks.

Wind erosion.

Impact craters.

Mirror fragments.

Sword forests.

Space cracks.

Aurora afterglow.

Monster debris.

In the final phase, these visual elements don't need to all become the same skill directly, but should produce some degree of environmental resonance.

Hanjin becomes the final energy core.

Senior Sister releases a large-scale termination phenomenon covering the core floating island group and sky.

Can be manifested as:

Giant star rings.

Multi-layer sky dome shockwaves.

Ice-blue and dark gold ring-shaped sword light.

Large-range starry sky energy expansion.

Termination skill scale must be obviously higher than previous single-element skills.

Star river, lightning, sun/moon, and aurora visuals can briefly appear in the termination effect, but cannot fully replay previous skills.

path: prompts/真人/特效向/武侠打斗/youmind-11852--Seedance-2.0-Mini-武侠对决提示词.md
prompt:
电影级写实纹理，纯粹的中国古风仙侠高张力双人对战。

此次彻底打破以往模式：

武器频繁变换
单挑式破局

核心概念变为：
两位主角本身就是一个持续移动的双人战术系统。
一人正面承受压力

另一人从侧翼改变局势
下一秒立即互换角色
真正的爽点不在于华丽的剑气，而在于两人几乎无需回头确认，就能不断覆盖彼此的盲区，形成越来越强的默契与张力。

角色与资产锁定

严格仅将 @image 1 和 @image 2 锁定为两位核心角色。

@image 1 | 剑仙大师姐

图 1 剑仙大师姐始终保持原貌：

成年东亚女性身份
面部特征

黑色长发半束
白玉发簪
高挑纤细比例
白色刺绣丝绸汉服
半透明层叠宽袖
银色腰封
玉佩
白布靴
仅持一把银色直剑
@image 2 | 小师妹
图 2 小师妹始终保持原貌：

成年东亚女性身份
面部特征

黑色编发
绿色亚麻汉服
深色腰带
木质发簪
黑布鞋
仅持一把暗钢剑
其他角色
敌人、师父、路人均为功能性角色，无需复杂的面部或服装锁定。

环境 DNA
本轮上传的所有背景和地点参考图像共同决定同一套环境 DNA。

在正式生成前，静默分析其中的兼容元素：

地形

建筑

高度差

空间尺度
材质年代感
植被
水体
天气
山雾
光照
反射
空气深度
角色可通行的路径
然后重新组合成一个独特但可信的新空间供本轮使用。
空间与路径原则
整个 15 秒必须发生在一条连续且可理解的战斗路径上，不能突然切换到另一个世界。

背景保持动态活跃但在叙事上中性：

风

水

雾

落叶

衣摆
反射
远处人影
始终自然活动。
只有当角色真正：
踏步
碰撞

擦身而过

武器接触环境时
才会出现：
尘土
涟漪
碎片

划痕

衣物位移
等被动物理反馈。
严格禁止
桥梁突然断裂
雾气突然救人

树木突然挡剑

建筑物自行倒塌帮助某一方
分段结构
0–5s | 全景切入中景
同样的白衣剑仙大师姐和绿衣小师妹背靠背站立。
三名仅具战斗功能的敌方剑客从不同方向主动逼近。
0–1s

使用 24mm 固定广角全景，让观众瞬间理解：

五人位置

攻击方向

下一步可用的移动空间
小师妹低声说道，只有一句台词：

“这次，别回头救我。”
大师姐全程未回头，冷静回答：

“好。”
话音刚落，敌人毫无预警地同时发起攻击。
摄像机迅速从固定的 24mm 推进至 35mm 中近景运动，但不随机晃动，而是由角色的真实运动轨迹带动。

首轮交锋

一名敌人从上方攻击大师姐

另一名敌人同时切入小师妹的盲区

两名女子几乎瞬间向相反方向爆发：

大师姐短暂改变第一剑的攻击线后直接推进位置

小师妹降低重心擦过第二次攻击，仅反击敌人的武器路径，不停顿摆姿势

两人立即沿着参考环境中真实存在的路径向前迁移。
高速掠过的前景敌人身影短暂填满镜头，利用这种真实的遮挡完成第一次隐藏剪辑，观众几乎感觉不到机位已变。
5–10s | 中景连续跟随
保持：

同一空间
同两位主角

相同的武器归属

敌人绝不能排队出招，他们持续：

追击

包围

拦截
此时：
大师姐承受来自两名敌人的持续压力
小师妹面对另一名敌人

不能分屏显示“两人各自为战”，必须让两条战斗线不断交织。

首次战术互补
大师姐故意让出半步，将一名追击的敌人引入小师妹的进攻路线。
小师妹完全不看大师姐，只在敌人剑尖真正进入她空间的瞬间，用暗钢剑短暂格挡并改变武器方向，随即释放，继续处理面前的对手。

第二次战术互补
不到一秒后，情况完全相反。
另一名敌人从小师妹背后发动真实攻击。
同样的白衣剑仙甚至不回头，银色剑尖从画面另一侧高速刺入，仅用一次极短的金属撞击将那把剑推离小师妹身后的危险线路，随后银剑立即离开画面，大师姐继续自己的战斗。

核心状态

两人从不确认彼此位置，却准确知道对方在哪里。
摄像机在前景和中景之间平滑滑行，利用以下元素高速掠过镜头形成 2-3 个极其自然的隐藏转场：

敌人肩膀

白色宽袖
绿色衣摆

武器
节奏要求
动作节奏并非从头到尾一个速度，而是：
两次快速交换

一次真正有分量的武器碰撞

半拍寂静
然后突然爆发
年长的师父留在远处的安全区观察，自始至终不出手，不为任何人解决问题。
10–15s | 特写切入最终较宽的中景

三名敌人发现单独追击无效，首次真正同时改变策略，从三个方向压缩空间，迫使大师姐和小师妹向同一中心区域靠拢。
形成明显的僵局。

两人不再后退。
同样的白衣剑仙和绿衣小师妹突然同时向彼此冲刺。
摄像机不立即切换，让观众充分看到：
两人的肩线高速擦过，身体以最小距离交错穿过。
在交错的瞬间，两人完全互换前后位置。
且谁都没有看对方一眼。

互换后的战术翻转

大师姐在经过小师妹时，直接接管原本攻击小师妹盲区的敌人

小师妹同时切入原本追击大师姐的敌人的线路

一名敌人的长剑高速横扫整个摄像机，形成唯一一次明显的武器遮挡硬切。

切到全新的反向轴线：

大师姐现在站在小师妹刚离开的位置

小师妹也站在大师姐刚离开的位置

两人立即完成两个极短、极直接、无花哨旋转的反向突破：
银色剑尖稳稳停在一敌人下巴前一指宽处

暗钢剑同时稳稳停在另一名敌人持剑手腕外
第三名敌人准备再次攻击，却发现两条有效攻击线路完全被同伴的位置阻挡，只能强行撤退。

骤停时刻
之前密集的：
呼啸声

金属碰撞声

鞋底摩擦声
在这一刻突然崩塌。
只剩下：

两名女子的真实呼吸声

剑身极轻微的余震
丝绸衣摆逐渐落下

大师姐仍盯着眼前的敌人，头也不回地问：

“还活着吗？”
小师妹几乎没有停顿：

“比你轻松。”
大师姐嘴角露出一丝极短、极轻的笑意。
远处同样的师父终于轻轻呼出一口憋了许久的气，但不说教，也不解释两人之间的关系。

结束状态

胜利确认后，绝对没有胜利姿势。

两名女子同时放下剑尖，保持原有节奏继续穿过同一空间；三名敌人本能地让路。
头发、衣摆、环境风、水雾、碎片继续自然运动，画面在角色仍在向前移动时直接结束。
摄像机与剪辑要求

严格总时长 15 秒

16:9 横屏

保持 0–5s / 5–10s / 10–15s 三个清晰的叙事段落

视觉上由一条连续丝滑的摄像机路径主导

全片允许仅约 4-5 次隐藏剪辑或由冲击真正触发的剪辑

禁止为了“动作感”而疯狂碎片化剪辑

Seedance 2.0 Mini 执行重点
对于 Seedance 2.0 Mini，积极控制提示词预算。

最重要的是：

图 1、图 2 两位主角身份稳定

两把剑的归属稳定

手部与身体连续性

两人的空间关系连续性
核心环境路径连续
三名敌人只需保持：
古风敌对剑客
基本功能性外观
这就足够了，不要浪费模型注意力去严格锁定面部、服装和细节。

声音与动作要求

原生同步普通话对白

原生同步空间音频效果

重点强化：

剑尖短暂呼啸
真实金属碰撞
鞋底摩擦
丝绸衣摆颤动
角色真实呼吸

最后的骤然安静声音对比

动作质感
