[0-7s: 日常情侣对话]
普通的城市公园或居民区楼下，傍晚时分，自然柔光，背景伴有轻微的生活环境音。
女孩和男孩并肩坐在长椅上。使用双人中近景，清晰展现两人面部。女孩转头看向男孩，握着他的手，语气深情、认真且带有一丝撒娇，仿佛在随意提及一件浪漫的事。男孩深情注视着她。
女孩完整清晰地说道：
“宝贝，如果将来娶我的不是你，那你一定要把头发染成绿色来参加我的婚礼，这样我一眼就能认出你。”
语速自然、稍快且连贯，符合日常说话节奏，不刻意拖长音，无吞字现象，无机械加速。女孩说话时，男孩注视着她倾听，露出既感动又困惑的淡淡微笑，没有添加回复台词。
保持表演的连续性，清晰确立男主角的面部特征。女孩不提前坏笑，不对镜头眨眼，不预示后续的反转。
[7-9s: 硬切至未来婚礼，先见同脸，后见绿发]
就在女孩说完最后一个字“你”的瞬间，立即硬切至酒店婚礼场景。环境音同步从户外生活声切换为宴会厅内的掌声和模糊人声。
切至同一男主角面部的正面特写。初始画面的顶部边缘裁剪在发际线以下，暂时隐藏头发，让观众先认出他是刚才的那个男孩。
他坐在婚礼宾客席上，身穿西装，表情略显拘谨，带着复杂的期待，目光投向入口通道。
随后镜头缓慢平稳地向后移动，逐渐显露出他的整个头部——他染了绿色的头发。
观众在这一刻第一次看到绿色。他从进入婚礼镜头开始就已经是绿发了，不会出现现场变色的特效。
[9-12s: 新人入场，其他发色逐渐显现]
镜头继续向后移动，从特写扩展为中景，进行轻微的横向调整，使绿发男主角保持在画面一侧，逐渐揭示中央婚礼通道。
场景是一个布置用于西式婚礼的真实酒店宴会厅，配有浅色花艺装饰、白色或米色椅子、温暖的顶灯以及铺地毯的入口通道。光源清晰，婚纱保留面料细节，无梦幻仙境效果。
在背景通道上，开头的女孩身穿婚纱，挽着微胖的新郎缓缓入场。新郎的外貌和体型与绿发男主角有明显区别。
男主角原本看着新娘，勉强维持着淡淡的微笑。随着镜头后拉，一位红发男宾和一位蓝发男宾相继进入他附近的画面。
他不经意地瞥了一眼旁边的红发男子，笑容略微停顿，然后看向另一侧的绿发男子，眉毛轻轻挑动，开始感到不对劲。
[12-15s: 揭示更多彩发男士，男主角惊讶环顾]
镜头沿相同轨迹继续后移，扩展为包含男主角、周围排排的宾客以及婚礼通道的更广阔视野。婚礼片段保持连续，不再剪辑。
更多不同发色的男性宾客逐渐进入画面：紫色、黄色、橙色，以及另一位在外貌、体型和发型上与男主角不同的红发男子。
包括男主角在内，约有六到八名彩发男子散坐在相邻的排次中，与普通黑发宾客交错分布。并非所有宾客都染了发，也没有形成整齐的彩虹队列。
他们各不相同：有的瘦削，有的健壮，有的微胖；有的是寸头，有的是偏分短发，有的略带卷曲。西装颜色有黑色、深蓝、灰色、棕色，剪裁、领带和衬衫搭配均有明显差异，看起来像是独立邀请的真实婚礼宾客。
这些人从婚礼镜头开始就坐在原位，只是被初始的紧凑构图遮挡，随着镜头后拉变得可见，不能凭空出现或突然染发。
男主角先向左看，再向右看，最后稍微转身向后斜视，发现另一位绿发男子。他的表情从困惑转为惊讶和尴尬，嘴唇微张，仿佛终于意识到自己可能不是唯一收到这种承诺的人。
其他彩发男子主要继续观看婚礼，有些人可能会与他短暂眼神接触，不会集体转头或同步反应。
结尾同时保留了男主角惊讶环顾的神情、周围不同发色的男士，以及背景中新人继续入场的画面。屏幕自然结束，无额外对话来解释笑点。
[摄影、表演与真实氛围]
开场使用自然日光，婚礼使用温暖的室内酒店灯光。肤色正常，保留皮肤纹理，西装有真实褶皱，婚纱有垂坠感，染发有自然的明暗层次。
前半段感觉像真实情侣闲聊，后半段感觉像在真实婚礼场景中发生的尴尬发现。男主角通过眼神交流、微表情和左右环顾来表达情绪，没有卡通式的大眼瞪视、张嘴或捂脸动作。
婚礼的后拉镜头使用实际的摄像机后退运动，速度平稳，预先安排宾客位置以便不同发色依次进入画面。后拉后逐渐增加景深，确保男主角、彩发宾客和背景新人之间的关系清晰可辨，绝不将周围人物模糊成色块。
无复古 DV 画质、夸张的手持抖动、鱼眼效果、突然变焦、高速环绕、慢动作、塑料皮肤或重滤镜。
[声音]
开场保留女孩的对话和轻微的户外生活声。硬切后，进入酒店宴会厅内自然的掌声、衣物摩擦声、椅子吱呀声和模糊交谈声。
对话准确匹配女孩的唇形，男主角不替她说话也不打断。婚礼片段中不添加清晰的对话。
无旁白，无背景音乐。

variants.label: YouMind 提供的English版本（README.md）
variants.text:
15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, realistic live-action texture, modern Chinese urban background. The first half features natural intimate dialogue between a couple; the second half hard cuts to a Western-style wedding in a future hotel. The camera slowly pulls back to gradually reveal male guests with different colored hair, forming an absurd and awkward comedy twist. Character performances are restrained; environment, skin, fabric, and lighting are realistic and natural.
[Characters and Continuity]
The female lead is a young adult Chinese girl @image (31). In the future wedding, the bride must be the same girl, maintaining facial features and contours, only changing hairstyle, makeup, and clothing.
The male lead is a young adult Chinese man, starting with normal black short hair and daily casual clothes. In the future wedding, his facial features, face shape, body type, and hairstyle contour remain consistent, but he wears a well-fitted suit and dyes his hair distinctly green, fulfilling the girl's request from the opening. He must not look like a different person due to scene/hair changes.
The groom is another adult Chinese man, slightly chubby, with black hair, clearly different appearance from the male lead, wearing formal groom attire.
There are multiple adult male guests at the wedding site, dyed red, blue, purple, yellow, orange, and one other green-haired man. Their appearances, heights, builds, hairstyles, and suits are all distinct. Hair dye retains real hair strands, roots, and luster, looking like natural dyed hair rather than wigs or glowing colors.
[0–7s: Daily Couple Dialogue]
Ordinary city park or residential area downstairs, evening, soft natural light, slight ambient life sounds in the background.
The girl and boy sit side by side on a bench. Medium close-up shot, clearly recognizable faces. The girl turns to look at the boy, holding his hand, speaking affectionately, seriously, with a touch of coquettishness, as if casually mentioning something romantic. The boy looks at her deeply.
The girl speaks completely and clearly:
"Baby, if you're not the one marrying me in the future, you must dye your hair green to come to my wedding, so I can spot you at a glance."
Spoken at a natural, slightly fast, coherent daily pace, not deliberately dragged out, no swallowed words, no mechanical acceleration. While the girl speaks, the boy listens, showing a faint smile moved yet puzzled, adding no response.
Maintain continuous performance, clearly establishing the male lead's appearance. The girl does not smirk early, wink at the camera, or foreshadow the twist.
[7–9s: Hard Cut to Future Wedding, See Same Face Then Green Hair]
Immediately after the girl says "you", hard cut to the hotel wedding scene. Ambient sound switches synchronously from outdoor life sounds to banquet hall applause and blurred voices.
Cut to a frontal close-up of the same male lead's face. Initial frame top edge cropped below the hairline, temporarily hiding hair, letting viewers recognize him as the previous boy.
He sits in the wedding guest seats, wearing a suit, expression slightly reserved with complex anticipation, gaze towards the entrance aisle.
The camera then slowly, steadily moves backward, gradually revealing his full head—he has dyed his hair green.
The green is seen clearly by viewers for the first time. He was already green-haired when entering the wedding shot; no live color-change effect occurs.
[9–12s: Bride and Groom Entrance, Other Colors Appear]
Camera continues moving back, expanding from close-up to medium shot, adjusting horizontally to keep the green-haired male lead on one side and gradually reveal the central wedding aisle.
The site is a real hotel banquet hall arranged for a Western wedding, with light-colored floral arrangements, white/beige chairs, warm ceiling lights, and carpeted entrance aisles. Lighting has clear sources; wedding dress retains fabric details, avoiding dreamy fairy-tale effects.
In the background aisle, the opening girl enters in a wedding dress, arm-in-arm with the slightly chubby groom. The groom's appearance and build are clearly different from the green-haired male lead.
The male lead originally watches the bride, forcing a faint smile. As the camera pulls back, a red-haired male guest and a blue-haired male guest enter the frame near him.
He inadvertently glances at the red-haired man beside him, smile pausing slightly, then looks at the green-haired man on the other side, brow twitching, starting to feel something is wrong.
[12–15s: Reveal More Colored-Hair Men, Male Lead Looks Around in Surprise]
Camera continues moving back along the same trajectory, expanding to a wider frame containing the male lead, several rows of surrounding guests, and the wedding aisle. The wedding segment remains continuous, no further cuts.
More male guests with different hair colors gradually enter the frame: purple, yellow, orange, and another red-haired man distinct from the male lead in appearance, build, and hairstyle.
Including the male lead, about six to eight colored-hair men are scattered across adjacent rows, intermingled with ordinary black-haired guests. Not all guests have dyed hair, nor are they arranged in a neat rainbow line.
They vary: some thin, some sturdy, some chubby; some buzz cuts, some short side parts, some curly. Suits are black, dark blue, gray, brown, with obvious differences in fit, ties, and shirt combinations, resembling independent real wedding guests.
These people were seated in place from the start of the wedding shot, merely hidden by the initial tight framing, becoming visible as the camera pulled back; they cannot appear suddenly or change hair color abruptly.
The male lead looks left, then right, finally turning slightly back to see another green-haired man. His expression shifts from confusion to surprise and embarrassment, lips parting slightly, realizing he might not be the only one who received such a promise.
Other colored-hair men mostly continue watching the wedding; a few may briefly exchange glances with him, not collectively turning heads or reacting in sync.
The ending simultaneously retains the male lead's surprised look-around, surrounding differently colored-hair male guests, and the bride/groom continuing to enter in the background. The screen ends naturally, without extra dialogue explaining the joke.
[Cinematography, Performance, and Realistic Atmosphere]
Opening uses natural daylight; wedding uses hotel warm indoor lighting. Skin tones are normal, retaining texture; suits have real wrinkles; wedding dress has weight; dyed hair has natural shading layers.
The first half feels like real couples chatting casually; the second half feels like an awkward discovery happening at a real wedding. The male lead expresses emotions through eyes, micro-expressions, and looking around, avoiding cartoonish eye-widening, mouth-opening, or face-covering actions.
The wedding pull-back uses actual camera movement, steady speed, with pre-arranged guest positions so different hair colors enter sequentially. Depth of field increases gradually after pull-back, ensuring relationships between male lead, colored-hair guests, and background newlyweds are discernible; do not blur surrounding people into color blocks throughout.
Avoid retro DV quality, exaggerated shaking, fisheye, sudden zooms, high-speed orbits, slow motion, plastic skin, or heavy filters.
[Sound]
Opening retains girl's dialogue and slight outdoor life sounds. After hard cut, enter natural applause, fabric rustle, chair creaks, and blurred conversation of the hotel banquet hall.
Dialogue accurately matches girl's lip movements; male lead does not speak for her or interrupt. No clear dialogue added in wedding segment.
No narration, background music, canned laughter, twist alert sounds, or explanatory subtitles.
[Core Constraints]
Total length 15 seconds. The only hard cut occurs after the girl finishes her line, switching from daily couple scene to future wedding. Wedding part starts with male lead's facial close-up, continuously pulling back slowly.
Information revelation order fixed: Same boy's face -> His green hair -> Same girl and different groom entering -> Surrounding gradual appearance of different colored-hair male guests -> Male lead discovers another green-haired man, looks around in surprise.
Girl's line requests "dye hair green"; male lead indeed dyes hair green in future, consistent.
Bride is same person as opening girl; green-haired male lead is same person as opening boy; groom is different person. Other guests have independent faces, no cloned faces, face swaps, abrupt hair color changes, or sudden appearances.
No subtitles, date stamps, explanatory text, or watermarks.

title: Seedance 2.0 Mini 电影级护送战斗提示词
title_en: Seedance 2.0 Mini Cinematic Escort Battle Prompt
changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。
path: prompts/真人/特效向/古装仙侠玄幻/youmind-11921--Seedance-2.0-Mini-电影级护送战斗提示词.md
prompt:
电影级写实纹理，纯粹的中国古代仙侠动作片，15 秒，16:9，Seedance 2.0 Mini。
本轮并非静止对决，也不重复“切换新武器 → 主角观察 → 反击 → 剑停在喉咙”的旧模式。
核心动作动机是：
在当前参考图像所示的真实高空御道上发生的移动护送战斗。
同一位大师姐和小师妹必须在保护身后受伤师父、弟子和平民撤离的同时，持续向前推进。
敌人的真正目标不一定是击败两位主角。
他们想要做的是：
突破两位主角形成的防线；
切入撤离人群；
封锁继续前进的道路。
因此，整场战斗的核心是：
**打破前方封锁
阻挡后方追兵
两位主角不断交换前后位置
始终重新开辟道路。**
动作追求流畅但绝不能软弱。
流畅意味着：
前一个动作自然引出下一个；
角色始终在移动；
攻防从不重置为零；
武器方向和角色方向始终清晰可辨；
剪辑后，观众仍知道谁在前，谁在后，以及攻击来自何处。
力量来源于：
突然启动；
明显加速；
真实碰撞；
重心变化；
力量抵消；
失衡；
惯性；
反向抓取；
急停；
立即重启。
禁止柔软如舞蹈的剑术。
禁止一次打击后重置姿势。
敌人必须有真实的判断力。
第一种策略失败后，他们必须改变目标、攻击路线、追击、封锁路径、侧翼包抄或主动分离两位主角。
禁止敌人排队送人头。
[核心角色锁定]
严格仅将 @Image 1 和 @Image 2 锁定为两位核心主角及其各自的主要武器。
@Image 1 始终是之前相同的那位剑仙大师姐：
相同的成年东亚女性身份；
25–30 岁；
相同的面容；
黑色长发半束；
白玉发簪；
高挑纤细的身材比例；
白色刺绣丝绸汉服；
半透明层叠宽袖；
银色腰封；
玉佩；
白布靴；
全片中唯一的银色直剑。
@Image 2 始终是之前相同的那位小师妹：
相同的成年东亚女性身份；
20–25 岁；
相同的面容；
黑色编发；
娇小的身材比例；
青绿色亚麻汉服；
深色腰带；
木发簪；
黑布鞋；
全片中唯一的暗钢剑。
敌人、师父、弟子、平民和旁观者都只是功能性配角。
不要浪费生成注意力去严格锁定配角的脸、发型和复杂服装。
只需确保角色类型、位置、武器和动作功能在镜头内保持逻辑连续。
[本轮特定场景硬锚点 | 最高优先级]
本轮上传的背景参考已展示了一个完整且高度可识别的位置。
因此，本轮直接进入：
硬性位置锚定。
参考图像不是风格灵感。
整个视频必须真实发生在参考图像中显示的同一高空天宫御道上。
禁止将其重新设计为“类似的仙侠地点”。
必须持续保持以下位置特征：
画面中心轴始终包含同一条极长、笔直、苍白的高空御道，从前景延伸至远处中心。
御道始终保持明显的狭长深度；角色主要沿前后方向移动；禁止将其扩展为圆形竞技场、巨大庭院或宽阔广场。
御道左右两侧始终保持同样的巨大高空落差、乳白色云海和连续的大瀑布。
中景左右两侧继续包含同一组巨大的传统宫殿，保持原有的左右位置、体量和与御道的空间关系。
左侧前景继续保留同样极其显眼的大型深色悬挑木结构建筑；密集的木结构不得消失或缩小为普通小建筑。
御道下方和雾气之下，继续保持同样规模的密集古城。
最远中心继续包含同样的巨型山体 / 超大型结构。
远处中心继续保留同样的巨大环形门 / 环形建筑。
角色始终比御道、宫殿、瀑布、底层城市和远处超大型结构小得多。
保持与原参考图像相同的明亮冷白灰、淡暖金、低饱和度日间/晨光、乳白色空气雾霭和巨大景深。
远处的巨大圆环必须始终保持在非常远的地方。
禁止突然拉近使其变成普通山门。
禁止将当前御道重新生成为：
圆形竞技场；
普通庭院；
宽阔广场；
另一座云桥；
新的悬浮平台；
新的山门；
新的浮岛；
新的悬崖；
新的宫殿入口；
新的大楼梯。
禁止为了战斗方便而突然加宽御道。
禁止白天变为夜晚。
禁止用暴风雨乌云替换当前的柔和天气。
所有动作和摄像机必须适应当前真实的御道。
禁止为了动作而重新设计场景。
[背景动态 | 必须生动，但默认不参与剧情]
场景持续自然移动。
远处的云缓慢移动。
巨大的瀑布持续真实地向下坠落。
瀑布底部的水雾持续旋转并与现有的云海融合。
不同距离的云层和雾层保持略微不同的速度，产生真实的视差。
高空自然风持续影响两位主角的黑发、宽袖、衣摆、流苏和配饰。
远处古城和宫殿之间的薄雾持续缓慢移动。
大气透视持续产生微妙变化。
少数远处人物可以在参考图像中已存在的区域内自然移动。
但是：
环境默认在叙事上是中性的。
瀑布不能突然帮助任何人。
雾气不能主动遮挡敌人。
风不能改变剑路。
建筑物不能自行倒塌。
御道不能断裂。
远处的圆环不能突然激活法术。
环境不能主动解决战斗。
只有当角色真正踩踏、急停或武器碰撞时，才允许轻微的尘土、划痕、金属火花、织物位移和鞋底摩擦碎屑。
已经出现的明显痕迹应合理持久存在。
[0–5s | 钩子：无法后退]
0.0–1.0s。
使用 24mm 超广角中心轴大全景。
首先重现位置；位置优先级高于复杂动作。
第一眼必须确认：
同样的长白御道；
左右同样的巨大瀑布；
左右同样的大型宫殿；
左侧同样的大型木结构；
下方的同样古城；
同样的巨大远处圆环。
两位主角在巨大环境中保持较小比例。
大师姐在前。
小师妹落后半步。
更远处，一位受伤的老年师父、几位弟子和一些平民正沿着同一御道继续前进。
两名敌对剑客挡住去路。
领先的敌人横剑封锁有效通道区域：
“护着他们，你们过不去。”
大师姐完全没有停下：
“谁说我们要撤退？”
话音刚落。
敌人毫无预警地发起攻击。
摄像机立即从固定大全景过渡到约 32–35mm 沿御道轴线后退的跟踪镜头。
第一个敌人迅速抢占大师姐的中心线。
大师姐绝不向后撤退。
直到最后一刻，她只斜向移动半个身位，用同一把银色直剑完成短促、坚硬、真实的碰撞，将敌人的剑推出御道中心轴。
没有后续打击。
没有摆姿势。
她立即越过敌人肩膀继续向前。
几乎同时。
第二个敌人从相反方向切向小师妹，试图绕过她攻击后方人群。
小师妹不盲目追逐敌人。
她直接冲入敌人与撤离人群之间的位置，仅用暗钢剑短暂改变对手的攻击线，然后继续向前。
一名敌人快速掠过摄像机附近，身体瞬间填满屏幕，形成第一次自然的隐藏剪辑。
到 0–5 秒结束时，观众必须清楚理解：
他们不是为了留下来赢。
他们是在夺回道路。
[5–10s | 升级：敌人开始攻击真正目标]
保持完全相同的御道、左右宫殿、瀑布、远处圆环和世界尺度。
使用约 35mm 中景跟踪镜头沿桥轴移动。
第一次攻击失败后，敌人必须主动改变策略。
敌方首领不再坚持与大师姐正面硬拼。
他突然改变目标，主动试图绕过大师姐，切入小师妹和撤离人群之间。
另一名敌人同时从相反方向压制大师姐，试图真正分离两位主角。
动作形成连续的因果链：
敌人横斩迫使大师姐短暂偏离御道中心线；
大师姐只进行一次短暂的卸力，不继续纠缠；
敌人投入的冲击惯性导致其身体略微超出最佳攻击位置；
小师妹继续向前。
领先敌人突然从小师妹右前方斜切而来。
小师妹接住第一击。
敌人不停顿，立即改为第二次低位攻击。
小师妹被迫向御道中心线收缩半步。
就在敌人判断她已被封锁之际——
大师姐突然从小师妹身后快速冲到另一侧。
两人完成第一次极快的前后位置交换。
不是双转。
不是同步姿势。
而是在保持向前运动的同时进行紧凑的肩部交叉位置互换。
大师姐直接接管原本压制小师妹的敌人。
小师妹沿着开辟出的半条路径继续向前，成为新的前锋位置。
摄像机仅因两人的真实位置交换而进行短暂的横向移动。
一把敌人的剑擦过镜头，形成自然的遮挡过渡。
禁止无理的环绕拍摄。
此时。
高速追击的脚步声从后方传来。
一名原本落在后面的功能性追兵已经赶到。
前面有人挡路。
后面有人追击。
两位女性首次陷入狭窄御道上最危险的境地：
前后夹击。
[10–15s | 反转：不守人，守路]
重新拉宽至约 28–32mm 移动中景。
用近 1 秒充分解释当前空间：
小师妹在前；
大师姐约在一个身位之后；
前方敌人首领重新占据中心线；
后方追兵快速接近；
撤离的师父、弟子和平民仍在更安全的远处位置移动。
所有人都在参考图像中的同一条真实御道上。
禁止突然切换到其他平台。
前方敌人和后方追兵几乎同时发起攻击。
小师妹本能地想回头。
大师姐只说：
“别守我。”
小师妹停止回头。
大师姐紧接着说：
“守路。”
两人几乎同时爆发。
小师妹不回头救大师姐。
她继续向前，用短促坚硬的暗钢剑碰撞强行将前方敌人的刀刃推出御道中心轴。
大师姐同时处理后方追兵。
她故意让出半步，让敌人真正进入攻击范围。
就在对方体力投入的瞬间，她突然斜向切出攻击轴。
追兵自身的前进动量导致其身体超出半个身位。
大师姐不追击。
立即再次加速向前。
此时，小师妹已将前方敌人推离中心线半个身位。
两位主角高速靠近。
肩线在极近距离擦过。
完成第二次前后位置交换。
这次，她们完全不互相看。
小师妹自然落到后方位置，接管转身再次追击的敌人。
大师姐再次成为前锋位置，面对仍然挡路的领先敌人。
一把敌人的剑扫过摄像机前景，瞬间填满屏幕，形成全片最明确的武器遮挡硬切。
切到稍低的反向摄像机位置。
大师姐仅用银剑进行一次极短、极猛烈的向外偏转。
首领的剑路被彻底推出御道中心轴。
因为他的体重已向前投入，自身的惯性带着他身体侧移约两个身位。
敌人不能掉下桥。
不能被夸张地吹飞。
不需要完全失去战斗能力。
只要打开道路就足够了。
大师姐和小师妹绝对不停下来给予致命一击。
两人直接从敌人中间穿过，沿着同一条白色御道朝远处的巨大圆环继续前进。
后方撤离的人群也开始沿重新开辟的路线前进。
敌方首领转身愤怒大喊：
“你们赢不了！”
不要切到英雄式的正面特写。
摄像机继续从侧后方跟随两位女性前进。
小师妹仍在调整呼吸：
“我们从来不是为了赢。”
大师姐始终看着前方的路：
“只要路还在，就够了。”
只留下极短的停顿。
在同一条远处御道的更深处，几名原本存在于远处人物层的功能性敌人开始慢慢散开，进入下一轮的路障位置。
禁止凭空在雾中生成它们。
禁止突然从建筑物刷新出来。
它们从一开始就存在于真实距离中，只是在这一刻通过动作显露敌意。
两位主角丝毫不减速。
银剑和暗钢剑保持自然的低位戒备状态。
摄像机继续沿御道轴后退。
黑发、衣摆、瀑布、雾气、云朵、远处宫殿和巨大世界始终自然移动。
在两人仍积极走向下一批敌人的状态下：
直接切黑。
[摄像机与剪辑]
三个叙事段落，但绝不等于是三个镜头。
全片使用少量真正功能的剪辑。
主摄像机路径：
24mm 中心轴大全景确认真实位置 → 32–35mm 沿现有御道轴后退跟踪 → 人体经过镜头形成隐藏剪辑 → 武器擦过镜头形成遮挡剪辑 → 当前后夹击发生时，重新拉宽镜头以解释空间 → 最后从侧后方持续跟随两位主角向远处圆环前进。
所有剪辑只能由以下事件自然触发：
角色遮挡；
武器遮挡；
真实武器碰撞；
运动方向的明显变化；
明显的身体失衡；
速度的突然变化。
禁止机械碎片化剪辑。
禁止摄像机比动作更躁动。
禁止无意义的 ORBIT（环绕）。
禁止为了摄像机移动而改变御道、宫殿、瀑布和远处圆环的位置。
动作驱动摄像机。
摄像机不能驱动场景变形。
[声音]
开场首先建立：
高空自然风；
远处持续存在的巨大瀑布低频轰鸣；
浅色石质御道上的脚步声；
极远处的古城环境噪声底。
战斗爆发后添加：
短促尖锐的剑风声；
坚硬、尖锐的金属碰撞声；
鞋底摩擦声；
丝绸织物抖动声；
追兵急促的脚步声；
逐渐沉重的角色呼吸声。
当前后夹击形成时，暂时降低音乐和宽广的环境声场。
突出：
脚步声；
呼吸声；
武器方向。
道路重新开辟后，战斗声音逐渐在角色身后淡出。
最终对话必须清晰：
“我们从来不是为了赢。”
“只要路还在，就够了。”
对话结束后：
瀑布；
高空风；
持续向前的脚步声
重新占据主声场。
音乐绝不能压倒动作细节和对话。
[Seedance 2.0 Mini 生成优先级]
P0：上传背景参考图像的位置身份绝对不能改变。
P0：@Image 1 和 @Image 2 核心角色的身份稳定性。
P1：银色直剑和暗钢剑的归属和连续性稳定性。
P1：同一御道上清晰的前后空间关系。
P1：角色持续的前进方向、敌人攻击方向和摄像机轴线的连续性。
P2：敌人、师父、弟子和平民的具体面孔和复杂服装。
如果需要降低模型复杂度：
首先减少配角细节；
然后减少额外攻击动作；
接着减少装饰性视觉效果。
绝对不能牺牲：
参考图像位置身份；
核心主角身份；
动作因果关系；
空间连续性。
[负面约束]
禁止将当前高空御道变为圆形竞技场。禁止变为普通庭院。禁止变为宽阔广场。禁止添加另一座云桥。禁止添加独立山门。禁止添加浮岛。禁止添加战斗平台。禁止删除左右巨大瀑布。禁止删除左右大型宫殿。禁止删除左侧巨大悬挑木结构。禁止删除底层密集古城。禁止删除远处巨大圆环结构。禁止拉近远处巨大圆环使其变成普通门楼。禁止改变远处宫殿和中景建筑的相对位置。禁止白天突然变为夜晚。禁止用暴风雨乌云替换当前柔和天气。禁止为了动作加宽御道。禁止剪辑后改变御道宽度。禁止环境主动参与剧情。禁止突然断桥。禁止建筑物自行倒塌。禁止雾气主动遮挡敌人。禁止瀑布突然改变攻击。禁止风突然改变剑路。禁止角色无轨迹瞬移。禁止两位主角无缘无故交换位置。禁止随机大面积剑气。禁止能量波碰撞。

variants.label: YouMind 提供的English版本（README.md）
variants.text:
Cinematic photorealistic texture, pure ancient Chinese Xianxia action film, 15 seconds, 16:9, Seedance 2.0 Mini.
This round is not a stationary duel, nor does it continue to repeat the old pattern of "switch to a new weapon → protagonist studies → counter → sword stops at throat".
The core action motif is:
A mobile escort battle occurring on the real high-altitude imperial road shown in the current reference image.
The same Senior Sister and Junior Sister must continuously advance forward while protecting the injured Master, disciples, and ordinary people evacuating behind them.
The enemies' true goal is not necessarily to defeat the two protagonists.
What they want to do is:
Break through the defensive line formed by the two protagonists;
Cut into the evacuating crowd;
Seal off the path for continued advancement.
Therefore, the core of this entire battle is:
**Break the blockade ahead
Block pursuers behind
The two protagonists continuously swap front and back positions
Always reopen the path.**
Actions pursue silkiness but must never be soft.
Silkiness means:
The previous action naturally leads to the next;
Characters are always moving;
Attack and defense never reset to zero;
Weapon direction and character direction are always understandable;
After cuts, one still knows who is in front, who is behind, and who is attacking from where.
Power comes from:
Sudden initiation;
Obvious acceleration;
Real collisions;
Center of gravity changes;
Force offsets;
Imbalance;
Inertia;
Counter-grabs;
Hard stops;
Immediate restarts.
Prohibit soft, dance-like swordsmanship.
Prohibit resetting poses after striking once.
Enemies must have real judgment.
After the first strategy fails, they must change targets, attack routes, pursue, seal paths, flank, or actively separate the two protagonists.
Prohibit enemies lining up to offer attacks.
[Core Character Lock]
Strictly lock only @Image 1 and @Image 2 as the two core protagonists along with their respective primary weapons.
@Image 1 is always the same Sword Immortal Senior Sister as before:
Same adult East Asian female identity;
25–30 years old;
Same face;
Black long hair half-tied;
White jade hairpin;
Tall and slender proportions;
White embroidered silk Hanfu;
Semi-transparent layered wide sleeves;
Silver waist sash;
Jade pendant;
White cloth boots;
The only silver straight sword in the entire film.
@Image 2 is always the same Junior Sister as before:
Same adult East Asian female identity;
20–25 years old;
Same face;
Black braided hair;
Petite proportions;
Cyan-green linen Hanfu;
Dark belt;
Wooden hairpin;
Black cloth shoes;
The only dark steel sword in the entire film.
Enemies, Masters, disciples, ordinary people, and bystanders are all merely functional supporting characters.
Do not waste generation attention strictly locking supporting characters' faces, hairstyles, and complex clothing.
Just ensure that character types, positions, weapons, and action functions remain logically continuous within the shot.
[Round-Specific Scene Hard Anchor | Highest Priority]
The uploaded background reference for this round already displays a complete, highly recognizable location.
Therefore, this round directly enters:
HARD LOCATION ANCHOR.
The reference image is not style inspiration.
The entire video must truly take place on the same high-altitude celestial palace imperial road shown in the reference image.
Prohibit redesigning it into a "similar Xianxia location".
Must continuously maintain the following location identities:
The central axis of the frame always contains the same extremely long, straight, pale white high-altitude imperial road, extending from the foreground towards the distant center.
The imperial road always maintains obvious narrow depth; characters primarily move along the front-back direction; prohibit expanding it into a circular arena, huge courtyard, or wide plaza.
The left and right sides of the imperial road always maintain the same massive high-altitude drop, milky white sea of clouds, and continuous large waterfalls.
The mid-ground left and right continue to contain the same group of huge traditional palaces, maintaining original left-right positions, volume, and spatial relationship with the imperial road.
The left foreground continues to retain the same extremely prominent large dark cantilevered wooden structure building; dense wood structures must not disappear or shrink into ordinary small buildings.
Below the imperial road and under the mist, continue to maintain the same scale of dense ancient city.
The farthest center continues to contain the same giant mountain body / superstructure.
The distant center continues to retain the same huge ring-shaped gate / ring building.
Characters are always much smaller than the imperial road, palaces, waterfalls, underlying city, and distant superstructures.
Maintain the same bright cool white-grey, pale warm gold, low saturation daytime/morning light, milky white air haze, and huge depth as the original reference image.
The distant huge ring must always remain very far away.
Prohibit suddenly pulling it closer to become an ordinary mountain gate.
Prohibit regenerating the current imperial road into:
Circular arena;
Ordinary courtyard;
Wide plaza;
Another cloud bridge;
New floating platform;
New mountain gate;
New floating island;
New cliff;
New palace entrance;
New large staircase.
Prohibit suddenly widening the imperial road for convenient combat.
Prohibit day turning into night.
Prohibit replacing current soft weather with stormy dark clouds.
All actions and cameras must adapt to the current real imperial road.
Prohibit redesigning the scene for the sake of action.
[Background Dynamics | Must be alive, but default non-participatory in plot]
Scene continuously moves naturally.
Distant clouds slowly move.
Huge waterfalls continuously fall realistically downwards.
Water mist at the bottom of waterfalls continuously swirls and merges with the existing sea of clouds.
Cloud layers and fog layers at different distances maintain slightly different speeds, creating realistic parallax.
High-altitude natural wind continuously affects the black hair, wide sleeves, hem, tassels, and accessories of the two protagonists.
Thin mist between the distant ancient city and palaces continuously moves slowly.
Atmospheric perspective continuously produces subtle changes.
A few distant figures can naturally move within areas already existing in the reference image.
However:
The environment is narratively neutral by default.
Waterfalls cannot suddenly help anyone.
Mist cannot actively obscure enemies.
Wind cannot change sword paths.
Buildings cannot collapse on their own.
The imperial road cannot break.
The distant ring cannot suddenly activate spells.
The environment cannot actively resolve combat.
Only when characters truly step, hard stop, or collide with weapons, allow slight stone dust, scratches, metal sparks, fabric displacement, and sole friction debris.
Already appearing obvious traces should reasonably persist.
[0–5s | Hook: Cannot Retreat]
0.0–1.0s.
Use 24mm ultra-wide angle central axis grand panorama.
First reproduce the location; location priority is higher than complex action.
The first glance must confirm:
The same long white imperial road;
Same huge waterfalls on left and right;
Same large palaces on left and right;
Same huge wooden structure on the left;
Same ancient city below;
Same huge distant ring.
The two protagonists maintain small scale within the huge environment.
Senior Sister is in front.
Junior Sister is half a step behind.
Further back at a distance, an injured elderly Master, several disciples, and a few ordinary people are continuing to advance along the same imperial road.
Two enemy swordsmen block the path ahead.
The leading enemy blocks the effective passage area with a horizontal sword:
"Protecting them, you can't pass."
Senior Sister does not stop at all:
"Who said we were retreating?"
As soon as the last word falls.
The enemy launches without warning.
The camera immediately transitions from fixed grand panorama to approx. 32–35mm tracking shot retreating along the imperial road axis.
The first enemy quickly seizes Senior Sister's center line.
Senior Sister never retreats backwards.
Until the last moment, she only shifts diagonally by half a body width, using the same silver straight sword to complete a short, hard, real collision, pushing the enemy sword out of the imperial road's central axis.
No follow-up strike.
No posing.
She immediately continues forward past the enemy's shoulder.
Almost simultaneously.
The second enemy cuts towards Junior Sister from the opposite direction, trying to bypass her to attack the crowd behind.
Junior Sister does not chase enemies wildly.
She directly rushes into the position between the enemy and the evacuating crowd, only briefly changing the opponent's attack line with the dark steel sword, then continues forward.
An enemy passes quickly near the camera, body instantly filling the screen, forming the first natural hidden cut.
By the end of 0–5 seconds, the audience must clearly understand:
They are not staying to win.
They are reclaiming the path.
[5–10s | Upgrade: Enemies Start Attacking True Targets]
Maintain completely identical imperial road, left/right palaces, waterfalls, distant ring, and world scale.
Use approx. 35mm medium shot tracking moving along the bridge axis.
After the first attack fails, enemies must proactively change strategy.
The enemy leader no longer insists on winning head-to-head against Senior Sister.
He suddenly changes target, actively trying to bypass Senior Sister, cutting between Junior Sister and the evacuating crowd.
Another enemy simultaneously presses Senior Sister from the opposite direction, trying to truly separate the two protagonists.
Actions form a continuous causal chain:
Enemy horizontal slash forces Senior Sister to briefly deviate from the imperial road center line;
Senior Sister only performs one brief force release, not continuing entanglement;
The impact inertia already invested by the enemy causes their body to slightly overshoot the optimal attack position;
Junior Sister continues forward.
The leading enemy suddenly cuts diagonally from Junior Sister's right front.
Junior Sister catches the first strike.
The enemy does not pause, immediately changing to a second low-position attack.
Junior Sister is forced to shrink half a step towards the imperial road center line.
Just at the moment the enemy judges she has been sealed off ——
Senior Sister suddenly rushes fast from behind Junior Sister to the other side.
The two complete the first extremely fast front-back position exchange.
Not a double rotation.
Not a synchronized pose.
But a compact shoulder-crossing position swap while maintaining forward motion.
Senior Sister directly takes over the enemy originally pressing Junior Sister.
Junior Sister continues forward along the half-path opened up, becoming the new front position.
The camera only performs a short lateral move due to the two's real position swap.
An enemy sword grazes past the lens, forming a natural occlusion transition.
Prohibit unreasoned orbiting.
At this moment.
High-speed pursuit footsteps come from behind.
A functional pursuer originally falling further back has arrived.
Someone blocking the path ahead.
Someone pursuing from behind.
The two women are truly trapped for the first time in the most dangerous situation of the narrow imperial road:
Front and rear pincer attack.
[10–15s | Flip: Don't Guard People, Guard the Path]
Re-widen to approx. 28–32mm moving medium shot.
Use nearly 1 second to fully explain current space:
Junior Sister is in front;
Senior Sister is about one body length behind;
Front enemy leader reoccupies center line;
Rear pursuers approaching fast;
Evacuating Master, disciples, and ordinary people are still moving in safer positions further away.
Everyone remains on the same real imperial road from the reference image.
Prohibit suddenly cutting to other platforms.
Front enemies and rear pursuers launch almost simultaneously.
Junior Sister instinctively wants to turn back.
Senior Sister only says:
"Don't guard me."
Junior Sister stops turning back.
Senior Sister immediately follows with:
"Guard the path."
The two explode almost simultaneously.
Junior Sister does not turn back to save Senior Sister.
She continues forward, using a short and hard dark steel sword collision to forcibly push the front enemy's blade edge out of the imperial road's central axis.
Senior Sister simultaneously handles the rear pursuer.
She intentionally yields half a step, letting the enemy truly enter attack range.
Just at the moment the opponent's body strength has been invested, she suddenly cuts diagonally out of the attack axis.
The pursuer's own forward momentum causes their body to overshoot by half a body length.
Senior Sister does not chase.
Immediately accelerates forward again.
At this moment, Junior Sister has already pushed the front enemy half a body length away from the center line.
The two protagonists approach at high speed.
Shoulder lines graze at extremely close distance.
Complete the second front-back position exchange.
This time, they don't look at each other at all.
Junior Sister naturally falls to the rear position, taking over the enemy who has turned around to pursue again.
Senior Sister becomes the front position again, facing the leading enemy still blocking the path.
An enemy sword sweeps across the camera foreground, instantly filling the screen, forming the most explicit weapon-occlusion hard cut of the whole film.
Cut to a slightly lower reverse camera position.
Senior Sister only performs one extremely short, extremely fierce outward deflection with the silver sword.
The leader's sword path is thoroughly pushed out of the imperial road's central axis.
Because his body weight was already invested forward, his own inertia carries his body sideways by about two body lengths.
Enemies cannot fall off the bridge.
Cannot be exaggeratedly blown away.
Do not need to completely lose combat ability.
Just opening the path is enough.
Senior Sister and Junior Sister absolutely do not stop to deliver finishing blows.
The two pass directly between the enemies, continuing along the same white imperial road towards the distant huge ring.
The rear evacuating crowd also begins to advance along the reopened route.
The enemy leader turns back and shouts angrily:
"You can't win!"
Do not cut to heroic frontal close-ups.

Pure hand-drawn 2D cartoon animation only — absolutely no 3D. Ever. 24fps on ones, 16:9. Every line breathes with subtle hand-drawn imperfections. A young adventurous boy rides a flying paper airplane over a vibrant seaside town during sunset. The camera stays closely behind his back the entire time — we see his shoulders, messy hair, fragile paper wings, and the world opening ahead.
His loose sky-blue scarf whips toward the camera with fully hand-drawn cloth physics, every fold unique. His messy dark hair flies wildly in the wind with exaggerated cartoon motion. The wind itself appears as flowing white and pale-blue hand-drawn brush strokes swirling around him and trailing behind the plane.
He glides between pastel seaside buildings with wooden balconies, flower pots, and laundry lines. As he passes, shutters burst open in a domino effect and curtains fly outward. Each window releases glowing golden sunset light that hits the camera, forming hand-drawn 2D lens flares and floating dust particles.
The town below is alive — fishermen point upward, children run through streets, seagulls scatter, cats leap across rooftops, and market flags whip in the wind he leaves behind.
Suddenly colorful festival banners stretch across the street. He tries to dodge by pulling the paper plane upward, but the sudden slowdown throws his body forward. He bursts through a banner — a red cloth wraps over his face while ribbons tangle around the wing.
He wobbles on the fragile plane, gripping with one hand while pulling the cloth away with the other. His head shakes left-right-left with exaggerated squash and stretch animation, neck stretching comically and eyes spinning briefly.
Finally he yanks the cloth free. It flies away in the wind. His face appears messy and annoyed — teeth clenched and brows furrowed — then he exhales with relief.
He leans forward and accelerates again, hand-drawn speed lines rushing around him. A clock tower appears suddenly — he brakes hard and sharply banks around it, barely missing the bricks.
Another obstacle appears — a string of lanterns. He flattens himself against the paper plane as they pass inches above his head. One final banner swings into his path; he twists and slides underneath, but a tiny ribbon lands on his nose and he flicks it away in irritation.
Every acceleration stretches his body backward, scarf and hair whipping violently. Every stop throws him forward. Every turn bends the plane dramatically.
The environment is painted in soft watercolor textures — glowing orange and pink skies, terracotta rooftops, emerald trees, and violet shadows with layered parallax depth. Warm golden sunset light washes over everything as seagulls cross the glowing horizon.
Pure 2D. Hand-drawn. No 3D. Ever.

variants.text:
纯手绘 2D 卡通动画，绝无 3D 成分。永远如此。24 帧每秒，16:9 比例。每一笔都带着微妙的手绘痕迹。一个充满冒险精神的男孩，在日落时分骑着一架飞行的纸飞机，飞越一座充满活力的海滨小镇。镜头始终紧随其后——我们能看到他的肩膀、凌乱的头发、脆弱的纸翅膀，以及眼前展开的世界。

他那宽松的天蓝色围巾，带着完全手绘的布料物理效果，每一道褶皱都独一无二，向镜头飘动。他凌乱的深色头发在风中狂野地飞舞，带着夸张的卡通动感。风本身则以流动的白色和淡蓝色手绘笔触呈现，在他周围盘旋，并拖曳在飞机后面。

他滑翔在粉彩色的海滨建筑之间，这些建筑有着木制阳台、花盆和晾衣绳。当他经过时，百叶窗像多米诺骨牌一样纷纷打开，窗帘向外飞舞。每个窗户都释放出金色的日落光芒，照向镜头，形成手绘的 2D 镜头光晕和漂浮的尘埃颗粒。

下面的小镇生机勃勃——渔民向上指着，孩子们在街上奔跑，海鸥四散，猫咪跳过屋顶，市场上的旗帜在他留下的风中飘扬。

突然，五彩缤纷的节日横幅横跨街道。他试图拉起纸飞机来躲避，但突然的减速使他的身体向前倾。他冲破了一面横幅——一块红布蒙住了他的脸，彩带缠绕在机翼上。

他在脆弱的飞机上摇摇晃晃，一只手紧握着，另一只手则拉开蒙在脸上的布。他的头左右摇摆，带着夸张的挤压和拉伸动画效果，脖子滑稽地伸长，眼睛短暂地打着转。

最后，他猛地扯掉了布。它随风飞走。他的脸显得凌乱而恼火——牙齿紧咬，眉头紧锁——然后他如释重负地呼出一口气。

他向前倾身，再次加速，手绘的速度线在他周围飞驰。一座钟楼突然出现——他猛地刹车，急转弯绕过它，险些撞上砖墙。

另一个障碍出现了——一串灯笼。他平躺在纸飞机上，灯笼从他头顶几英寸处掠过。最后一面横幅挡住了他的去路；他扭身滑过，但一根小小的彩带落在了他的鼻子上，他恼怒地把它弹开。

每一次加速都让他的身体向后拉伸，围巾和头发剧烈地飘动。每一次停顿都让他向前倾。每一次转弯都让飞机剧烈地弯曲。

环境以柔和的水彩纹理绘制——发光的橙色和粉色天空、赤陶色屋顶、翠绿色树木和紫罗兰色阴影，带有分层视差深度。温暖的金黄色日落光芒洒满一切，海鸥飞过发光的地平线。

纯 2D。手绘。绝无 3D。永远如此。

path: prompts/真人/现实向/情绪特写/youmind-1347--声学小夜曲与情感反应故事板.md
prompt:
[00:00 – 00:03 | OVER-THE-SHOULDER MEDIUM SHOT - SLOW PUSH IN]
Camera sits just behind and above the red-haired girl's left shoulder, her wild crimson waves and the neck of her acoustic guitar filling the foreground in soft bokeh. Across from her, Ruby, brown curls, dark tee, quilt-covered bed at her back, comes into sharp focus. The warm amber glow of the bedside lamp halos the room. The red-haired girl's strumming hand begins to move. She opens her mouth and sings softly: "Ruby… oh Ruby…" The camera breathes forward almost imperceptibly, closing the emotional distance.

[00:03 – 00:06 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - GUITAR HAND, LOW ANGLE]
Cut to a ground-level macro shot angled upward at the strumming hand against the guitar body. Fingers move with loose, unhurried grace across the strings. The warm lamplight catches the shimmer of each string vibration. The faint resonance of the acoustic body fills the frame. Her voice drifts over: "…do you know how much you mean to me?"

[00:06 – 00:10 | TIGHT CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S FACE, STATIC]
Hard cut to Ruby's face centered, lit entirely by the golden lamp behind her. Her lips are parted just slightly, cheeks flushed, eyes glistening with the quiet weight of being truly seen. A slow, disbelieving smile creeps in at the corner of her mouth. She doesn't speak. She doesn't need to. The song does it all: "Ruby… my Ruby…"

[00:10 – 00:13 | TWO-SHOT MEDIUM - WIDE, HANDHELD DRIFT]
Camera floats back on a subtle handheld drift, revealing both girls in the full frame for the first time the cluttered bookshelves, the faded quilt, the soft chaos of a lived-in room. The red-haired girl leans slightly forward as she reaches the final line, voice barely above a whisper: "…I'll love you till the very end." The last chord rings out and hangs in the air.

[00:13 – 00:15 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S EYES, SLOW RACK FOCUS]
The final cut lands on Ruby's eyes alone. Focus pulls soft… then razor sharp. A single tear catches the lamplight on her lower lash line, not yet fallen. She exhales.

prompt:
固定机位广角延时摄影，完整记录一栋建筑从空地基到竣工的全过程。摄像机保持固定，仅通过时间压缩（10-30 倍快进）来展现建造节奏，并呈现自然光线在场景中的循环（早晨 → 中午 → 黄昏 → 夜晚）。

阶段 0：空旷起点 - 平坦、空旷的原始场地，可见测量桩和放线。施工设备尚未抵达。背景环境（山脉/海洋/城市天际线）清晰可见，作为整个作品中唯一稳定、不变的元素。静态画面持续 3 秒。

阶段 1：场地准备和地基工程 - 挖掘机和推土机迅速抵达，安全围栏竖起，安全标识就位。挖掘机挖地基沟槽，泥土装载到运输车辆并运至场地一侧。地基坑内迅速铺设钢筋网，混凝土搅拌车进入，浇筑并找平。地基轮廓在画面中逐渐清晰。

阶段 2：主体结构生长 - 脚手架像骨架一样从地面迅速升起。混凝土柱和楼板逐层浇筑，每完成一层，整栋建筑都会明显升高——呈现出阶梯式上升的节奏（而非连续飞升）。起重机持续旋转，精确地将钢筋、模板和混凝土构件吊运到工作层。建筑旁边的材料堆放区始终可见，材料堆随着施工进度而增减。

阶段 3：围护结构和外墙封闭 - 楼板结构完成后，外墙材料开始安装：
砖结构：工人逐层砌砖，墙体迅速升高。
玻璃幕墙：起重机吊起整块玻璃单元，工人定位并固定。
木质外墙：工人逐块组装，木板依次覆盖。
石材立面：预切石板吊起，粘合，压紧。
建筑从透明骨架过渡到被外墙“填充”，轮廓变得越来越清晰。

阶段 4：屋顶完工 - 屋顶结构在工人协作下完成：铺设防水层，覆盖保温层，逐块放置表面材料（瓦片/金属屋面/平屋顶铺设）。屋顶封闭标志着主体建筑形态的完成，整体轮廓首次呈现。

阶段 5：门窗和机电安装 - 门窗框架精确安装到开口中，工人使用起重设备缓慢定位玻璃。同时，导管、水管、风管迅速穿过内外墙体，如同血管般延伸至建筑内部。电气设备、管道装置陆续抵达并安装，内部空间从空壳迅速转变为功能性实体。

阶段 6：室内精装修和外部收尾 - 室内地板铺设、墙面涂料、天花板逐步完成，每个空间从粗糙过渡到精装修状态。外部同步推进：立面精装修、外墙涂料滚涂或外挂板安装、窗台压顶，建筑表面质感逐渐变得精致。

阶段 7：景观和场地完工 - 安全围栏拆除，施工设备依次撤离。景观施工车辆抵达：铺撒表土，起重机将树木吊入种植坑，灌木迅速覆盖地面，草坪分段铺设。硬质铺装（石材/木材/混凝土）逐块完成。灯具、标识、设施依次安装。

阶段 8：竣工状态 - 最后一辆施工车辆驶离，场地恢复整洁。建筑巍然屹立：立面一尘不染，景观绿意盎然，灯光亮起。静态画面持续 5 秒。背景环境（山脉/海洋/天际线）仍是最初的区域，从未改变。画面定格——从空地到建筑，见证一座房屋的诞生。

技术参数：
摄像机：固定广角，构图覆盖建筑主体 + 周围材料堆放区 + 车辆进出通道。
风格：建造纪录片，4K 超清，工业质感色调 → 竣工暖色调。
时间压缩：10-30 倍，保持机械动作可读性。
音频：施工声音（机械轰鸣、钢筋碰撞）快进处理 → 竣工时过渡到空灵音乐。
无水印，无字幕，无文字叠加。

精准拆解：[参考图像建筑名称] 有序拆解延时摄影，类型：建筑精准拆解延时摄影 / 固定机位逆向记录，时长：高速逆向演化序列（完整有序拆解周期），核心原则：禁止魔幻过渡；使用快进方式展示机械和人工有序拆解、材料堆放、转运和清理的真实过程。绝对禁止失控的镜头，如倒塌、爆炸、突然消失。所有拆解必须是受控的、按部就班的、有序的工程操作。

拆除方法论：工业级精准拆解：人 + 机械协作 → 逐件拆卸 → 分类堆放 → 系统转运 → 场地清理。

参考图像分析：指令：深入分析用户提供的[参考图像]，默默记录所有建筑关键细节，作为拆解起点的 100% 精确起始点。
分析清单：[建筑风格类型（现代/传统/混合/热带/工业等），建筑层数和整体规模（单层/多层/别墅/豪宅），主体结构形式（木/混凝土/钢/砖石），外立面材料（木/石/玻璃/混凝土/金属/涂层），可拆卸构件清单（屋顶/门窗/外墙板/楼板/柱梁等），材料估算（需要堆放多少立方米的木材/钢材/混凝土块），拆解难度评估（哪些部分需要起重机 vs 人工拆解）]。

初始状态锁定：阶段 0 必须 100% 还原参考图像的竣工状态，作为有序拆解的起始点。

叙事时间线：[阶段 0：竣工状态（拆解前准备），阶段 1：拆解准备和景观移除，阶段 2：内部物品拆解和转运，阶段 3：第一批材料转运（部分清理堆放区），阶段 4：门窗和特殊构件移除，阶段 5：外墙材料移除，阶段 6：第二批材料大规模转运，阶段 7：主体结构拆解（自上而下有序拆卸），阶段 8：地基移除和材料清理] - 每个阶段包含详细的视觉描述、动作风格、关键行动、材料流向以及重要性/强调说明。该提示详细描述了从初始完整建筑状态到系统拆解、材料分类、移除和最终场地清理的整个过程，强调受控拆除方法，避免魔幻过渡或倒塌场景。

prompt: A young witch flies on a broom over an ancient European town at golden hour. The camera stays tight behind her back as the town opens ahead. Her dark purple cloak whips directly into camera, animated with hand-drawn cloth physics. Her long messy brown hair lashes wildly in all directions with expressive independent strands. She flies between narrow stone buildings with flower pots, red tiled roofs, and climbing greenery. Hand-drawn wind lines split around her body and curl into small vortices behind her. As she passes windows, her wind blasts shutters open in a domino chain. White curtains burst outward. Golden sunlight flashes through the glass and creates hand-drawn 2D lens bloom with glowing dust. The town below reacts. People point upward, hats blow away, rooftop cats jump, pigeons explode into flocks, leaves spiral through her wake, and laundry lines whip violently. Suddenly laundry lines cross her path. She tries to dodge. She brakes hard. Her body lurches forward over the broom from the sudden deceleration while her legs lift backward. Too late. She bursts through the first line. A large white shirt catches on her face and completely covers it. A sheet wraps around her body. A sock dangles from the broom. She wobbles on the broom - one leg kicked sideways, one hand gripping tightly, the other yanking wildly at the shirt covering her face. Angry muffled words bubble under the fabric. Her head jerks right-left-right in exaggerated hand-drawn motion with extreme squash and stretch. Her neck elongates with each shake. Her eyes briefly spin when the shirt lifts. She pulls hard. The shirt flies off her face. Her face is revealed: messy hair, comic fury, clenched teeth, burning eyes, deeply furrowed brows - then a long exhale and visible relief. She straightens herself on the broom, leans forward, grips tightly, and accelerates. Hand-drawn speed lines stream around her. A building suddenly appears ahead. She brakes sharply. Her body and broom compress forward. She banks hard around it, shoulder nearly scraping the wall, then snaps back to a straight path and accelerates again. A shop sign appears overhead. She flattens herself low against the broom as the sign passes mere centimeters above her head. Another laundry line appears. This time she twists her body and narrowly passes beneath it at the last moment. A single sock catches on her nose. She flicks it away irritably. Pure 2D hand-drawn traditional animation with hand-painted watercolor backgrounds. Tight rear-follow shot locked close behind the young witch's back for the entire sequence. Camera shows her shoulders, her hair, the broom, the world opening ahead of her. Continuous tracking shot following directly behind her. Occasional hand-drawn 2D lens bloom when sunlight bursts through opened windows. With every acceleration, her body stretches backward, hair and cloak are pushed back harder, hand-drawn speed lines intensify. With every sudden slowdown, her body is thrown forward, hair wraps across her face, cloak folds inward over her back. With every turn, the broom bends, her body leans into the turn, her legs tuck and react expressively.

Scene Description: A battlefield where the fires of war have just been extinguished, visibility is low, and the air is filled with choking smoke and the lingering smell of charring. The ground is soaked with blood and war damage, covered with broken flags, snapped weapons, and layers of fallen soldiers' remains. A soldier in tattered armor kneels alone in the wreckage, his long spear stuck in the bloody soil supporting his body. His armor is stained with blood and soot, and his body seems ready to collapse at any moment from cold and exhaustion. The audience should feel intense desolation, suffocation, and a sense of tension as if shrouded in darkness, as if although the war has ended, some more terrifying threat still lurks in the shadows. The entire clip must be presented with an uninterrupted, stealth-like camera movement.

 Timeline:
0:00-0:04 | Setup: Low-angle stealth perspective tracking shot, moving through thick smoke and scattered embers. The lens is constantly hit by flying charcoal particles and dust, creating intermittent visual obstruction. The camera slides past a tattered battle flag stained with blood and mud, bearing a fragmented unit number, then reveals the outlines stacked beneath the ashes: a piece of armor pierced by arrows, a helmet half-buried in the soil. The overall composition exhibits David Fincher-style precise control and information withholding. Sound Effects: Residual sounds of raging fire, the harsh scraping of soot against metal, distant lingering echoes of explosions.

 0:04-0:10 | Escalation: The camera rotates to the right, focusing on the kneeling armored soldier. He uses the spear inserted into the ground as a support point, initially motionless, with only heavy breathing exhaling white mist in the cold air. His tattered battle robe whips violently in the cold wind, and the blood and soot on his armor crack and flake off as his body trembles. The camera slowly approaches with almost imperceptible precision and circles behind him, continuously tightening the frame, refusing to provide any sense of security. Sound Effects: Heavy breathing sounds, the creaking of armor, the violent whipping sound of the battle robe, tiny collision sounds from debris buried under the soil in the wind.

 0:10-0:15 | Climax: Moving over the soldier's shoulder, the smoke briefly thins, and a massive silhouette, carrying an incredibly heavy force, passes through the black curtain, its full appearance never completely revealed. The soldier senses the threat, raises his head in fear, breathing rapidly, gripping the spear handle tightly, and then forcefully pulls out the long spear. The action of drawing the spear kicks up mud and embers, throwing them towards the camera, at which point the silhouette of the giant beast instantly becomes clearer. Full FPV first-person follow-up feel, high-speed camera switching, handheld without stabilizer.

Dark metallic fragments burst from the skin's surface, as if piercing outward from within the body.

Black liquid metal begins to seep out from the spine, spreading along the body like molten dark iron.

Clothing is torn and stripped away, fabric fragments are absorbed by the black energy field and turn to ash.

Muffled sound of bone restructuring, dark purple electric arcs burst from the joints.

Black-red light penetrates from inside the chest cavity, and energy patterns appear on the skin like cracks.

Camera: Handheld close-up follow-up, frequently losing and regaining focus due to energy impact, simulating the effect of the photographer being pushed back by the air blast.

Micro Animation Details: The thorns at the armor joints slightly tremble and adjust, like breathing; the corrosion patterns on the edge of each plate spread in real-time.

Atmospheric Effects: The moment the transformation is complete, the bloodstains and dust on the ground within a ten-meter radius are compressed into circular ripples by the black oppressive aura. All surrounding flames change color to purple-black flames.

Camera: Fast 360° low-angle orbit. The camera trembles synchronously with each armor plate interlocking, like a physical shockwave hitting the camera directly.

12–15 seconds | Completion·Battlefield Slaughter

Final Form: Full set of black iron spiked mecha, referencing the Sauron-esque Ghost King design—trident spiked helmet, giant blade shoulder pads, full dark heavy armor, blood-red energy patterns.

Weapon Materialization: Hands spread open, dark smoke condenses and rotates in the palms, instantly forming a giant black flame greatsword—the blade is wide and thick, engraved with ancient curse patterns. Extreme close-up on The Flash’s boots touching wet asphalt at night. Raindrops freeze midair as time slows. Golden lightning begins to crawl over his suit, crackling softly.
Camera: Low-angle, slow push-in.
As he leans forward, the world stretches and distorts. On the beat, he launches. The camera snaps into pursuit as he explodes forward in a blinding burst of red and gold lightning, tearing through the city streets. Buildings smear into light trails, traffic lights become streaks of color, thunder rolling underneath the sound design.

DIRECTOR’S PROMPT — PART 2

The Flash accelerates beyond the city, racing across highways, deserts, and oceans in seconds. The curvature of the Earth becomes visible as clouds rip apart beneath him.
Camera: Dynamic tracking shot with heavy motion blur, lightning arcing outward like veins of energy.
Time fractures — day and night collapse into one continuous run. As he reaches maximum velocity, the lightning intensifies into near-white brilliance. He vanishes in a final thunderous flash, leaving only scorched air, fading electricity, and silence.

DIRECTOR’S PROMPT — PART 3

A low, resonant hum builds. The air ahead fractures like glass. A circular portal forms — ancient, unstable — glowing with swirling light and dust, as if time itself is being torn open.

镜头：极速下坠特写，随后与人物速度匹配保持距离，捕捉滑翔待命姿态。

环境：万米高空海面，乌云闪电，海面浓雾，能见度低。

分镜 6-8：组装（6-8 秒）

核心场景：机甲组件通过全息投影有序展开、放大，精确快速地在人物周围组装成实体机甲（展现组件飞来组合）。

变形过程（关键点）：

人物（1:47 比例）在空中保持滑翔姿态。两套巨大的腿部和足部组件（重工业机械美学，非方块感）机甲全息虚拟影像从下方和两侧展开、扩散，精确地附着并锁定在人物下半身。人物双脚踏入实体机甲。

两套巨大的手臂组件（包括保留的右臂机械臂甲）和核心胸部组件全息虚拟投影放大、扩散，精确就位、对接、锁定，完全包裹人物身体。外部实体机甲框架显现。

最后，机甲头部和经典 V 形天线组件从人物面部作为全息虚拟投影放大、扩散，旋转并锁定在顶部，形成实体机甲发光的眼睛。

视觉效果：组件全息投影展开和组装过程中，伴随精密的粒子对齐、机械锁定和能量释放效果，酷炫的粒子和光效。

比例：人物（极小比例）完全融入机甲核心。变形过程流畅、有序、无缝。

镜头：低角度拍摄，机甲框架充满画面。

分镜 9-11：完成（8-11 秒）

核心场景：机甲组装完成，短暂空中悬停并摆出经典巨型机甲完成姿态，随后高速下坠，准备着陆。

动作：机甲在空中组装完成的瞬间，头部天线弹出，眼睛发光（产生镜头光晕），双手（尤其是右手的虚拟/机械臂甲）摆出经典的“完成”或“滑翔后待命”姿态。随后，机甲改变姿态，所有推进器点亮，高速下坠。

机甲细节：磨损掉漆的哑光漆面，油渍斑斑的关节，发光的推进器，产生镜头光晕。

动态：高速下坠，边缘泛红发烫，留下拖曳轨迹。

风格：重工业机械美学，写实金属质感，好莱坞级别特效。

分镜 12：冲击（11-12 秒）
（保留原始动作，重现重型落地感）

核心场景：机甲如流星般砸入海面，单膝跪地，一手撑地的姿态着陆，激起滔天巨浪。

落地：身体悬挂压缩，重型阻尼感反弹。

海面：深蓝色海面被撕裂，数百米高圆形水墙扩散，水下飞溅和气泡涡流，排山倒海的冲击力。

画质：8K 超细节，每一滴水清晰可见，低饱和度橙青色调，电影颗粒感。

7. 升起（12-14 秒）

升起：机甲在短暂落地后缓慢升起（史诗感）。汹涌的海水如海啸般冲击机甲，大量海水在机甲升起时从机甲内部流出。庞大的身躯在波涛中巍然屹立，海水仅及膝盖。直升机如同苍蝇般大小，在周围盘旋，凸显其惊人的体型。浓密的蒸汽和水雾环绕机甲，光线穿透产生丁达尔效应。直升机探照灯扫过机甲，金属表面产生霓虹反射效果。

7. 威胁（14-15 秒）
（保留原始动作）
巨兽：机甲正前方远处出现一只巨大的发光海怪，向其咆哮。

prompt:
15 秒甜宠反转短剧《心蛊》
风格：甜宠、反差、强反转

人物：
男主 [@Image 1]：叶辞，冷面毒王，百毒不侵，清冷孤傲。
女主 [@Image 2]：身着淡蓝色轻纱广袖裙，身背小药篓，娇俏女蛊医，擅长种心蛊，胆大冲动。

0–4 秒 [蛊室 | 昏暗暧昧]
女主手持蛊铃，歪头浅笑，款步走来。
女主：都说你百毒不侵，难道就不怕我的心蛊吗？

4–8 秒 男主抬眸，眼神慑人，冷声开口。
男主：蛊惑人心，雕虫小技。本王从不受人摆布。
女主笑容僵住，委屈转身。

8–10 秒 刚迈出一步，手腕却被猛地抓住。
男主将她拉入怀中，清冷人设瞬间崩塌。

10–15 秒 [甜蜜暴击 + 反转钩子]
他低头，气息低哑灼热。
男主：不是不受蛊惑……而是，我早已被你种下心蛊，无药可医。
[反转钩子] 他指尖轻触她的心口，低语：“此蛊一生只能种一次。你逃不掉了。”

Characters:

Female Lead [@Image 2]: Wearing a light blue sheer wide-sleeved dress, carrying a small medicine pouch, a charming female Gu doctor, skilled in planting 'Heart Gu', daring and impulsive.

0–4 seconds [Gu Chamber | Dim and Ambiguous]
The female lead approaches, shaking a Gu bell, smiling with a tilted head.
Female Lead: They say you're immune to all poisons, aren't you afraid of my Heart Gu?

4–8 seconds The male lead looks up, his coldness intimidating, speaking coldly.
Male Lead: Gu magic that confuses the heart is a trivial trick. This King is never controlled.
The female lead's smile freezes, and she turns away, feeling wronged.

8–10 seconds Just as she steps away, her wrist is suddenly grabbed.
The male lead pulls her into his arms, his cold persona instantly collapsing.

10–15 seconds [Sweet Attack + Reversal Hook]
He lowers his head, his breath low, hoarse, and hot.
Male Lead: It's not that I'm not controlled by Gu... It's that you planted the Heart Gu in me long ago, and there is no cure.
[Reversal Hook] His fingertip traces her chest, and he whispers: “This Gu can only be planted once in a lifetime. You can't escape.”

prompt:
第一幕：工业废墟追逐，15 秒，一镜到底。主体：赛博朋克女主角 @Image 2 站立在领头装甲战车 Image 1 车顶——身穿白色正装，机械义肢，金属颈甲，马尾发型，金色耳环，单手高举红旗长矛，指向前方深邃峡谷。面部细节电影级写实，面部表情全程保持稳定。两辆重型装甲沙漠越野车在狭窄的富铁峡谷中疾驰，峡谷两侧散落着废弃的采矿设备和巨大的吊钩摆锤。[0-3 秒 · 峡谷切入] 镜头切入峡谷壁之间，紧密跟随领头战车急速后退——女主角纹丝不动地站立在车顶 Image 2。红旗长矛在峡谷气流中剧烈飘扬，机械义肢紧握旗杆，白色正装裙摆和马尾头发被高速气流剧烈扬起，机械颈甲和义肢关节在赭红色峡谷侧光中闪烁耀眼金属光泽；镜头突然横向跟踪，跟随两辆战车在尘土和落石中咆哮并行的身影。峡谷两侧的巨大吊钩摆锤在高处缓慢摇摆。[3-7 秒 · 摆锤陷阱触发] 女主角机械义肢突然向上指——驾驶员同步触发头顶吊钩；巨大摆锤猛烈横扫，从追逐车辆上撕下装甲板、链条、工具和金属碎片。一整扇车门在峡谷侧光中翻飞散落；敌车猛然转向，裸露的悬挂系统剧烈迸发火花。女主角稳稳站立在车顶，旗矛划出弧线；镜头低空掠过摆动的吊钩下方，轮毂盖被撕裂，金属碎片在狭窄的赭红色峡谷光线中四散。[7-11 秒 · 反制摆锤 · 破局] 敌方反击，拖拽领头战车冲向预设摆锤陷阱——战车剧烈转向，女主角机械义肢瞬间张开五指，插入车顶钢架锁定重心。机械脊柱结构沿后背展开，抵抗冲击。金属颈甲迸发蓝白电弧，对抗摆锤拉扯力；旗矛被气流冲击显著偏转，但女主角机械义肢反向旋转，牢牢压住旗杆；战车极限漂移，挤入狭窄岩石裂缝，同时巨大吊钩摆锤横向撕裂敌车整个车身，将其猛烈撞向峡谷岩壁，轰然粉碎。浓密尘土和金属撕裂声充满峡谷，尖叫的螺栓和碎裂的岩石在狭窄光线中四处飞溅。[11-15 秒 · 冲出峡谷 · 机甲前定格] 领头战车冲出峡谷出口。光线突然从赭红色峡谷侧光切换为沙漠阳光的暖黄色强烈逆光；镜头缓慢减速拉远——前方开阔的末日废土上，一架巨型机甲 Image 3 在黑烟和烈日中巍然耸立。橙红色火焰从其腿部喷射，黑烟遮天蔽日；战车停在机甲正前方。女主角依然站立在车顶，单手高举红旗长矛，直指机甲驾驶舱。白色正装沾满飞沙，马尾头发在爆炸热浪中逆光飘扬；镜头最终定格在低角度广角，严格复刻构图 Image 3——废弃战车占据画面右下角，巨型机甲占据天空左侧，黑烟与烈日营造出史诗般的压迫感，缓慢淡出。[风格/质量]：4K 超高清，锐利清晰，细节丰富，无模糊或重影，末日工业大片风格，赭红色峡谷侧光与暖黄色沙漠逆光形成强烈对比，金属撕裂的物理效果写实，全程浓密尘土和剧烈动势。[限制]：正常人类结构，面部稳定不扭曲，无画面闪烁。女主角服装和机械细节全程严格遵循 Image 1 原始外观。最终定格构图严格复刻，旗矛长度全程保持一致。时长 15 秒。

第二幕：场景 1：15 秒（机甲攻势 · 女主角反击）。全程视觉风格参考 80 年代香港武侠片剧照质感：VHS 磁带扫描线，胶片颗粒，褪色暖黄色调，轻微画面抖动。主角全程参考 Image 2：白色正装，机械义肢，金属颈甲，马尾发型，金色耳环，站立在废弃老爷车车顶，手持红旗长矛。场景 1（0-4 秒）· 低角度广角。生成末日废土场景 @Image 1，起始帧严格参考构图 Image 1——前景废弃老爷车占据画面右下角，背景巨型机甲占据天空左侧。机甲胸部缓慢打开，喷射出大股橙红色火焰，直扑女主角；女主角单手持矛，另一只机械臂抬起，从袖口喷射出大范围白色遮光隔热雾气，直接对抗火焰。火焰在白雾中逐渐熄灭，沙漠地面留下焦痕。火焰熄灭时镜头缓慢推近。场景 2（4-9 秒）· 跟拍中景切换。机甲肩部导弹舱打开，两枚导弹拖着白色烟迹高速射出；导弹旋转飞行轨迹慢动作特写，镜头跟随导弹视角冲向女主角；女主角侧身，抬起机械义肢，踢飞第一枚导弹。导弹击中远处沙丘爆炸；女主角旋转，挥舞矛杆击开第二枚导弹。导弹在空中偏转，在远处无声坠落。视角切换为仰角。阳光下飞沙走石，女主角稳稳站回车顶，白色正装裙摆在爆炸热浪中飘扬。场景 3（9-15 秒）· 快速三角剪辑对峙。机甲驾驶舱特写——驾驶员面部透过舷窗隐约可见，眼神惊恐；切换至女主角面部特写，眼神冰冷锐利，嘴角微扬，金色耳环在风中轻微摇曳；切换回低角度广角。女主角缓慢将红旗长矛指向机甲驾驶舱。沙漠热浪和黑烟在逆光中涌动。快速三角剪辑节奏逐渐加快，画面轻微抖动，VHS 噪点增强，营造出窒息的对峙感。只生成机甲火焰咆哮声、导弹爆炸冲击声、金属碰撞声和沙漠风声。不包含背景音乐。动作设计符合武侠动作片标准，动作干净利落，无血腥场面，无危险动作指导，矛长全程与 @Image 1 保持一致。

prompt:
场景 1 (3 秒)：一位身披破旧斗篷的资深战士，骑乘在一头巨大的黑曜石鳞片巨龙背上，立于断裂崎岖的悬崖边缘。巨龙张开双翼，发出一声震耳欲聋的咆哮。他们从悬崖边俯冲而下，天空中弥漫着飞舞的火花和盘旋的飞灰。

场景 2 (4 秒)：战士紧紧抓住巨龙的脖颈，巨龙在空中进行着猛烈而高速的螺旋式俯冲。下方是数千名中世纪步兵和重骑兵，他们正进行着混乱而血腥的肉搏战。尘土飞扬，刀剑相击，战旗飘扬。镜头以令人眩晕的环绕运动，紧随巨龙的螺旋飞行轨迹。

场景 3 (4 秒)：战场地面的特写镜头。两名浑身沾满泥土、身着厚重板甲的步兵正进行着殊死搏斗，刀剑相撞。一名士兵愤怒地咬紧牙关，将一把闪亮的双手长剑刺入另一名士兵的胸甲。鲜血以慢动作喷溅而出，真实的画面展现了战争的原始残酷。

场景 4 (4 秒)：巨龙低空掠过，距离地面仅数米，其巨大的阴影吞噬了尖叫、恐惧的军队。它喷吐出大量耀眼夺目的液态龙焰。白热的火焰之海瞬间吞噬了整排交战的士兵，将战场变成了一堵火墙。高对比度的光影，强烈的热浪扭曲效果，史诗般的最高潮。

风格：史诗般的巨龙之战，高速空中机动，崎岖的中世纪血腥战场。电影级灯光，动态摄影机追踪。4K，60fps，超逼真纹理，光线追踪火焰和反射，精雕细琢的盔甲和鳞片。

Shot 06 (0:10-0:12)

Shot 07 (0:12-0:14)
Sweeping fast pan reveals a sprawling cyberpunk city horizon while the pistol snaps toward one last rooftop threat; two quick shots, shell casings flying past the lens.

A vast frozen valley under pale twilight. Towering glacier walls reflect soft blue light across the snowfield while wind sweeps fine snow particles across the surface. The frozen ground glitters with crystalline frost.

**Action:**

15.0s sequence from the first-person perspective of a massive glacier tiger stalking prey. The viewer sees white fur edges at the bottom of frame and faint icy vapor in each breath. The tiger moves silently through deep snow while distant footsteps echo across the frozen valley.

At the 2-second mark the tiger breaks into a sprint. Snow explodes outward beneath its paws as the camera races low across the terrain.

A herd of elk appears ahead near a frozen river.

Velocity Ramp choreography: the tiger launches into a massive leap as the moment slows — snow crystals and frost particles suspended in the air before snapping back to real-time speed as the tiger lands across the ice.

The frozen river cracks violently beneath the impact.

**Camera:**

Low predator-eye POV racing just above the snow surface, with occasional head tilts revealing the immense glacier walls surrounding the hunt.

**Style & Constraints:**

Photorealistic fur edges, volumetric snow particles, cinematic cold lighting, realistic animal motion physics, 8K.

title: Seedance 2.0 提示词技术和模板
title_en: Seedance 2.0 Prompting Techniques and Template
changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。
path: prompts/真人/现实向/剧情短片/youmind-200--Seedance-2.0-提示词技术和模板.md
prompt:
① 通用公式

主体 + 动作 + 场景 + 光线 + 镜头语言 + 风格 + 质量 + 约束

示例：
一个女孩在海边缓慢行走，发丝被微风轻柔吹动，自然微笑，夕阳暖光，中景，缓慢推近，运镜稳定流畅，4K 高清，电影质感，面部清晰无畸形。

② 动作描述

不要只写：走路 / 跳舞
要写：缓慢 + 持续 + 自然

优先词：
缓慢、轻柔、自然、持续、流畅、不僵硬

好用的组合：
缓慢转身 / 轻柔抬手 / 微微低头 / 随风摇曳

③ 镜头语言

Seedance 在识别镜头运动上很强，记得写：

特写 / 中景 / 特殊镜头
缓慢推近 / 轻微拉远 / 平滑横移 / 稳定跟拍

示例：
中景，缓慢推近，稳定跟拍，运镜流畅无卡顿

④ 防变脸 / 防畸形

非常重要：

面部清晰，五官稳定，无畸形
人体结构正常，比例自然
相同人物，服装一致，发型不变

⑤ 质量提升通用词

4K，超高清，细节丰富，清晰锐利
电影质感，柔和光影，色彩自然
无模糊，无闪烁，画面稳定

⑥ 风格 / 氛围词

治愈清新 / 日系风格 / 韩系氛围
复古胶片颗粒 / 梦幻柔光 / 赛博朋克
极简干净 / 高级质感

⑦ 多镜头写法（进阶用法）

按顺序描述，不要随意打乱：

特写面部开场 → 缓慢拉远 → 人物缓慢行走 → 镜头平稳跟随 → 定格微笑结尾

⑧ 规避指南

❌ 剧烈跑跳 / 复杂多人互动
❌ 模糊词：好看 / 很美 / 很酷
❌ 矛盾要求：超高速 + 极致稳定

⑨ 可直接复制的模板

人像氛围短片
一个女孩在森林中缓慢行走，发丝被微风轻柔吹动，自然微笑，中景，缓慢推近，运镜稳定流畅，4K 高清，电影质感，面部清晰无畸形。

风景氛围
夕阳下的海边，海浪轻柔拍打沙滩，镜头缓慢横移，暖橙色调，画面流畅，4K 超高清，无闪烁无重影。

⑩ 提示总结

1️⃣ 动作写缓慢、持续
2️⃣ 运镜写稳定、简单
3️⃣ 必加稳定 / 无畸形 / 不僵硬
4️⃣ 质量 & 风格最后加
5️⃣ 少复杂，多精准

Wild curly black hair barely contained under a brown newsboy cap. Wears a wrinkled olive-green apron over a flannel shirt with haphazardly rolled sleeves. Moves like a pinball — bouncing between stations, sliding across the floor, catching things mid-air without looking. Every movement triggers the next part of the machine. His body IS part of the mechanism. Pixar-style 3D rendering: rubbery expressive limbs, exaggerated squash-and-stretch on fast movements, warm skin tones. Subject 2: The café itself — every object is a component of one interconnected Rube Goldberg machine. The espresso machine is the central engine. The sequence involves: a marble track built from bent spoons along the ceiling, balanced cups on saucers that tip like dominoes, a hanging mobile of sugar cubes acting as a counterweight system, a toy train on a track delivering milk from the fridge to the steamer, and a small catapult made from a ruler and napkin holder that launches the finished cup to the counter. Subject 3: The customer — a deadpan woman in a business suit, briefcase in hand, reading glasses on a chain. Completely unfazed by the chaos. She stands at the counter with the patience of someone who has seen this before. ENVIRONMENT: A tiny corner café — barely ten feet wide. Exposed brick walls covered in chalkboard menus with hand-drawn coffee illustrations. Every horizontal surface has a mechanical element: marble tracks on shelves, cup-and-saucer balance chains along the counter, tiny pulleys strung from the ceiling with twine. Warm morning light streams through a single front window catching dust and steam. A small bell hangs above the door. The whole space feels like a brilliant inventor's workshop that serves coffee. MOOD: Manic joy. The barista is in his element — the chaos is intentional, practiced, musical. Every crash, pour, and launch is precisely timed. The punchline deflates the entire spectacle in the best possible way. TIMELINE: 0:00–0:03: The door opens — bell dings. The customer places her briefcase on the counter. Says nothing. The barista points at her, nods — he knows the order. He flicks a marble from his apron pocket onto a ceiling track. The marble rolls — clicking over ridges, banking around a curve, dropping through a funnel into a cup on a saucer on a high shelf. The cup's weight tips the saucer, pulls a string, releases a cabinet latch — coffee beans slide down a ramp into a hand-crank grinder. Audible: bell ding, marble clicking on track, cup clinking, string twang, beans cascading. 0:03–0:06: The barista cranks the grinder with one hand while pulling a lever starting the toy train. The train chugs along a counter-edge track — passes the fridge where a small arm places a milk carton in the car — continues to the steam wand where the track tilts and pours milk into a steaming pitcher. Ground coffee falls through a chute into the portafilter. The barista slams it in with his elbow while catching a falling sugar cube from the overhead mobile with his other hand, dropping it into a cup. Audible: grinder crunching, train chugging and whistling, milk pouring, portafilter clicking, mobile tinkling. 0:06–0:09: Espresso machine fires — rich dark coffee flowing into a porcelain cup. Close-up: crema forming, thick and golden-red, swirling. The barista steams milk — pitcher vibrating, velvety microfoam building. He pours with a practiced wrist flick — a perfect rosetta latte art pattern forms. He tops it with a single coffee bean placed dead center. Camera lingers on the completed drink — perfect, beautiful. Audible: espresso hissing, milk steaming (tearing-paper sound), the gentle pour, the bean placed with a tiny tap. 0:09–0:12: The delivery. The barista places the cup on the ruler catapult and slams his palm down. The cup launches in a perfect arc — camera follows in slow motion as it rotates, latte art intact, not a drop spilled. It lands with a clean clink on a saucer directly before the customer. Steam rises in a perfect spiral. The barista slides into frame behind the counter, slightly breathless, fingers pointing at the drink with showman's pride. Audible: catapult snap, cup whistling through air, clean landing clink, a beat of silence. 0:12–0:15: The customer adjusts her reading glasses. Looks at the latte art. Looks at the barista. "Actually — can I get tea?" The barista's face falls — completely deflated. Shoulders drop. Cap slides askew. A long beat. Then his eyes snap back to life. He pulls out a different marble — a green one — and flicks it onto a completely different track on the opposite wall. The entire café begins moving again — a whole new sequence activating. The customer takes a seat. She's done this before. Cut to black. Audible: her flat delivery, the defeated exhale, then the green marble clicking onto the track and the café machine roaring back to life.

variants.text:
主题:
主题 1: 一个手忙脚乱的咖啡师——身材瘦小、精瘦，三十出头，眼睛总是惊慌失措的样子，永远带着胡茬。狂野的黑色卷发，勉强被一顶棕色报童帽压住。穿着一件皱巴巴的橄榄绿围裙，里面是法兰绒衬衫，袖子随意地卷着。动作像弹珠一样——在各个工作台之间弹跳，在地板上滑行，不看也能在半空中接住东西。他的每一个动作都触发了机器的下一个部分。他的身体就是这个机制的一部分。皮克斯风格的 3D 渲染：富有弹性的表现力肢体，快速移动时夸张的挤压和拉伸效果，温暖的肤色。

主题 2: 咖啡馆本身——每一个物件都是一台相互连接的鲁布·戈德堡机械的组成部分。意式浓缩咖啡机是核心引擎。整个流程包括：天花板上用弯曲的勺子搭成的弹珠轨道，像多米诺骨牌一样倾斜的平衡茶杯和茶碟，一个由方糖组成的悬挂式平衡系统，一列在轨道上行驶的玩具火车，将牛奶从冰箱运到蒸汽棒，以及一个由尺子和餐巾架制成的小型弹射器，将做好的咖啡杯弹射到柜台。

主题 3: 顾客——一位面无表情、身穿商务套装的女士，手里提着公文包，老花镜挂在链子上。对眼前的混乱完全不为所动。她站在柜台前，耐心十足，仿佛对这一切早已司空见惯。

环境: 一间狭小的街角咖啡馆——宽度不足十英尺。裸露的砖墙上挂满了黑板菜单，上面有手绘的咖啡插画。每一个水平表面都带有一个机械元素：货架上的弹珠轨道，柜台边沿的杯碟平衡链，以及用细绳从天花板上悬挂下来的微型滑轮。温暖的晨光透过一扇前窗洒进来，照亮了空气中的灰尘和蒸汽。门上方挂着一个小铃铛。整个空间感觉就像一个天才发明家的工作室，只不过是用来制作咖啡的。

情绪: 狂热的喜悦。咖啡师如鱼得水——这种混乱是刻意的、熟练的、富有节奏感的。每一次碰撞、倾倒和弹射都精准无误。最后的“包袱”以最精彩的方式消解了整个表演。

时间线:
0:00–0:03: 门开了——铃铛叮当作响。顾客把公文包放在柜台上。一言不发。咖啡师指了指她，点点头——他知道订单了。他从围裙口袋里弹出一颗弹珠，弹到天花板上的轨道上。弹珠滚动着——咔嗒咔嗒地越过凸起，绕过弯道，穿过漏斗落入高架上茶碟里的一个杯子。杯子的重量使茶碟倾斜，拉动一根绳子，释放了一个柜子插销——咖啡豆沿着斜坡滑入一个手摇研磨机。音效：铃铛声、弹珠在轨道上咔嗒声、杯子叮当声、琴弦拨动声、咖啡豆倾泻声。

0:03–0:06: 咖啡师一手摇动研磨机，同时拉动一个杠杆启动玩具火车。火车沿着柜台边缘的轨道吭哧吭哧地行驶——经过冰箱时，一只小机械臂将牛奶盒放入车厢——然后继续开到蒸汽棒处，轨道倾斜，将牛奶倒入一个蒸汽奶泡壶。研磨好的咖啡粉通过滑槽落入咖啡手柄。咖啡师用手肘猛地将其推入，同时用另一只手接住从头顶悬挂装置上掉落的方糖，将其放入杯中。音效：研磨机嘎吱声、火车吭哧声和汽笛声、牛奶倾倒声、咖啡手柄咔嗒声、悬挂装置叮当声。

0:06–0:09: 意式浓缩咖啡机启动——浓郁的深色咖啡流入一个瓷杯。特写：咖啡油脂形成，浓稠呈金红色，旋转着。咖啡师打发牛奶——奶泡壶震动着，天鹅绒般的微奶泡逐渐形成。他熟练地手腕一抖倾倒，一个完美的玫瑰花拿铁艺术图案形成了。他在正中央放上一颗咖啡豆作为点缀。镜头停留在完成的饮品上——完美，美丽。音效：意式浓缩咖啡嘶嘶声、牛奶蒸汽声（撕纸声）、轻柔的倾倒声、咖啡豆轻微的放置声。

0:09–0:12: 递送环节。咖啡师将杯子放在尺子弹射器上，然后猛地拍下手掌。杯子以完美的弧线弹射出去——镜头慢动作跟随，杯子旋转着，拿铁艺术完好无损，一滴未洒。它干净利落地“叮”一声落在顾客面前的茶碟上。蒸汽呈完美的螺旋状升腾。咖啡师滑入柜台后的画面中，略微气喘吁吁，手指指向饮品，带着表演者的骄傲。音效：弹射器“啪”一声、杯子划过空气的呼啸声、干净利落的落地“叮”声、一阵寂静。

0:12–0:15: 顾客调整了一下老花镜。看了看拿铁艺术。又看了看咖啡师。“其实——我能要杯茶吗？”咖啡师的脸垮了下来——彻底泄了气。肩膀耷拉着。帽子歪了。一阵漫长的停顿。接着他的眼睛又重新焕发了生机。他拿出一颗不同的弹珠——一颗绿色的——弹到对面墙上一个完全不同的轨道上。整个咖啡馆又开始运转起来——一个全新的流程被激活了。顾客坐了下来。她以前也这么做过。画面切黑。音效：她平淡的语气、泄气的叹息声，然后是绿色弹珠在轨道上咔嗒作响，咖啡馆的机器再次轰鸣着运转起来。

prompt: Core Theme: Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu; ruin collapse; dark energy convergence; heavily armored dark knight + armored Taotie (pure form) undergoing synchronized transformation; cinematic-level weight and oppression; CG realism blending biotechnology and dark heavy armor aesthetics. Character Setup Face: Strict 1:1 replication of reference image. Facial features, face shape, and hairstyle must match exactly, with no beautification or stylization. Visible bruises and minor abrasions on the face; traces of blood at the corner of the mouth. Expression: Overall exhausted and suppressed. During transformation: extreme pain (brows tightly furrowed, teeth clenched, facial muscles tensed, increasing blood traces, body convulsing uncontrollably). After transformation: pain is instantly restrained, shifting to a cold, oppressive, and composed demeanor. Pre-transformation Clothing: Strictly based on reference, with added heavy battle damage (tears, burn marks, dirt, dust accumulation). Preserve original silhouette and structural details; do not alter the outfit design. Pre-transformation Creature: Cute creature. small enough to be held with one hand. Fur slightly messy with dirt; expression gentle yet alert; shows dependency on the protagonist; consistently protected in the protagonist's arms. Heavily Armored Dark Knight Design A robust physique fully covered in dark iron heavy armor (deep black base with cold metallic reflections). Shoulder and chest armor feature spikes and intricate rune engravings. Helmet: fully enclosed, crown-like with three forward-curving spikes; faceplate completely sealed; narrow, non-glowing visor. A heavy charcoal-gray cloak drapes down to the calves. Right hand carries a massive rune battle axe (dark metallic body with embedded dim gold glowing runes). Left arm exposed, showing defined muscles and prominent veins; stance upright and imposing. Armored Taotie (Evolved from the animal): The animal gradually mutates into a four-legged beast: A fusion of lion and reptile traits; huge size with explosive musculature. Body covered in layered, irregular dark gray scales with cold silver edges. Head develops a pair of thick curved horns with ring-like textures. Entire body gains matching dark iron armor (layered shoulder plates and dense spiked chest armor). Limbs are thick and powerful, especially the forelimbs; claws are black and hook-shaped. Mouth slightly open, revealing pale fangs. Final pose: stationary beside the knight in a guardian stance. Core Prop In the protagonist's right hand: "Sacred Ring Crystal Core" — black base infused with high-frequency dark gold energy flow (overall dark-gold tone to match the theme). Environment Post-apocalyptic rooftop in a ruined city. Overcast sky, light wind, distant ongoing warfare. Gray-blue sky with meteors streaking across, trailing fire and smoke. Ground scattered with dark-gold rune fragments. Visual Quality & Lighting IMAX film texture; Panavision C-series 35mm lens (f/4 aperture). Low saturation gray-blue + dark gold color scheme. Shadows are deep but retain detail. Soft edge focus with natural film grain. Strong contrast between "physical pain" and "cold metal". Effects Core Dark energy + dark-gold rune particles forming a vortex. Protagonist and capybara are enveloped simultaneously. Armor assembly conveys intense piercing pain (reflected in facial and body reactions). Sharp, harsh metal-clamping sounds. Battle axe gradually materializes. animal transforms frame-by-frame (scale growth → body expansion → horn emergence → single eye activation). Energy surges tightly synchronized with pain responses. No holy or divine effects; purely oppressive dark atmosphere emphasizing their bond. Camera Movement One continuous take; handheld with subtle breathing motion. Path: extreme wide falling shot → shaking push-in to mid close-up → transformation orbit → pull-back low-angle dual frame → aerial top-down pull-away. 0–15s Shot Breakdown 0–3s: Protagonist falls from high altitude, tightly holding the capybara protectively; rolls on impact, kicking up dust. Struggles to stand; briefly looks at the capybara (soft moment), then stares at the crystal core. Camera follows fall, impact shake, and rapid push-in close-up. 3–6s: Protagonist locks eyes with the animal, conveying strong bond; whispers "Let's do this together." Crushes the core; a dark energy pillar erupts skyward. Energy vortex engulfs both. Eyes turn black; runes appear on the animal. Slight camera shake. 6–9s: Protagonist tilts head back with a suppressed painful roar; body convulses, veins bulge, blood increases. Dark metal fragments and energy burst outward. Armor assembles in a "devouring" manner. Helmet closure marks peak pain. Animal expands, scales form, horns emerge. Camera shakes violently with brief defocus. 9–12s: Knight armor fully forms; cloak drops; battle axe materializes. animal fully evolves into armored Taotie, standing beside. Old clothing disintegrates. Camera orbits to showcase the completed forms. 12–15s: Knight stands upright with axe; pain fully suppressed, presence cold and dominant. Taotie subtly moves, showing bond. Low-angle shot with floating debris. Sudden vertical launch; ground cracks, shockwave expands. Camera briefly blurs from force, then stabilizes with heat distortion. Audio No background music. Only: metal clashing, energy bursts, rune vibrations, and battle axe materialization sounds.

variants.text:
核心主题：现实科幻特摄；废墟崩塌；暗能量汇聚；重甲暗骑士 + 装甲饕餮（纯粹形态）进行同步变形；电影级的厚重感和压迫感；CG 级写实，融合生物科技与暗黑重甲美学。

角色设定面部：严格 1:1 复刻参考图。面部特征、脸型、发型必须完全一致，无美化或风格化处理。脸部可见淤青和轻微擦伤；嘴角有血迹。
表情：整体疲惫、压抑。变形过程中：极度痛苦（眉头紧锁、牙关紧咬、面部肌肉紧绷、血迹增多、身体不受控制地抽搐）。变形后：痛苦瞬间收敛，转变为冰冷、压迫、沉着的神态。
变形前服装：严格参照参考图，增加重度战损（撕裂、烧痕、污垢、积灰）。保留原始轮廓和结构细节；不改变服装设计。
变形前生物：可爱生物。小到可以单手抱起。毛发略显凌乱，带有污垢；神情温顺而警惕；对主角表现出依赖；始终被主角护在怀中。

重甲暗骑士设计：健壮的身躯完全覆盖在暗铁重甲中（深黑色基底，带有冷冽金属反光）。肩甲和胸甲带有尖刺和复杂的符文雕刻。头盔：全封闭式，冠状，带有三根向前弯曲的尖刺；面甲完全密封；狭窄、不发光的目镜。一件厚重的炭灰色斗篷垂至小腿。右手持一柄巨型符文战斧（暗金属斧身，镶嵌着暗淡金光符文）。左臂裸露，展现出清晰的肌肉线条和凸起的血管；姿态挺拔，气势逼人。

装甲饕餮（由生物进化）：该生物逐渐变异成四足巨兽：融合了狮子和爬行动物的特征；体型巨大，肌肉爆发力强。身体覆盖着层叠、不规则的暗灰色鳞片，边缘带有冷银色光泽。头部生出一对粗壮的环状弯角。全身获得配套的暗铁装甲（层叠的肩甲和密集的尖刺胸甲）。四肢粗壮有力，尤其是前肢；爪子呈黑色钩状。嘴巴微张，露出苍白的獠牙。最终姿态：静止在骑士身旁，呈守护姿态。

核心道具：主角右手：“圣环晶核”——黑色基底，注入高频暗金色能量流（整体暗金色调，与主题匹配）。

环境：废墟城市中的末日天台。阴沉的天空，微风，远处战火持续。灰蓝色天空，流星划过，拖曳着火焰和烟尘。地面散落着暗金色符文碎片。

视觉质量与灯光：IMAX 电影质感；Panavision C 系列 35mm 镜头（f/4 光圈）。低饱和度灰蓝色 + 暗金色配色方案。阴影深邃但保留细节。柔和边缘对焦，带有自然胶片颗粒感。“肉体痛苦”与“冰冷金属”之间的强烈对比。

特效：核心暗能量 + 暗金色符文粒子形成漩涡。主角和水豚同时被包裹。装甲组装过程传达剧烈的穿刺疼痛（反映在面部和身体反应上）。尖锐、刺耳的金属夹击声。战斧逐渐实体化。生物逐帧变形（鳞片生长 → 身体膨胀 → 角部出现 → 单眼激活）。能量涌动与疼痛反应紧密同步。无神圣或神性效果；纯粹的压抑黑暗氛围，强调他们之间的羁绊。

0–3 秒：主角从高空坠落，紧紧护住水豚；落地翻滚，扬起尘土。挣扎站起；短暂看向水豚（柔和瞬间），随后凝视晶核。镜头跟随坠落、落地震动，并快速推近特写。
3–6 秒：主角与生物眼神交汇，传达强烈羁绊；低语“我们一起。”捏碎晶核；一道暗能量光柱冲天而起。能量漩涡吞噬两者。双眼变黑；符文出现在生物身上。镜头轻微晃动。
6–9 秒：主角仰头，发出压抑的痛苦嘶吼；身体抽搐，青筋暴起，血迹增多。暗金属碎片和能量向外迸发。装甲以“吞噬”方式组装。头盔闭合标志着痛苦达到顶峰。生物膨胀，鳞片形成，角部出现。镜头剧烈晃动，短暂失焦。

环境：
小型社区便利店入口，铺砖人行道，内部有饮料海报，可见购物篮，午后阳光，玻璃上有柔和的反射。背景保持固定和一致。

皮克斯般的吸引力，具有逼真的材质，可信的皮肤着色，电影级全局光照，柔和的漫反射光，高端动画电影品质，喜剧时机，清晰的面部动画，物理上合理的运动。

喜剧前提：
快递员试图进入，但自动门只在他走开时才打开，而每当他自信地走近时，门就会关闭。

镜头：
一个锁定的中景广角镜头，只有非常微妙的电影式推近，无剪辑，无角度变化，无镜头畸变变化。

他带着轻松的自信走向自动门，嘴角带着一丝微笑，调整了一下配送包，走到入口处。门保持关闭。

0:02-0:04
他困惑地后退一步。门立刻自动滑开。他眼前一亮，再次向前走去。就在他到达前，门又关上了。

0:04-0:06
他再次尝试，这次更快。他左倾，右倾，小步，大步，弓步，所有动作都带着越来越荒谬的认真。每次门都在恰好错误的时机做出反应。

0:06-0:08
现在他完全投入了，做出夸张的“潜行”动作，戏剧性地定格，然后冲刺一小段距离。门以完美的喜剧时机继续“戏弄”他。面部表情变得越来越绝望，但仍然迷人且干净。

0:08-0:10
门终于大开，他为此庆祝——但他却得意洋洋地径直撞上了旁边那块一尘不染的固定玻璃侧板，而不是敞开的门洞。柔和的喜剧效果，没有受伤，只有震惊的沉默。他带着破碎的尊严，慢慢地将一只手滑到玻璃上。

prompt:
Seedance 2.0 Pro - 10 sec TEST -
Prompt 👇👇👇

Subject 1 (Main Character):
A young female retro-futuristic spaceship mechanic.

Appearance:
Sharp cheekbones, lively eyes, slightly messy short black hair with copper highlights.
Small grease marks on her face.
Expressive face with strong comedic reactions.

Outfit:
Utility jumpsuit in faded teal and orange accents.
Rolled sleeves, worn fabric, tool belt, fingerless gloves.
Slightly oversized, practical silhouette with subtle wrinkles.

Subject 2 (Companion Object):
A tiny magnetic repair robot shaped like a floating metal sphere with two articulated mini arms.
Polished chrome body, glowing blue lens eye.
Fast, mischievous movement, playful hovering, precise but chaotic.

Prop:
A glowing plasma wrench.

Environment:
Inside a compact spaceship repair bay.
Exposed pipes, blinking control panels, dangling cables, small sparks in the background.
Workbench full of tiny parts and tools.
Soft fog from a coolant leak.
Background slightly cluttered but visually controlled.

Lighting:
Cinematic sci-fi lighting.
Cool blue ambient light mixed with warm orange sparks.
Strong rim light, glossy reflections on metal surfaces.
Shallow depth of field.

Mood:
Confident focus -> suspicious confusion -> frantic chaos -> comic defeat.

Color Logic:
Muted industrial blues and greys, orange sparks and teal suit as focal accents.

Camera Style:
Dynamic handheld feel, medium close shots, macro inserts, quick punch-in moments.
High detail, smooth motion, cinematic realism with subtle comedic exaggeration.

Performance Arc:
Calm and capable -> mildly annoyed -> chasing panic -> shocked surrender.

Timeline:
0:00–0:02 — Beat 1 (Confident setup)
Medium close shot.
The mechanic tightens a panel with the glowing plasma wrench.
She smiles with professional confidence.
The mini robot hovers nearby, appearing helpful and innocent.

0:02–0:04 — Beat 2 (First mischief)
Close-up.
As she reaches for a screw, the robot quietly steals it with a magnetic pull.
She notices the missing screw, pauses, narrows her eyes.
The robot pretends to scan the wall innocently.

0:04–0:06 — Beat 3 (Escalation)
Quick cuts.
Every tool she grabs gets magnetically pulled away at the last second.
Wrench, screwdriver, bolts, all snap toward the robot.
Her expression shifts from confusion to disbelief to irritation.
The robot zips around her head playfully.

0:06–0:10 — Beat 4 (Chaotic chase)
Faster rhythm.
She lunges after the floating robot through the cramped repair bay.
Cables sway, tiny sparks fly, she nearly slips, catches herself dramatically.
The robot keeps dodging with perfect comic timing.

0:08–0:10 — Beat 5 (Payoff)
Slow-motion comic finish.
She finally grabs the robot triumphantly—
but it magnetically pulls every loose metal object in the room onto her suit at once.
Now covered in spoons, bolts, tools, and random metal parts, she freezes in stunned silence.
The robot hovers in front of her and gives a cheerful blinking wink.

prompt:
Character & Setup
Full-body based on reference image (upper-body reference), with face, hairstyle, and features matched exactly. She wears a hat. Expression is tense and restrained, slightly painful, with a faint frown—carrying a strong sense of despair and intensity in his eyes.

Clothing: Dark grey coat, dark inner layer, no belt, wearing heavy black-tech gauntlets.

Environment: Apocalyptic wasteland, grey-blue sky, strong winds, smoke and debris in the air. Meteors streak across the sky with faint flames and trails of smoke.

⸻

Visual Style

IMAX film look with a 35mm Panavision lens.

Low-saturation grey tones, compressed shadows with preserved detail, subtle film grain and edge vignetting.

Heavy, oppressive atmosphere with realistic lighting and physical presence.

⸻

Camera Rules

One continuous handheld shot with subtle breathing motion.

Starts from a low-angle upward shot, focusing on the face and upper body, slowly circling to a frontal view during transformation. The weapon in his hand remains the visual anchor.

⸻

0–3s · Stare

The injured protagonist stands still, slightly lowering his head. Her body is tense.

She slowly raises his right arm forward, stiff and heavy.

A dim glow surrounds the gauntlet. Her breathing subtly moves her body.

Suddenly, her eyes ignite with purple-white light, creating strong lens flares.

⸻

3–6s · Activation

A deep whisper: “Transform!”

She snaps his right hand sharply.

Purple crystal-like electricity bursts from her arm. The air compresses inward, distorting space.

A circular shockwave expands around her. Strange glowing blue runic lines appear and orbit his body.

⸻

6–9s · Tearing

Dark gold cracks erupt from her chest. Thick golden liquid flows like blood.

Blue mist and fine electric arcs surge outward.

Her coat tears apart from the inside, edges burning into ash.

Fragments of organic armor burst outward, then unnaturally retract and reattach.

Her face tightens in pain as glowing blue markings spread symmetrically. A small tear opens on his cheek, revealing pulsing orange light beneath.

⸻

9–12s · Growth

New organic matter seeps from within, shimmering with iridescent light and moving toward the chest.

White armor plates collide and fuse, leaving scorched marks.

The chest core flickers like embers, not fully stabilized.

Her outer clothing is violently stripped away.

Purple-black metal spreads across her face, forming an uneven mask.

Compound eyes begin forming, flickering irregularly.

⸻

12–15s · Completion

The helmet seals fully. Horn-like structures grow upward, burning with purple-gold flames.

One eye glows steadily while the other flickers with electrical instability.

Armor is uneven and battle-damaged, with glowing cracks and leaking fluid.

The camera slowly circles to her right, then pulls back from above.

She shifts into a ready combat stance, standing against the harsh environment.

角色与设定
角色全身基于参考图（上半身参考），面部、发型和特征精确匹配。她戴着一顶帽子。表情紧张而克制，略带痛苦，眉宇间微蹙——眼中流露出强烈的绝望和专注。

服装：深灰色外套，深色内搭，无腰带，戴着厚重的黑科技臂铠。

环境：末日废土，灰蓝色天空，狂风呼啸，空气中弥漫着烟尘和碎屑。流星划过天际，拖曳着微弱的火焰和烟迹。

⸻

视觉风格

IMAX 电影质感，搭配 35mm Panavision 镜头。

低饱和度灰色调，阴影压缩但细节保留，带有微妙的胶片颗粒和边缘暗角。

沉重压抑的氛围，写实的光照和实体感。

⸻

镜头规则

一个连续的手持镜头，带有微妙的呼吸感。

从低角度仰拍开始，聚焦于面部和上半身，在变形过程中缓慢环绕至正面视角。她手中的武器保持为视觉焦点。

⸻

0–3s · 凝视

受伤的主角静立不动，微微低头。她的身体紧绷。

她缓慢地抬起右臂，僵硬而沉重。

臂铠周围环绕着微弱的光芒。她的呼吸轻微牵动着身体。

突然，她的双眼燃起紫白色光芒，产生强烈的镜头光晕。

⸻

3–6s · 激活

一声低沉的耳语：“变形！”

她猛地甩动右臂。

紫色水晶般的电流从她的手臂中迸发。空气向内压缩，扭曲了空间。

一道圆形冲击波在她周围扩散。奇异的蓝色发光符文线条出现并环绕着她的身体。

⸻

6–9s · 撕裂

暗金色裂纹从她的胸口迸裂。浓稠的金色液体如血液般流淌。

蓝色薄雾和细密的电弧向外涌动。

她的外套从内部撕裂，边缘燃烧成灰烬。

有机装甲碎片向外爆裂，随后不自然地收缩并重新附着。

她的脸因痛苦而紧绷，发光的蓝色纹路对称地蔓延。她脸颊上裂开一道小口，露出下方跳动的橙色光芒。

⸻

9–12s · 生长

新的有机物质从内部渗出，闪烁着虹彩光芒，向胸口汇聚。

白色装甲板相互碰撞并融合，留下烧焦的痕迹。

胸部核心像余烬般闪烁，尚未完全稳定。

她的外衣被猛烈地剥离。

紫黑色金属蔓延至她的面部，形成一张不规则的面具。

复眼开始形成，不规则地闪烁。

⸻

12–15s · 完成

头盔完全闭合。角状结构向上生长，燃烧着紫金色火焰。

一只眼睛稳定发光，另一只则因电能不稳定而闪烁。

装甲不平整且带有战损，有发光的裂缝和渗出的液体。

镜头缓慢地环绕至她的右侧，然后从上方拉远。

她转变为备战姿态，矗立在严酷的环境中。

The boat skims through the canal, narrowly avoiding walls as sparks and water spray collide.

0:09 - 0:12

path: prompts/真人/现实向/生活与vlog/youmind-2147--极致专注的拉面厨师冲刺电影.md
prompt:
Shot on ALEXA 65mm anamorphic lens. Photorealistic cinematic quality. Aspect ratio 2.39:1 widescreen. Teal shadows, warm amber highlights. Film grain. Tokyo neon dusk. Lens flares, motion blur. Dolby Vision HDR.

0.0s–2.5s:

Extreme low-angle tracking shot — a hyper-focused street female food chef sprints at impossible speed through a neon-lit Tokyo alley, clutching a steaming bowl of ramen. Crisp apron flapping, sleeves rolled, sneakers splashing through puddles. Camera shakes aggressively behind them. Steam trails like smoke. Neon signs streak across frame. Their face — intense, locked-in, slightly unhinged determination.

2.6s–5.0s:

Whip-pan — they shoulder-check a stack of plastic crates. TIME REMAP: slow-motion chaos — vegetables, bowls, and chopsticks explode into the air. Broth ripples in perfect cinematic detail without spilling. They tilt the bowl mid-run, saving every drop. Quick glance back, dead serious. Continue sprint.

5.1s–7.5s:

Drone shot — they leap across narrow alley gaps between buildings. SLOW MOTION: steam spirals upward into neon light. A cat jumps out of the way. Laundry lines ripple. They casually garnish the ramen mid-air with one hand — flawless precision.

7.6s–10.0s:

360° orbital shot — they slide across the hood of a parked car, spin, land clean. One sandal nearly slips off but is caught mid-motion. They adjust grip on the bowl, completely composed.

10.1s–13.0s:

First-person POV — a small ramen shop door rushes forward. SMASH CUT: door slams open. Steam floods the frame. They step in, perfectly calm now. Place the bowl gently on the counter. Slow push-in.

Low-angle shot. They look at the customer:

“Still hot.”

Customer sits in stunned silence as steam rises dramatically.

variants.label: YouMind 提供的中文版本（README_zh.md）
variants.text:
ALEXA 65mm 变形镜头拍摄。电影级写实画质。2.39:1 宽屏画幅。青色阴影，暖琥珀色高光。胶片颗粒。东京霓虹暮色。镜头光晕，运动模糊。Dolby Vision HDR。

0.0s–2.5s:

极致低角度跟踪镜头——一位专注的街头女厨师，以不可思议的速度飞奔穿过霓虹闪烁的东京小巷，紧抓着一碗热气腾腾的拉面。围裙飒飒作响，袖子卷起，运动鞋溅起水花。镜头在他们身后剧烈晃动。热气如烟般缭绕。霓虹招牌划过画面。他们的脸上——专注、坚定，带着一丝近乎疯狂的决绝。

2.6s–5.0s:

快速摇摄——他们用肩膀撞开一堆塑料箱。时间重映射：慢动作下的混乱——蔬菜、碗筷在空中炸裂。汤汁在完美的电影细节中荡漾，却滴水未洒。他们在奔跑中倾斜面碗，挽救每一滴汤汁。迅速回眸一瞥，神情严肃。继续冲刺。

5.1s–7.5s:

无人机镜头——他们飞跃在狭窄的楼宇间小巷缝隙。慢动作：蒸汽向上盘旋，融入霓虹灯光。一只猫跳开躲避。洗衣绳随风摆动。他们单手在空中随意地为拉面加料——精准无瑕。

7.6s–10.0s:

360° 环绕镜头——他们滑过一辆停放汽车的引擎盖，旋转，稳稳落地。一只凉鞋差点滑落，却在半空中被稳住。他们调整了握碗的姿势，神态自若。

10.1s–13.0s:

第一人称视角——一家小拉面店的门迅速逼近。猛烈剪辑：门猛地被撞开。蒸汽瞬间充满画面。他们迈步而入，此刻已全然平静。将面碗轻轻放在柜台上。缓慢推近镜头。

低角度镜头。他们看向顾客：

“还热着呢。”

顾客在震惊中沉默不语，热气戏剧性地升腾而起。
